    const katexOptions = {
        delimiters: [
            {left: '\\[', right: '\\]', display: true},
            {left: '\\(', right: '\\)', display: false},
            {left: '$$', right: '$$', display: true},
            {left: '$', right: '$', display: false}
        ],
        throwOnError: false,
        strict: false,
        trust: true
    };

    let renderTimeout;
    function safeRender() {
        if (renderTimeout) clearTimeout(renderTimeout);
        renderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);
        }, 100);
    }

    renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);

    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        let shouldRender = false;
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
            if (mutation.target &&
                mutation.target.className &&
                typeof mutation.target.className === 'string' &&
                mutation.target.className.includes('katex')) {
                return;
            }
            shouldRender = true;
        });

        if (shouldRender) {
            safeRender();
        }
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        characterData: true
    });

    setInterval(() => {
        const text = document.body.innerText;
        if (text.includes('\\(') || text.includes('$$')) {
            safeRender();
        }
    }, 2000);
});
</script>
</head>
<body>

<div id="game-container">
  <canvas id="gameCanvas"></canvas>

  <!-- HUD -->
  <div id="hud">
    <div class="hud-item">
      <span>分数 Score</span>
      <span class="hud-value" id="score-val">0</span>
    </div>
    <div class="hud-item">
      <span>连击 Streak</span>
      <span class="hud-value" id="streak-val">0</span>
    </div>
    <div class="hud-item">
      <span>关卡 Level</span>
      <span class="hud-value" id="level-val">1</span>
    </div>
    <div class="hud-item">
      <span>生命 ❤️</span>
      <span class="hud-value" id="lives-val">3</span>
    </div>
    <button id="pause-btn" onclick="togglePause()">⏸</button>
  </div>

  <!-- Zone Labels -->
  <div id="zone-labels">
    <div class="zone-label left">
      📐 变化率描述
      <span class="en">Rate Description — dy/dt 表示斜率</span>
    </div>
    <div class="zone-label right">
      🚫 代数误解
      <span class="en">Misconception — 试图"解出y"</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- Start Screen -->
  <div id="start-screen">
    <h1>📊 微分方程卡片分类挑战</h1>
    <p class="subtitle">Differential Equation Sort Challenge</p>
    
    <div class="instruction-box">
      <h3>🎯 游戏目标</h3>
      <p>数学表达式从上方落下，拖动底部的<span style="color:#ffd700">接球框</span>到正确区域：</p>
      
      <div class="zone-preview">
        <div class="zone left-zone">
          <h4>📐 变化率描述</h4>
          <p>正确理解 dy/dt 的含义<br>（描述斜率/变化率）</p>
        </div>
        <div class="zone right-zone">
          <h4>🚫 代数误解</h4>
          <p>错误地把微分方程当<br>成普通代数方程求解</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="example">
        <span class="correct">✅ dy/dt = y + t → "y的变化率等于y+t"</span>
        <br>
        <span class="wrong">❌ 移项解出 y = ... → 这是错误的！</span>
      </div>

      <p style="font-size:12px;color:#aaa;">
        💡 <strong>关键直觉：</strong>微分方程 <code style="color:#74b9ff">dy/dt = f(t,y)</code> 描述的是一条曲线在每一点的<strong>斜率</strong>，而不是一个可以"解出来"的固定值。
      </p>
    </div>

    <button id="start-btn" onclick="startGame()">🚀 开始挑战</button>
    <p style="font-size:11px;color:#666;margin-top:12px;">3条生命 · 错分扣生命 · 限时加分</p>
  </div>

  <!-- Pause Overlay -->
  <div id="pause-overlay">
    <h2>⏸ 暂停</h2>
    <button id="resume-btn" onclick="togglePause()">▶ 继续</button>
    <button id="restart-btn" onclick="restartGame()">🔄 重新开始</button>
  </div>

  <!-- Game Over Screen -->
  <div id="gameover-screen">
    <h2>🏁 游戏结束</h2>
    <div class="stats-grid">
      <div class="stat-card">
        <div class="stat-label">最终分数</div>
        <div class="stat-value" id="final-score">0</div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-card">
        <div class="stat-label">正确分类</div>
        <div class="stat-value" id="final-correct">0</div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-card">
        <div class="stat-label">最高连击</div>
        <div class="stat-value" id="final-streak">0</div>
      </div>
      <div class="stat-card">
        <div class="stat-label">准确率</div>
        <div class="stat-value" id="final-accuracy">0%</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="best-score" id="best-score-text"></p>
    <button onclick="restartGame()" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#00ced1,#74b9ff);color:#000;border:none;padding:12px 40px;font-size:18px;font-weight:bold;border-radius:50px;cursor:pointer;">🔄 再来一次</button>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const container = document.getElementById('game-container');

  // High DPI support
  function resizeCanvas() {
    const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    canvas.width = rect.width * dpr;
    canvas.height = rect.height * dpr;
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    W = rect.width;
    H = rect.height;
  }

  let W, H;
  resizeCanvas();
  window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);

  // ============ CARD DATA ============
  const rateCards = [
    { text: "dy/dt = y + t", type: "rate", explanation: "这表示 y 的变化率(rate)取决于 y 和 t" },
    { text: "斜率 = 当前位置 + 时间", type: "rate", explanation: "dy/dt 描述的是每一点的斜率(slope)" },
    { text: "变化率取决于\n当前状态", type: "rate", explanation: "微分方程描述状态如何变化，不是固定值" },
    { text: "dy/dt 表示斜率\n而非 y 的值", type: "rate", explanation: "导数(derivative)就是瞬时变化率" },
    { text: "在每一点，曲线的\n倾斜程度是 y+t", type: "rate", explanation: "这就是方向场(direction field)的含义" },
    { text: "y 的变化速度\n与 y 本身有关", type: "rate", explanation: "这正是微分方程的核心：变化率与状态相关" },
    { text: "dy/dt = 2y", type: "rate", explanation: "y 的变化率与 y 成正比——指数增长！" },
    { text: "温度变化率\n取决于温差", type: "rate", explanation: "dT/dt = -k(T-T_env) 牛顿冷却定律" },
    { text: "人口增长率\n与当前人口成正比", type: "rate", explanation: "dP/dt = kP —— 经典的微分方程模型" },
    { text: "dy/dt = cos(t)", type: "rate", explanation: "y 的变化率随时间周期性变化" },
    { text: "描述曲线斜率\n随位置变化", type: "rate", explanation: "微分方程给出每个点的切线方向" },
    { text: "速度 = 加速度 × 时间", type: "rate", explanation: "dv/dt = a —— 最基本的微分关系" },
    { text: "dy/dt = y(1-y)", type: "rate", explanation: "逻辑斯蒂方程——增长率随 y 变化" },
    { text: "变化率由\n当前位置决定", type: "rate", explanation: "这就是为什么微分方程需要初始条件" },
    { text: "dy/dt 不等于 y", type: "rate", explanation: "导数和函数值是两个不同的概念！" },
  ];

  const wrongCards = [
    { text: "移项得:\ny - dy/dt = t", type: "wrong", explanation: "❌ 不能像代数方程那样移项！dy/dt 不是普通的 y" },
    { text: "解出 y = t/(1-t)", type: "wrong", explanation: "❌ 你不能直接「解出」y！这是微分方程，不是代数方程" },
    { text: "令 dy/dt = 0\n得 y = -t", type: "wrong", explanation: "❌ 这是求平衡点，不是「解方程」。dy/dt 通常不等于 0" },
    { text: "y = t² + C\n（随便积分）", type: "wrong", explanation: "❌ 对 dy/dt=y+t 不能简单积分，需要积分因子法" },
    { text: "把 dy/dt 当成 y\n代入求解", type: "wrong", explanation: "❌ dy/dt 是变化率，不是 y 本身！概念混淆" },
    { text: "y = t + dy/dt\n两边消去 dy/dt", type: "wrong", explanation: "❌ 不能随意消去导数！dy/dt 是 y 的函数" },
    { text: "代入 y=0\n得 0 = t", type: "wrong", explanation: "❌ 代入一个值不代表解了方程！这只是检查一个点" },
    { text: "dy/dt = y+t\n所以 y = 0, t = 0", type: "wrong", explanation: "❌ 这不是方程组的解！微分方程描述的是关系" },
    { text: "交叉相乘:\ny·dt = t·dy", type: "wrong", explanation: "❌ 这是相加不是相乘！不能交叉相乘" },
    { text: "直接写答案:\ny = e^t", type: "wrong", explanation: "❌ dy/dt=y+t 的解不是简单的 e^t，需要系统求解" },
    { text: "dy/dt + t = y\n所以 y 是常数", type: "wrong", explanation: "❌ y 显然不是常数！如果 y 是常数，dy/dt=0，矛盾" },
    { text: "两边除以 y:\n(dy/dt)/y = 1 + t/y", type: "wrong", explanation: "❌ 这样并不能「解出」y，分离变量法需要更系统的步骤" },
    { text: "画图时把 y 画\n成水平直线", type: "wrong", explanation: "❌ 如果 dy/dt=y+t，y 不可能恒定——它一直在变！" },
    { text: "dy/dt = y+t\ny = (dy/dt) - t", type: "wrong", explanation: "❌ 这只是重排了方程，并没有「解出」y（y 仍出现在 dy/dt 中）" },
    { text: "当 t=1 时\ny = dy/dt + 1", type: "wrong", explanation: "❌ 代入 t 的值不等于解出 y，dy/dt 仍然未知" },
  ];

  // ============ GAME STATE ============
  let gameActive = false;
  let paused = false;
  let score = 0;
  let streak = 0;
  let bestStreak = 0;
  let lives = 3;
  let level = 1;
  let correctCount = 0;
  let totalAttempts = 0;
  let cards = [];
  let particles = [];
  let floatingTexts = [];
  let catcher = { x: 0, y: 0, width: 120, height: 50 };
  let spawnTimer = 0;
  let spawnInterval = 120; // frames
  let cardSpeed = 1.2;
  let lastTime = 0;
  let achievements = [];
  let speedBonusTimer = 0;
  let gracePeriod = 180; // 3 seconds at 60fps
  let graceTimer = 0;
  let shakeAmount = 0;
  let comboTimer = 0;
  let comboText = '';

  // Load achievements from localStorage
  let unlockedAchievements = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('de_game_achievements') || '[]');
  let bestScore = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('de_game_best') || '0');

  // ============ ZONE DEFINITIONS ============
  // Left zone: rate (correct zone for rate cards)
  // Right zone: wrong (correct zone for wrong cards)
  function getZone(x) {
    return x < W / 2 ? 'left' : 'right';
  }

  // ============ CARD CLASS ============
  function createCard() {
    const isRate = Math.random() < 0.5;
    const pool = isRate ? rateCards : wrongCards;
    const data = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
    
    const cardWidth = Math.min(W * 0.35, 220);
    const cardHeight = data.text.includes('\n') ? 80 : 55;
    
    return {
      x: Math.random() * (W - cardWidth - 40) + 20,
      y: -cardHeight - 10,
      width: cardWidth,
      height: cardHeight,
      text: data.text,
      cardType: data.type, // 'rate' or 'wrong'
      explanation: data.explanation,
      vy: cardSpeed + Math.random() * 0.5,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5,
      rotation: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1,
      angularVel: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.002,
      alpha: 1,
      caught: false,
      catchAnim: 0,
      bounceBack: false,
      bounceVy: 0,
      bounceVx: 0,
      shakeTimer: 0,
      glowPhase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2,
      lines: data.text.split('\n'),
    };
  }

  // ============ PARTICLES ============
  function spawnParticles(x, y, color, count) {
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
      const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 4;
      particles.push({
        x, y,
        vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
        vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed - 2,
        life: 1,
        decay: 0.015 + Math.random() * 0.02,
        size: 2 + Math.random() * 4,
        color
      });
    }
  }

  function spawnFloatingText(x, y, text, color) {
    floatingTexts.push({
      x, y,
      text,
      color,
      life: 1,
      decay: 0.018,
      vy: -1.5
    });
  }

  // ============ ACHIEVEMENTS ============
  function checkAchievement(id, name, icon) {
    if (unlockedAchievements.includes(id)) return;
    unlockedAchievements.push(id);
    localStorage.setItem('de_game_achievements', JSON.stringify(unlockedAchievements));
    
    const popup = document.createElement('div');
    popup.className = 'achievement-popup';
    popup.innerHTML = `${icon} 成就解锁: ${name}`;
    container.appendChild(popup);
    setTimeout(() => popup.remove(), 3000);
  }

  // ============ DRAWING ============
  function drawCard(card) {
    ctx.save();
    const cx = card.x + card.width / 2;
    const cy = card.y + card.height / 2;
    ctx.translate(cx, cy);
    ctx.rotate(card.rotation);

    if (card.shakeTimer > 0) {
      ctx.translate(Math.sin(card.shakeTimer * 2) * 5, 0);
      card.shakeTimer -= 0.5;
    }

    // Card glow
    const glowColor = card.cardType === 'rate' ? 'rgba(0,206,209,0.3)' : 'rgba(255,107,107,0.3)';
    ctx.shadowColor = glowColor;
    ctx.shadowBlur = 10 + Math.sin(card.glowPhase) * 5;

    // Card background
    const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(-card.width/2, -card.height/2, card.width/2, card.height/2);
    if (card.cardType === 'rate') {
      gradient.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 206, 209, 0.15)');
      gradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 150, 200, 0.1)');
    } else {
      gradient.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 107, 107, 0.15)');
      gradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(200, 80, 80, 0.1)');
    }

    ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
    ctx.strokeStyle = card.cardType === 'rate' ? 'rgba(0,206,209,0.6)' : 'rgba(255,107,107,0.6)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    roundRect(ctx, -card.width/2, -card.height/2, card.width, card.height, 10);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

    // Card text
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    const fontSize = card.lines.length > 1 ? 13 : 14;
    ctx.font = `bold ${fontSize}px 'Courier New', monospace`;
    const lineHeight = fontSize + 4;
    const startY = -((card.lines.length - 1) * lineHeight) / 2;
    
    card.lines.forEach((line, i) => {
      ctx.fillText(line, 0, startY + i * lineHeight);
    });

    // Type hint icon
    ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText(card.cardType === 'rate' ? '📐' : '🤔', -card.width/2 + 6, -card.height/2 + 14);

    ctx.restore();
    card.glowPhase += 0.03;
  }

  function roundRect(ctx, x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
    ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
    ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
    ctx.closePath();
  }

  function drawCatcher() {
    const cx = catcher.x + catcher.width / 2;
    const cy = catcher.y + catcher.height / 2;

    // Left half (rate zone)
    const leftGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(catcher.x, catcher.y, catcher.x + catcher.width/2, catcher.y);
    leftGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,206,209,0.4)');
    leftGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,206,209,0.2)');
    
    ctx.fillStyle = leftGrad;
    roundRect(ctx, catcher.x, catcher.y, catcher.width/2, catcher.height, 8);
    ctx.fill();

    // Right half (wrong zone)
    const rightGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(catcher.x + catcher.width/2, catcher.y, catcher.x + catcher.width, catcher.y);
    rightGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,107,107,0.2)');
    rightGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,107,107,0.4)');
    
    ctx.fillStyle = rightGrad;
    roundRect(ctx, catcher.x + catcher.width/2, catcher.y, catcher.width/2, catcher.height, 8);
    ctx.fill();

    // Divider line
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, catcher.y + 5);
    ctx.lineTo(cx, catcher.y + catcher.height - 5);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Border
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.6)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    roundRect(ctx, catcher.x, catcher.y, catcher.width, catcher.height, 10);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Labels on catcher
    ctx.font = 'bold 11px sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,206,209,0.9)';
    ctx.fillText('📐 变化率', catcher.x + catcher.width * 0.25, cy);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,107,107,0.9)';
    ctx.fillText('🚫 误解', catcher.x + catcher.width * 0.75, cy);
  }

  function drawParticles() {
    particles.forEach(p => {
      ctx.globalAlpha = p.life;
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * p.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    });
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawFloatingTexts() {
    floatingTexts.forEach(ft => {
      ctx.globalAlpha = ft.life;
      ctx.font = 'bold 18px sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.fillStyle = ft.color;
      ctx.fillText(ft.text, ft.x, ft.y);
    });
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  function drawBackground() {
    // Grid pattern
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.03)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    const gridSize = 40;
    for (let x = 0; x < W; x += gridSize) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
      ctx.lineTo(x, H);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    for (let y = 0; y < H; y += gridSize) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, y);
      ctx.lineTo(W, y);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Center divider
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.setLineDash([5, 10]);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(W/2, 70);
    ctx.lineTo(W/2, H - 120);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);

    // Zone backgrounds
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,206,209,0.02)';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 70, W/2, H - 120);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,107,107,0.02)';
    ctx.fillRect(W/2, 70, W/2, H - 120);
  }

  function drawCombo() {
    if (streak >= 3 && comboTimer > 0) {
      ctx.globalAlpha = comboTimer;
      ctx.font = `bold ${20 + streak}px sans-serif`;
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.fillStyle = streak >= 10 ? '#ffd700' : streak >= 5 ? '#ff6b6b' : '#74b9ff';
      ctx.fillText(`🔥 ${streak} 连击!`, W/2, H/2 - 40);
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      comboTimer -= 0.005;
    }
  }

  function drawGraceIndicator() {
    if (graceTimer > 0) {
      ctx.font = '14px sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(85, 239, 196, ${Math.min(1, graceTimer / 60)})`;
      ctx.fillText('🛡️ 安全期 - 熟悉操作', W/2, H - 145);
    }
  }

  // ============ GAME LOGIC ============
  function update() {
    if (!gameActive || paused) return;

    // Grace period
    if (graceTimer > 0) {
      graceTimer--;
    }

    // Spawn cards
    spawnTimer++;
    if (spawnTimer >= spawnInterval) {
      spawnTimer = 0;
      if (cards.length < 5) {
        cards.push(createCard());
      }
    }

    // Update cards
    cards.forEach(card => {
      if (card.caught) {
        // Card is being sorted
        card.catchAnim += 0.05;
        if (card.bounceBack) {
          card.x += card.bounceVx;
          card.y += card.bounceVy;
          card.bounceVy += 0.3;
          card.alpha -= 0.02;
        } else {
          // Move toward catcher
          const tx = catcher.x + catcher.width / 2 - card.width / 2;
          const ty = catcher.y + catcher.height / 2 - card.height / 2;
          card.x += (tx - card.x) * 0.15;
          card.y += (ty - card.y) * 0.15;
          card.alpha = 1 - card.catchAnim;
        }
      } else {
        // Normal falling
        card.y += card.vy;
        card.x += card.vx;
        card.rotation += card.angularVel;

        // Bounce off walls
        if (card.x < 5 || card.x + card.width > W - 5) {
          card.vx *= -1;
          card.x = Math.max(5, Math.min(W - card.width - 5, card.x));
        }

        // Check if caught by catcher
        if (card.y + card.height > catcher.y + 5 &&
            card.y < catcher.y + catcher.height &&
            card.x + card.width > catcher.x &&
            card.x < catcher.x + catcher.width) {
          
          handleCatch(card);
        }

        // Missed - card fell below catcher (only after grace period)
        if (card.y > H - 100 && !card.caught && graceTimer <= 0) {
          card.caught = true;
          card.bounceBack = true;
          card.alpha = 0.5;
          
          // Missed card - small penalty
          streak = 0;
          spawnFloatingText(card.x + card.width/2, card.y, '💨 漏掉了!', '#aaa');
        }
      }
    });

    // Remove dead cards
    cards = cards.filter(c => {
      if (c.bounceBack && (c.alpha <= 0 || c.y > H + 100)) return false;
      if (c.caught && !c.bounceBack && c.catchAnim >= 1) return false;
      return true;
    });

    // Update particles
    particles.forEach(p => {
      p.x += p.vx;
      p.y += p.vy;
      p.vy += 0.1;
      p.life -= p.decay;
    });
    particles = particles.filter(p => p.life > 0);

    // Update floating texts
    floatingTexts.forEach(ft => {
      ft.y += ft.vy;
      ft.life -= ft.decay;
    });
    floatingTexts = floatingTexts.filter(ft => ft.life > 0);

    // Combo timer
    if (comboTimer > 0 && comboTimer < 1) {
      comboTimer -= 0.003;
    }

    // Level progression
    const cardsPerLevel = 8;
    const newLevel = Math.floor(correctCount / cardsPerLevel) + 1;
    if (newLevel > level) {
      level = newLevel;
      cardSpeed = 1.2 + (level - 1) * 0.3;
      spawnInterval = Math.max(50, 120 - (level - 1) * 10);
      document.getElementById('level-val').textContent = level;
      spawnFloatingText(W/2, H/2, `⬆️ 关卡 ${level}!`, '#74b9ff');
    }

    // Update HUD
    document.getElementById('score-val').textContent = score;
    document.getElementById('streak-val').textContent = streak;
    document.getElementById('lives-val').textContent = '❤️'.repeat(Math.max(0, lives));
  }

  function handleCatch(card) {
    card.caught = true;
    const zone = getZone(card.x + card.width / 2);
    const isCorrect = (zone === 'left' && card.cardType === 'rate') || 
                      (zone === 'right' && card.cardType === 'wrong');

    totalAttempts++;

    if (isCorrect) {
      correctCount++;
      streak++;
      if (streak > bestStreak) bestStreak = streak;

      // Score calculation
      let points = 10;
      // Speed bonus
      const timeOnScreen = (card.y + card.height) / (card.vy * 60);
      if (timeOnScreen < 3) {
        points += 5;
        spawnFloatingText(card.x + card.width/2, card.y - 20, '⚡ +5 速度加成!', '#ffd700');
      }
      // Streak bonus
      if (streak >= 3) {
        points += Math.min(streak, 10);
      }
      score += points;

      // Particles
      const pColor = card.cardType === 'rate' ? '#00ced1' : '#ff6b6b';
      spawnParticles(card.x + card.width/2, card.y + card.height/2, pColor, 15);
      spawnFloatingText(card.x + card.width/2, card.y - 10, `+${points}`, '#55efc4');

      // Combo display
      if (streak >= 3) {
        comboTimer = 1;
      }

      // Achievements
      if (correctCount === 1) checkAchievement('first_sort', '初次分类', '🎯');
      if (streak === 5) checkAchievement('perfect_5', '五连对', '🔥');
      if (streak === 10) checkAchievement('perfect_10', '十连对', '💥');
      if (score >= 100) checkAchievement('master', '微分大师', '🏆');

    } else {
      // Wrong sort
      streak = 0;
      comboTimer = 0;
      
      if (graceTimer <= 0) {
        lives--;
        document.getElementById('lives-val').textContent = '❤️'.repeat(Math.max(0, lives));
      }

      // Bounce back with explanation
      card.bounceBack = true;
      card.bounceVy = -5;
      card.bounceVx = (card.x < W/2 ? 1 : -1) * 3;
      card.shakeTimer = 20;

      // Red particles
      spawnParticles(card.x + card.width/2, card.y + card.height/2, '#ff6b6b', 10);
      spawnFloatingText(card.x + card.width/2, card.y - 10, '❌ 分类错误!', '#ff6b6b');

      // Show explanation
      showExplanation(card.explanation, card.y);

      if (lives <= 0) {
        endGame();
      }
    }
  }

  function showExplanation(text, y) {
    const popup = document.createElement('div');
    popup.className = 'explanation-popup';
    popup.textContent = text;
    popup.style.bottom = (H - y - 160) + 'px';
    container.appendChild(popup);
    setTimeout(() => popup.remove(), 2500);
  }

  function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    
    drawBackground();
    
    // Draw cards (behind catcher)
    cards.forEach(card => {
      if (!card.caught || card.bounceBack) {
        ctx.globalAlpha = card.alpha;
        drawCard(card);
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      }
    });

    drawCatcher();

    // Draw cards being caught (on top of catcher)
    cards.forEach(card => {
      if (card.caught && !card.bounceBack) {
        ctx.globalAlpha = card.alpha;
        drawCard(card);
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      }
    });

    drawParticles();
    drawFloatingTexts();
    drawCombo();
    drawGraceIndicator();

    // Screen shake on wrong answer
    if (shakeAmount > 0) {
      shakeAmount *= 0.9;
    }
  }

  function gameLoop(timestamp) {
    if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
    const delta = timestamp - lastTime;
    lastTime = timestamp;

    if (!paused && gameActive) {
      update();
    }
    draw();

    requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
  }

  // ============ INPUT HANDLING ============
  let isDragging = false;

  function getCatcherX(clientX) {
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = clientX - rect.left;
    const cx = x - catcher.width / 2;
    return Math.max(0, Math.min(W - catcher.width, cx));
  }

  canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
    if (!gameActive || paused) return;
    isDragging = true;
    catcher.x = getCatcherX(e.clientX);
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    if (!isDragging) return;
    catcher.x = getCatcherX(e.clientX);
  });

  canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { isDragging = false; });
  canvas.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { isDragging = false; });

  // Touch support
  canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!gameActive || paused) return;
    isDragging = true;
    catcher.x = getCatcherX(e.touches[0].clientX);
  }, { passive: false });

  canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!isDragging) return;
    catcher.x = getCatcherX(e.touches[0].clientX);
  }, { passive: false });

  canvas.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    isDragging = false;
  }, { passive: false });

  // ============ GAME CONTROL ============
  window.startGame = function() {
    document.getElementById('start-screen').classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('gameover-screen').style.display = 'none';
    
    gameActive = true;
    paused = false;
    score = 0;
    streak = 0;
    bestStreak = 0;
    lives = 3;
    level = 1;
    correctCount = 0;
    totalAttempts = 0;
    cards = [];
    particles = [];
    floatingTexts = [];
    spawnTimer = 0;
    cardSpeed = 1.2;
    spawnInterval = 120;
    graceTimer = 180; // 3 seconds grace
    comboTimer = 0;
    lastTime = 0;

    catcher.width = Math.min(W * 0.45, 200);
    catcher.height = 50;
    catcher.x = (W - catcher.width) / 2;
    catcher.y = H - 110;

    document.getElementById('score-val').textContent = '0';
    document.getElementById('streak-val').textContent = '0';
    document.getElementById('level-val').textContent = '1';
    document.getElementById('lives-val').textContent = '❤️❤️❤️';

    // Spawn first card after a short delay
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (gameActive) cards.push(createCard());
    }, 1000);

  };

  window.togglePause = function() {
    paused = !paused;
    document.getElementById('pause-overlay').style.display = paused ? 'flex' : 'none';
    if (!paused) {
      lastTime = 0;
    }
  };

  window.restartGame = function() {
    document.getElementById('pause-overlay').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('gameover-screen').style.display = 'none';
    startGame();
  };

  function endGame() {
    gameActive = false;
    
    // Save best score
    if (score > bestScore) {
      bestScore = score;
      localStorage.setItem('de_game_best', bestScore.toString());
    }

    // Show game over
    setTimeout(() => {
      document.getElementById('final-score').textContent = score;
      document.getElementById('final-correct').textContent = correctCount;
      document.getElementById('final-streak').textContent = bestStreak;
      const accuracy = totalAttempts > 0 ? Math.round(correctCount / totalAttempts * 100) : 0;
      document.getElementById('final-accuracy').textContent = accuracy + '%';
      
      if (bestScore > 0) {
        document.getElementById('best-score-text').textContent = 
          `🏆 历史最高: ${bestScore} 分${score >= bestScore ? ' (新纪录!)' : ''}`;
      }
      
      document.getElementById('gameover-screen').style.display = 'flex';
    }, 500);
  }

  // Initialize catcher position
  catcher.width = Math.min(W * 0.45, 200);
  catcher.height = 50;
  catcher.x = (W - catcher.width) / 2;
  catcher.y = H - 110;

  // Start the render loop (game won't update until startGame is called)
  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 0;
    }

    #info {
      position: absolute;
      top: 16px;
      left: 16px;
      background: rgba(20, 20, 30, 0.88);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      max-width: 300px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      color: #ddd;
    }

    #info h2 {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: #fbbf24;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    #info p {
      font-size: 12.5px;
      color: #bbb;
      line-height: 1.6;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    #info .formula {
      background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.15);
      border-left: 3px solid #6366f1;
      padding: 6px 10px;

      border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0;

    #click-hint {
      position: absolute;
      top: 16px;
      right: 16px;
      background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15);
      border: 1px solid rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.3);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      padding: 12px 16px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      color: #fbbf24;
      font-size: 13px;
      max-width: 220px;
      text-align: center;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    #cursor-info {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 80px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      background: rgba(20, 20, 30, 0.85);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      padding: 8px 16px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      color: #ddd;
      font-size: 13px;
      pointer-events: none;
      display: none;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      #info { display: none; }
      #click-hint { 
        top: auto; 
        bottom: 72px;

        padding: 8px 12px;
        max-width: 180px;
      }
      #controls { padding: 8px 8px 16px; gap: 8px; }
      .control-group { min-width: 70px; }
      button { font-size: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; }

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const katexOptions = {
        delimiters: [
            {left: '\\[', right: '\\]', display: true},
            {left: '\\(', right: '\\)', display: false},
            {left: '$$', right: '$$', display: true},
            {left: '$', right: '$', display: false}
        ],
        throwOnError: false,
        strict: false,
        trust: true
    };

    let renderTimeout;
    function safeRender() {
        if (renderTimeout) clearTimeout(renderTimeout);
        renderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);
        }, 100);
    }

    renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);

    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        let shouldRender = false;
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
            if (mutation.target &&
                mutation.target.className &&
                typeof mutation.target.className === 'string' &&
                mutation.target.className.includes('katex')) {
                return;
            }
            shouldRender = true;
        });

        if (shouldRender) {
            safeRender();
        }
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        characterData: true
    });

    setInterval(() => {
        const text = document.body.innerText;
        if (text.includes('\\(') || text.includes('$$')) {
            safeRender();
        }
    }, 2000);
});
</script>

    <p>每条小箭头表示该点处解曲线的<b>斜率（slope）</b>。</p>

  <script type="importmap">{"imports":{"three":"data:text/javascript;base64,","three/addons/":"https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/","three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js":"data:text/javascript;base64,"}}</script>

  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';

    function checkWebGL() {
      try {
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        return !!(window.WebGLRenderingContext &&
          (canvas.getContext('webgl') || canvas.getContext('experimental-webgl')));
      } catch(e) {
        return false;
      }
    }

    async function initScene() {
      try {
        if (!checkWebGL()) {
          throw new Error('浏览器不支持 WebGL');
        }

        const container = document.getElementById('canvas-container');
        const width = container.clientWidth || window.innerWidth;
        const height = container.clientHeight || window.innerHeight;
        if (width === 0 || height === 0) throw new Error('容器尺寸为零');

        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x0a0a1a);
        scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(0x0a0a1a, 0.015);

        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(55, width / height, 0.1, 200);
        camera.position.set(8, 8, 12);

        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(width, height);
        renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
        renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
        container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
        controls.enableDamping = true;
        controls.dampingFactor = 0.06;
        controls.target.set(0, 0, 0);
        controls.minDistance = 3;
        controls.maxDistance = 40;

        // Lighting
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.5);
        scene.add(ambientLight);
        const hemiLight = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0x444444, 0.6);
        scene.add(hemiLight);
        const dirLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.2);
        dirLight.position.set(10, 15, 10);
        scene.add(dirLight);
        const pointLight = new THREE.PointLight(0x6366f1, 0.8, 30);
        pointLight.position.set(-5, 8, -5);
        scene.add(pointLight);

        const objects = {};
        let arrowScale = 1;
        let gridDensity = 8;
        let currentEquation = 'y_minus_1';
        let animationSpeed = 1;
        let isPaused = false;

        // --- Equation functions ---
        function getDyDt(equation, t, y) {
          switch(equation) {
            case 'y_minus_1': return y - 1;
            case 'y': return y;
            case 't_y': return t + y;
            case 'neg_y': return -y;
            default: return y - 1;
          }
        }

        function getEquationLabel(eq) {
          switch(eq) {
            case 'y_minus_1': return "dy/dt = y − 1";
            case 'y': return "dy/dt = y";
            case 't_y': return "dy/dt = t + y";
            case 'neg_y': return "dy/dt = −y";
            default: return "dy/dt = y − 1";
          }
        }

        function getEquilibriumY(eq) {
          switch(eq) {
            case 'y_minus_1': return 1;
            case 'y': return 0;
            case 'neg_y': return 0;
            case 't_y': return null; // no constant equilibrium
            default: return 1;
          }
        }

        function getEquilibriumLabel(eq) {
          switch(eq) {
            case 'y_minus_1': return "y = 1";
            case 'y': return "y = 0";
            case 'neg_y': return "y = 0";
            default: return "无平衡线";
          }
        }

        // --- Coordinate Axes ---
        function buildAxes() {
          const axesGroup = new THREE.Group();

          const axisLen = 10;
          const tickSize = 0.15;

          // t-axis (red) - horizontal
          const tAxis = new THREE.ArrowHelper(
            new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0), new THREE.Vector3(-axisLen, 0, 0),
            axisLen * 2, 0xff4444, 0.4, 0.25
          );
          axesGroup.add(tAxis);

          // y-axis (green) - vertical
          const yAxis = new THREE.ArrowHelper(
            new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), new THREE.Vector3(0, -2, 0),
            4, 0x44ff88, 0.35, 0.2
          );
          axesGroup.add(yAxis);

          // z-axis (blue) - depth
          const zAxis = new THREE.ArrowHelper(
            new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1), new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, -axisLen),
            axisLen * 2, 0x4488ff, 0.35, 0.2
          );
          axesGroup.add(zAxis);

          // Grid on t-y plane (z=0)
          const gridHelper = new THREE.GridHelper(14, 14, 0x333355, 0x1a1a3a);
          gridHelper.position.y = 0;
          axesGroup.add(gridHelper);

          // Tick marks and labels on t-axis
          for (let i = -7; i <= 7; i++) {
            if (i === 0) continue;
            const tickGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.05, 0.2, 0.05);
            const tickMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x666666 });
            const tick = new THREE.Mesh(tickGeo, tickMat);
            tick.position.set(i, 0, 0);
            axesGroup.add(tick);

            // Small number indicator spheres
            const numGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.08, 8, 8);
            const numMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xff6666 });
            const numDot = new THREE.Mesh(numGeo, numMat);
            numDot.position.set(i, -0.25, 0);
            axesGroup.add(numDot);
          }

          // Tick marks on y-axis
          for (let i = -4; i <= 4; i++) {
            if (i === 0) continue;
            const tickGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.2, 0.05, 0.05);
            const tickMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x666666 });
            const tick = new THREE.Mesh(tickGeo, tickMat);
            tick.position.set(0, i, 0);
            axesGroup.add(tick);

            const numGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.08, 8, 8);
            const numMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x66ff88 });
            const numDot = new THREE.Mesh(numGeo, numMat);
            numDot.position.set(-0.3, i, 0);
            axesGroup.add(numDot);
          }

          // Axis labels using small planes with canvas textures
          function createLabel(text, position, color) {
            const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
            canvas.width = 128;
            canvas.height = 64;
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            ctx.fillStyle = 'transparent';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 128, 64);
            ctx.font = 'bold 40px Arial';
            ctx.fillStyle = color;
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
            ctx.fillText(text, 64, 32);

            const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
            const planeGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.8, 0.4);
            const planeMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ 
              map: texture, transparent: true, side: THREE.DoubleSide, depthWrite: false 
            });
            const plane = new THREE.Mesh(planeGeo, planeMat);
            plane.position.copy(position);
            plane.lookAt(camera.position);
            plane.userData.isLabel = true;
            return plane;
          }

          const tLabel = createLabel('t (时间)', new THREE.Vector3(8, 0, 0), '#ff6666');
          axesGroup.add(tLabel);
          const yLabel = createLabel('y (数值)', new THREE.Vector3(0, 4.2, 0), '#66ff88');
          axesGroup.add(yLabel);
          const zLabel = createLabel('z', new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, -8), '#6688ff');
          axesGroup.add(zLabel);

          // Origin marker
          const originGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.15, 16, 16);
          const originMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffffff });
          const origin = new THREE.Mesh(originGeo, originMat);
          origin.position.set(0, 0, 0);
          axesGroup.add(origin);

          scene.add(axesGroup);
          return axesGroup;
        }

        objects.axesGroup = buildAxes();

        // --- Slope Vector Field ---
        function buildSlopeField() {
          const group = new THREE.Group();
          group.userData.arrows = [];

          const halfRange = 7;
          const spacing = halfRange * 2 / gridDensity;

          for (let i = 0; i <= gridDensity; i++) {
            for (let j = 0; j <= gridDensity; j++) {
              const t = -halfRange + i * spacing;
              const y = -halfRange + j * spacing;
              const dydt = getDyDt(currentEquation, t, y);

              // Normalize direction
              const mag = Math.sqrt(1 + dydt * dydt);
              const dx = 1 / mag;
              const dy = dydt / mag;

              // Color based on slope magnitude and sign
              const slopeNorm = Math.tanh(dydt);
              let color;
              if (slopeNorm > 0) {
                // Green-ish for positive slope
                color = new THREE.Color().setHSL(0.35, 0.8, 0.3 + 0.3 * Math.abs(slopeNorm));
              } else if (slopeNorm < 0) {
                // Red-ish for negative slope
                color = new THREE.Color().setHSL(0.02, 0.8, 0.3 + 0.3 * Math.abs(slopeNorm));
              } else {
                color = new THREE.Color(0x888888);
              }

              const arrowLen = 0.5 * arrowScale;
              const arrow = new THREE.ArrowHelper(
                new THREE.Vector3(dx, dy, 0).normalize(),
                new THREE.Vector3(t, y, 0),
                arrowLen,
                color,
                0.12 * arrowScale,
                0.08 * arrowScale
              );
              arrow.userData = { t, y, slope: dydt };
              group.add(arrow);
              group.userData.arrows.push(arrow);
            }
          }

          scene.add(group);
          return group;
        }

        objects.slopeField = buildSlopeField();

        // --- Equilibrium Line ---
        function buildEquilibriumLine() {
          const group = new THREE.Group();
          group.userData.visible = false;

          const eqY = getEquilibriumY(currentEquation);
          if (eqY !== null) {
            const points = [];
            for (let t = -8; t <= 8; t += 0.1) {
              points.push(new THREE.Vector3(t, eqY, 0.02));
            }
            const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(points);
            const mat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0xfbbf24, linewidth: 3 });
            const line = new THREE.Line(geo, mat);
            group.add(line);
            group.userData.visible = true;

            // Glow effect
            const glowMat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0xfbbf24, transparent: true, opacity: 0.3, linewidth: 1 });
            const glowLine = new THREE.Line(
              new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(points.map(p => p.clone().multiplyScalar(1.01).setZ(0.025))),
              glowMat
            );
            group.add(glowLine);

            // Label
            const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
            canvas.width = 256;
            canvas.height = 64;
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.15)';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 256, 64);
            ctx.font = 'bold 28px Arial';
            ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24';
            ctx.textAlign = 'center';
            ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
            ctx.fillText('平衡线 Equilibrium: y = ' + eqY, 128, 32);

            const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
            const labelGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(4, 1);
            const labelMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: texture, transparent: true, side: THREE.DoubleSide, depthWrite: false });
            const labelMesh = new THREE.Mesh(labelGeo, labelMat);
            labelMesh.position.set(4, eqY + 0.8, 0.05);
            labelMesh.lookAt(camera.position);
            labelMesh.userData.isLabel = true;
            group.add(labelMesh);
          }

          scene.add(group);
          return group;
        }

        objects.equilibriumLine = buildEquilibriumLine();

        // --- Integral Curves ---
        const integralCurves = [];

        function solveODE(t0, y0, steps = 400) {
          const dt = 0.02;
          const points = [{ t: t0, y: y0 }];
          let t = t0;
          let y = y0;

          // Forward
          for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
            const k1 = getDyDt(currentEquation, t, y);
            const k2 = getDyDt(currentEquation, t + dt/2, y + k1 * dt/2);
            const k3 = getDyDt(currentEquation, t + dt/2, y + k2 * dt/2);
            const k4 = getDyDt(currentEquation, t + dt, y + k3 * dt);
            y += (k1 + 2*k2 + 2*k3 + k4) * dt / 6;
            t += dt;
            if (Math.abs(y) > 15 || Math.abs(t) > 12) break;
            points.push({ t, y });
          }

          // Backward
          t = t0;
          y = y0;
          const backward = [];
          for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
            const k1 = getDyDt(currentEquation, t, y);
            const k2 = getDyDt(currentEquation, t - dt/2, y - k1 * dt/2);
            const k3 = getDyDt(currentEquation, t - dt/2, y - k2 * dt/2);
            const k4 = getDyDt(currentEquation, t - dt, y - k3 * dt);
            y -= (k1 + 2*k2 + 2*k3 + k4) * dt / 6;
            t -= dt;
            if (Math.abs(y) > 15 || Math.abs(t) > 12) break;
            backward.unshift({ t, y });
          }

          return [...backward.slice(1), ...points];
        }

        function addIntegralCurve(t0, y0, color) {
          const points = solveODE(t0, y0);
          const vecs = points.map(p => new THREE.Vector3(p.t, p.y, 0.04));
          
          // Curve line
          const curveGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(vecs);
          const curveMat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: color || 0x6366f1, linewidth: 2 });
          const curve = new THREE.Line(curveGeo, curveMat);
          scene.add(curve);

          // Glow
          const glowVecs = vecs.map(v => v.clone().setZ(0.05));
          const glowGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(glowVecs);
          const glowMat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: color || 0x6366f1, transparent: true, opacity: 0.25 });
          const glowCurve = new THREE.Line(glowGeo, glowMat);
          scene.add(glowCurve);

          // Starting point marker
          const markerGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.15, 16, 16);
          const markerMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ 
            color: color || 0x6366f1, emissive: color || 0x6366f1, emissiveIntensity: 0.5 
          });
          const marker = new THREE.Mesh(markerGeo, markerMat);
          marker.position.set(t0, y0, 0.06);
          scene.add(marker);

          const curveObj = { curve, glowCurve, marker, points };
          integralCurves.push(curveObj);
          objects['curve_' + integralCurves.length] = [curve, glowCurve, marker];

          return curveObj;
        }

        // Add default curves
        addIntegralCurve(0, 3, 0x818cf8);
        addIntegralCurve(0, -1, 0x34d399);
        addIntegralCurve(-3, 2, 0xfb923c);
        addIntegralCurve(3, -2, 0xf472b6);

        // --- Click interaction on the plane ---
        const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
        const mouse = new THREE.Vector2();
        const planeGeometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(30, 30);
        const planeMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ 
          color: 0x1a1a3a, transparent: true, opacity: 0.15, side: THREE.DoubleSide 
        });
        const interactionPlane = new THREE.Mesh(planeGeometry, planeMaterial);
        interactionPlane.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
        interactionPlane.position.y = 0;
        interactionPlane.userData.isInteractionPlane = true;
        scene.add(interactionPlane);

        // Color palette for curves
        const curveColors = [0x818cf8, 0x34d399, 0xfb923c, 0xf472b6, 0x60a5fa, 0xa78bfa, 0x38bdf8, 0xfbbf24];
        let colorIndex = 4;

        function onClick(event) {
          const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
          mouse.x = ((event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
          mouse.y = -((event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;

          raycaster.setFromCamera(mouse, camera);
          const intersects = raycaster.intersectObject(interactionPlane);

          if (intersects.length > 0) {
            const point = intersects[0].point;
            const t0 = point.x;
            const y0 = point.y;
            
            const color = curveColors[colorIndex % curveColors.length];
            colorIndex++;
            addIntegralCurve(t0, y0, color);

            // Flash effect at click point
            const flashGeo = new THREE.RingGeometry(0.1, 0.5, 32);
            const flashMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color, transparent: true, opacity: 0.8, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
            const flash = new THREE.Mesh(flashGeo, flashMat);
            flash.position.set(t0, y0, 0.07);
            scene.add(flash);
            setTimeout(() => {
              scene.remove(flash);
              flashGeo.dispose();
              flashMat.dispose();
            }, 500);
          }
        }

        renderer.domElement.addEventListener('click', onClick);

        // Hover cursor info
        const cursorInfo = document.getElementById('cursor-info');
        renderer.domElement.addEventListener('mousemove', (event) => {
          const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
          mouse.x = ((event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
          mouse.y = -((event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;

          raycaster.setFromCamera(mouse, camera);
          const intersects = raycaster.intersectObject(interactionPlane);

          if (intersects.length > 0) {
            const point = intersects[0].point;
            const t = point.x.toFixed(2);
            const y = point.y.toFixed(2);
            const slope = getDyDt(currentEquation, point.x, point.y).toFixed(3);
            cursorInfo.style.display = 'block';
            cursorInfo.textContent = `t = ${t}, y = ${y}  →  dy/dt = ${slope}`;
          } else {
            cursorInfo.style.display = 'none';
          }
        });

        // --- Stars background ---
        const starsGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
        const starPositions = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < 500; i++) {
          starPositions.push(
            (Math.random() - 0.5) * 100,
            (Math.random() - 0.5) * 100,
            (Math.random() - 0.5) * 100
          );
        }
        starsGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(starPositions, 3));
        const starsMat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({ color: 0x444466, size: 0.1 });
        const stars = new THREE.Points(starsGeo, starsMat);
        scene.add(stars);

        // --- Controls ---
        document.getElementById('equation-select').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
          currentEquation = e.target.value;
          rebuildScene();
          // Update info panel
          document.querySelector('#info .formula').textContent = getEquationLabel(currentEquation);
          const eqLabel = getEquilibriumLabel(currentEquation);
          if (eqLabel !== "无平衡线") {
            document.getElementById('info').querySelector('p:last-child').innerHTML =
              `🎯 <b style="color:#fbbf24">平衡线：</b>${eqLabel}（黄色线，斜率为零）`;
          } else {
            document.getElementById('info').querySelector('p:last-child').innerHTML =
              `⚠️ 此方程无恒定平衡线`;
          }
        });

        document.getElementById('arrow-scale-slider').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
          arrowScale = parseFloat(e.target.value);
          rebuildSlopeField();
        });

        document.getElementById('grid-density-slider').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
          gridDensity = parseInt(e.target.value);
          rebuildSlopeField();
        });

        document.getElementById('zoom-in-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
          const direction = new THREE.Vector3();
          camera.getWorldDirection(direction);
          camera.position.addScaledVector(direction, 2);
        });

        document.getElementById('zoom-out-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
          const direction = new THREE.Vector3();
          camera.getWorldDirection(direction);
          camera.position.addScaledVector(direction, -2);
        });

        document.getElementById('reset-view-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
          camera.position.set(8, 8, 12);
          controls.target.set(0, 0, 0);
          controls.update();
        });

        document.getElementById('clear-curves-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
          integralCurves.forEach(c => {
            scene.remove(c.curve);
            scene.remove(c.glowCurve);
            scene.remove(c.marker);
            c.curve.geometry.dispose();
            c.curve.material.dispose();
            c.glowCurve.geometry.dispose();
            c.glowCurve.material.dispose();
            c.marker.geometry.dispose();
            c.marker.material.dispose();
          });
          integralCurves.length = 0;
          colorIndex = 0;
          // Re-add defaults
          addIntegralCurve(0, 3, 0x818cf8);
          addIntegralCurve(0, -1, 0x34d399);
          addIntegralCurve(-3, 2, 0xfb923c);
          addIntegralCurve(3, -2, 0xf472b6);
          colorIndex = 4;
        });

        function rebuildSlopeField() {
          scene.remove(objects.slopeField);
          objects.slopeField.userData.arrows.forEach(a => {
            a.dispose && a.dispose();
          });
          objects.slopeField = buildSlopeField();
        }

        function rebuildScene() {
          rebuildSlopeField();
          scene.remove(objects.equilibriumLine);
          objects.equilibriumLine = buildEquilibriumLine();
          
          // Rebuild integral curves
          integralCurves.forEach(c => {
            scene.remove(c.curve);
            scene.remove(c.glowCurve);
            scene.remove(c.marker);
            c.curve.geometry.dispose();
            c.curve.material.dispose();
            c.glowCurve.geometry.dispose();
            c.glowCurve.material.dispose();
            c.marker.geometry.dispose();
            c.marker.material.dispose();
          });
          integralCurves.length = 0;
          colorIndex = 0;
          addIntegralCurve(0, 3, 0x818cf8);
          addIntegralCurve(0, -1, 0x34d399);
          addIntegralCurve(-3, 2, 0xfb923c);
          addIntegralCurve(3, -2, 0xf472b6);
          colorIndex = 4;
        }

        // --- Animate labels to face camera ---
        function updateLabels() {
          scene.traverse(obj => {
            if (obj.userData.isLabel) {
              obj.lookAt(camera.position);
            }
          });
        }

        // --- Animation loop ---
        let time = 0;
        function animate() {
          requestAnimationFrame(animate);
          if (!isPaused) {
            time += 0.016 * animationSpeed;
          }
          controls.update();
          updateLabels();
          
          // Subtle pulse on integral curve markers
          integralCurves.forEach(c => {
            if (c.marker) {
              const pulse = 1 + 0.15 * Math.sin(time * 3);
              c.marker.scale.setScalar(pulse);
            }
          });

          // Gentle star rotation
          stars.rotation.y = time * 0.005;

          renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }
        animate();

        // --- Resize ---
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
          const newWidth = container.clientWidth || window.innerWidth;
          const newHeight = container.clientHeight || window.innerHeight;
          camera.aspect = newWidth / newHeight;
          camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
          renderer.setSize(newWidth, newHeight);
        });

        // --- Teacher Actions ---
        window.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
          const { action, payload } = event.data || {};

          switch (action) {
            case 'SET_WIDGET_STATE': {
              if (payload.cameraPosition) {
                camera.position.set(...payload.cameraPosition);
              }
              if (payload.cameraTarget) {
                controls.target.set(...payload.cameraTarget);
              }
              if (payload.equation) {
                currentEquation = payload.equation;
                document.getElementById('equation-select').value = payload.equation;
                rebuildScene();
              }
              break;
            }

            case 'HIGHLIGHT_ELEMENT': {
              const { elementId, highlight } = payload;
              if (elementId === 'equilibrium_line' && objects.equilibriumLine) {
                objects.equilibriumLine.traverse(child => {
                  if (child.isLine) {
                    child.material.opacity = highlight ? 1.0 : 0.3;
                    child.material.color.set(highlight ? 0xfbbf24 : 0x664400);
                  }
                });
              }
              if (elementId && elementId.startsWith('curve_') && objects[elementId]) {
                objects[elementId].forEach(mesh => {
                  if (mesh.isLine) {
                    mesh.material.opacity = highlight ? 1.0 : 0.2;
                  }
                  if (mesh.isMesh) {
                    mesh.material.emissiveIntensity = highlight ? 1.0 : 0.3;
                  }
                });
              }
              if (elementId === 'slope_field' && objects.slopeField) {
                objects.slopeField.visible = !highlight; // toggle visibility
              }
              break;
            }

            case 'ANNOTATE_ELEMENT': {
              const { elementId, text } = payload;
              // Create a floating annotation
              const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
              canvas.width = 512;
              canvas.height = 128;
              const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
              ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.2)';
              ctx.strokeStyle = '#6366f1';
              ctx.lineWidth = 2;
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.roundRect(0, 0, 512, 128, 20);
              ctx.fill();
              ctx.stroke();
              ctx.font = '24px "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif';
              ctx.fillStyle = '#ddd';
              ctx.textAlign = 'center';
              ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
              
              // Word wrap
              const words = text.split('');
              let lines = [];
              let line = '';
              for (const char of words) {
                const test = line + char;
                if (ctx.measureText(test).width > 460 && line) {
                  lines.push(line);
                  line = char;
                } else {
                  line = test;
                }
              }
              lines.push(line);
              
              lines.forEach((l, i) => {
                ctx.fillText(l, 256, 40 + i * 30);
              });

              const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
              const annGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(5, 1.25);
              const annMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: texture, transparent: true, side: THREE.DoubleSide, depthWrite: false });
              const annotation = new THREE.Mesh(annGeo, annMat);
              annotation.position.set(0, 4, 0.1);
              annotation.userData.isLabel = true;
              scene.add(annotation);
              break;
            }

            case 'ADD_INTEGRAL_CURVE': {
              const { t, y, color } = payload;
              addIntegralCurve(t || 0, y || 0, color || 0x6366f1);
              break;
            }

            case 'TOGGLE_PAUSE': {
              isPaused = !isPaused;
              break;
            }
          }
        });

        // Hide loading
        document.getElementById('loading').style.display = 'none';

      } catch (error) {
        console.error('初始化失败:', error);
        document.getElementById('loading').innerHTML =
          `<div style="text-align:center;color:#ff6b6b;">
            <div style="font-size:24px;margin-bottom:16px;">⚠️</div>
            3D 场景加载失败<br>
            <small style="color:#888;">${error.message}</small><br>
            <button onclick="location.reload()" style="margin-top:16px;padding:8px 16px;background:#6366f1;color:white;border:none;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;">重试</button>
          </div>`;
      }
    }

    initScene();
  </script>

actions.content: 观察同一水平线上的箭头：它们都指向同一方向，说明变化率只依赖于y的值。

actions.text: 没错，这正是我们刚刚学到的关键点。对于 y' = y - 1 这个方程，变化率只取决于 y。现在，你能帮大家用你的空间直觉，找到箭头完全消失、斜率为零的那条线在哪里吗？

actions.text: 让我们拉近看看。当你把视角旋转到贴近这个平面时，你会发现有一条水平线非常特别。对，就是 y = 1 这条线。看，线上的箭头都塌缩成了点，意味着这里没有任何变化。这就是我们所说的平衡线（Equilibrium Line）。现在，试着点击这条平衡线上下不同的区域，看看解曲线（Integral Curve）会有什么不同的表现。

elements.content: 误解：避免机械套用
核心：化为可积分形式
目标：识别方程类型

actions.text: 本场景聚焦“可分离变量与一阶线性方程”。亲身体验了平衡线和变化率的方向。现在，我们把这种直观感受收回来，聚焦到两类非常基础、但威力强大的微分方程上——可分离变量方程与一阶线性方程。
我们先看左边这个，形如 dy/dx 等于 f(x) 乘以 g(y) 的方程。它的核心直觉是什么？看，x 和 y 是'拧'在一起的，但它们是乘在一起，而不是加在一起。这就给了我们一个机会，可以把含 x 的项和含 y 的项，像整理行李一样，分别放在等号两边。
于是我们得到了这个形式：把 g(y) 除到 dy 一边，f(x) 留在 dx 一边。这个过程叫'分离变量'。它的目标非常明确，就是把一个关于变化率的等式，转化为一个可以直接两边积分的等式。这就是我们页面上强调的核心：将复杂的方程转化为可直接积分的形式。
好，再看右边这个，形如 dy/dx 加上 P(x)y 等于 Q(x) 的一阶线性方程。它的结构不同了，y 和 y 的导数被'加'在了一起。这时候，分离变量的方法行不通了，因为它们是和的关系，不是积的关系。
我们怎么办？我们需要一个'放大镜'，来把左边这两项'合并'成一个整体的导数。这个放大镜就是积分因子 μ。看，乘以 μ 之后，左边神奇地变成了 μy 这个整体的导数。我们的目标，从分离变量，变成了'构造整体导数'，然后再积分。
要特别注意，大家。我们不是在机械地背公式。无论是分离变量还是找积分因子，每一步都必须问自己：我是在保持变化率的对应关系吗？我们不是在随意地移项，而是在寻找整体变化率。一旦你理解了这一点，这两类方程就从两个割裂的技巧，变成了同一个核心思想的不同体现。

actions.prompt: 请大家试着用自己的话，说说看'分离变量'和'构造整体导数'这两种转化直觉，有什么本质上的不同？你觉得哪一种更难把握？为什么？

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>可分离变量与一阶线性方程</title>
<style>
  *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
  :root{
    --bg:#0f172a;--panel:#1e293b;--card:#334155;--accent:#8b5cf6;
    --accent2:#06b6d4;--success:#22c55e;--warning:#f59e0b;--danger:#ef4444;
    --text:#e2e8f0;--textDim:#94a3b8;--border:#475569;
  }
  body{
    font-family:'Segoe UI',system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;
    background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);overflow-x:hidden;
    min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  }
  .app-header{
    text-align:center;padding:12px 16px 8px;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1e293b,#0f172a);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .app-header h1{font-size:1.2rem;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:2px}
  .app-header p{font-size:.75rem;color:var(--textDim)}
  .main-layout{
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1;
    min-height:0;
  }
  .control-panel{
    width:100%;background:var(--panel);padding:12px;
    overflow-y:auto;max-height:45vh;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
    transition:max-height .3s;
  }
  .control-panel.collapsed{max-height:44px;overflow:hidden}
  .toggle-btn{
    display:none;width:100%;padding:8px;background:var(--card);
    border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;color:var(--text);
    font-size:.85rem;cursor:pointer;margin-top:8px;
  }
  @media(min-width:768px){
    .main-layout{flex-direction:row}
    .control-panel{
      width:320px;min-width:280px;max-height:none;
      border-bottom:none;border-right:1px solid var(--border);
      overflow-y:auto;flex-shrink:0;
    }
    .toggle-btn{display:none!important}
  }
  .ctrl-group{margin-bottom:14px}
  .ctrl-group label{
    display:block;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--textDim);
    margin-bottom:4px;font-weight:600;
  }
  .ctrl-group .unit{color:var(--accent2);font-size:.7rem}
  input[type=range]{
    width:100%;height:36px;-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;
    background:var(--card);border-radius:8px;outline:none;cursor:pointer;
  }
  input[type=range]::-webkit-slider-thumb{
    -webkit-appearance:none;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--accent);border:2px solid var(--text);cursor:pointer;
  }
  input[type=range]::-moz-range-thumb{
    width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--accent);border:2px solid var(--text);cursor:pointer;
  }
  .val-display{
    text-align:right;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--accent);
    font-family:'Courier New',monospace;font-weight:700;
  }
  .eq-type-selector{
    display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:14px;
  }
  .eq-type-btn{
    flex:1;padding:10px 6px;border-radius:10px;border:2px solid var(--border);
    background:var(--card);color:var(--text);font-size:.78rem;
    cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;text-align:center;font-weight:600;
    min-height:44px;
  }
  .eq-type-btn.active{
    border-color:var(--accent);background:rgba(139,92,246,.2);
    color:var(--accent);
  }
  .eq-type-btn:hover{border-color:var(--accent)}
  .steps-area{margin-bottom:14px}
  .step-item{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 10px;
    margin-bottom:6px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--card);
    border:2px solid transparent;transition:all .3s;
  }
  .step-item.active{border-color:var(--accent);background:rgba(139,92,246,.15)}
  .step-item.completed{border-color:var(--success);background:rgba(34,197,94,.1)}
  .step-item.locked{opacity:.45;pointer-events:none}
  .step-num{
    width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    font-size:.8rem;font-weight:700;flex-shrink:0;
    background:var(--panel);color:var(--textDim);
  }
  .step-item.active .step-num{background:var(--accent);color:#fff}
  .step-item.completed .step-num{background:var(--success);color:#fff}
  .step-label{font-size:.78rem;flex:1}
  .step-label small{color:var(--textDim);font-size:.7rem}
  .step-action{
    padding:6px 14px;border-radius:8px;border:none;
    background:var(--accent);color:#fff;font-size:.75rem;
    cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;min-height:36px;min-width:60px;
  }
  .step-action:disabled{background:var(--border);color:var(--textDim);cursor:not-allowed}

    width:100%;height:8px;background:var(--card);border-radius:4px;
    margin:10px 0 14px;overflow:hidden;
  }
  .progress-bar-fill{

    background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--accent),var(--accent2));

  .preset-btn{
    padding:8px 12px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--border);
    background:var(--card);color:var(--text);font-size:.72rem;
    cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;min-height:36px;flex:1;
    text-align:center;font-weight:500;

  }
  .stats-overlay{
    position:absolute;top:12px;left:12px;
    background:rgba(15,23,42,.85);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
    padding:8px 12px;border-radius:10px;font-size:.72rem;
    border:1px solid var(--border);pointer-events:none;
  }
  .stats-overlay div{margin-bottom:3px}
  .stats-overlay .val{color:var(--accent);font-family:'Courier New',monospace;font-weight:700}
  .stats-overlay .label{color:var(--textDim)}
  .hint-box{
    position:absolute;bottom:12px;left:12px;right:12px;
    background:rgba(15,23,42,.9);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
    padding:10px 14px;border-radius:10px;font-size:.75rem;
    border:1px solid var(--accent);color:var(--accent);
    text-align:center;transition:opacity .3s;
  }
  .state-indicator{
    display:inline-block;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;
    margin-right:4px;vertical-align:middle;
  }
  .state-indicator.running{background:var(--success);animation:blink 1s infinite}
  .state-indicator.paused{background:var(--warning)}
  .state-indicator.ended{background:var(--danger)}
  .state-indicator.idle{background:var(--textDim)}
  @keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.3}}
  .equation-display{
    text-align:center;padding:6px 12px;margin-bottom:10px;
    background:var(--card);border-radius:10px;
    font-size:.9rem;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;
    color:var(--accent2);border:1px solid var(--border);
    word-break:break-all;
  }
  .evidence-box{
    margin-top:10px;padding:8px 10px;background:var(--card);
    border-radius:8px;font-size:.7rem;color:var(--textDim);
    border:1px dashed var(--border);
  }
  .evidence-box .ev-label{color:var(--accent);font-weight:700}
  @keyframes pulse-highlight{
    0%,100%{outline-color:rgba(139,92,246,.8)}
    50%{outline-color:rgba(139,92,246,.4)}
  }
  @keyframes fadeIn{
    from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px)}

  .teacher-annotation{
    position:fixed;background:rgba(139,92,246,.95);color:#fff;
    padding:8px 12px;border-radius:8px;font-size:14px;z-index:1000;
    animation:fadeIn .3s;
  }
</style>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const katexOptions = {
        delimiters: [
            {left: '\\[', right: '\\]', display: true},
            {left: '\\(', right: '\\)', display: false},
            {left: '$$', right: '$$', display: true},
            {left: '$', right: '$', display: false}
        ],
        throwOnError: false,
        strict: false,
        trust: true
    };

    let renderTimeout;
    function safeRender() {
        if (renderTimeout) clearTimeout(renderTimeout);
        renderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);
        }, 100);
    }

    renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);

    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        let shouldRender = false;
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
            if (mutation.target &&
                mutation.target.className &&
                typeof mutation.target.className === 'string' &&
                mutation.target.className.includes('katex')) {
                return;
            }
            shouldRender = true;
        });

        if (shouldRender) {
            safeRender();
        }
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        characterData: true
    });

    setInterval(() => {
        const text = document.body.innerText;
        if (text.includes('\\(') || text.includes('$$')) {
            safeRender();
        }
    }, 2000);
});
</script>
