<body>

<header class="app-header">
  <h1>可分离变量与一阶线性方程 <small style="font-size:.65rem;color:var(--textDim)">Separable Variables & 1st-Order Linear ODE</small></h1>
  <p>通过交互式操作分离变量或应用积分因子法求解微分方程</p>
</header>

<script type="application/json" id="widget-config">
{
  "type": "simulation",
  "concept": "separable_and_linear_ode",
  "description": "交互式求解可分离变量方程与一阶线性微分方程。学生通过选择方程类型、调整参数，逐步完成变量分离或积分因子法，观察解曲线的实时变化。",
  "variables": [
    { "name": "equation_type", "label": "方程类型", "min": 0, "max": 1, "default": 0, "unit": "" },
    { "name": "coefficient_k", "label": "系数 k", "min": -3, "max": 3, "default": 1, "unit": "" },
    { "name": "initial_condition", "label": "初始条件 y(0)", "min": -5, "max": 5, "default": 1, "unit": "" },
    { "name": "integration_step_hint", "label": "积分步骤提示", "min": 0, "max": 1, "default": 1, "unit": "" }
  ],
  "presets": [
    { "name": "经典可分离: y'=y", "variables": { "equation_type": 0, "coefficient_k": 1, "initial_condition": 1, "integration_step_hint": 1 } },
    { "name": "冷却定律: y'=-0.5y", "variables": { "equation_type": 0, "coefficient_k": -0.5, "initial_condition": 5, "integration_step_hint": 1 } },
    { "name": "线性方程: y'+2y=1", "variables": { "equation_type": 1, "coefficient_k": 2, "initial_condition": 0, "integration_step_hint": 1 } },
    { "name": "增长模型: y'=3y", "variables": { "equation_type": 0, "coefficient_k": 3, "initial_condition": 1, "integration_step_hint": 0 } }
  ]
}
</script>

<div class="main-layout">
  <aside class="control-panel" id="controls">
    <div class="equation-display" id="eq-display">y' = y</div>

    <div class="ctrl-group">
      <label>方程类型 Equation Type</label>
      <div class="eq-type-selector">
        <button class="eq-type-btn active" data-type="0" onclick="setEqType(0)">
          可分离变量<br><small>Separable</small>
        </button>
        <button class="eq-type-btn" data-type="1" onclick="setEqType(1)">
          一阶线性<br><small>1st-Order Linear</small>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="ctrl-group">
      <label>系数 Coefficient k <span class="unit" id="k-display">1.0</span></label>
      <input type="range" id="coefficient_k-slider" data-var="coefficient_k" min="-3" max="3" step="0.1" value="1">
      <div class="val-display">k = <span id="coefficient_k-display">1.0</span></div>
    </div>

    <div class="ctrl-group">
      <label>初始条件 Initial Condition y(0) <span class="unit" id="ic-display">1.0</span></label>
      <input type="range" id="initial_condition-slider" data-var="initial_condition" min="-5" max="5" step="0.1" value="1">
      <div class="val-display">y(0) = <span id="initial_condition-display">1.0</span></div>
    </div>

    <div class="ctrl-group">
      <label>积分步骤提示 Hint</label>
      <input type="range" id="integration_step_hint-slider" data-var="integration_step_hint" min="0" max="1" step="1" value="1">
      <div class="val-display"><span id="integration_step_hint-display">显示</span></div>
    </div>

    <label style="font-size:.8rem;color:var(--textDim);font-weight:600;display:block;margin-bottom:6px">求解步骤 Solution Steps</label>
    <div class="steps-area" id="steps-area"></div>

    <div class="progress-bar-wrap">
      <div class="progress-bar-fill" id="progress-fill" style="width:0%"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="presets-area" id="presets-area"></div>

    <button class="toggle-btn" onclick="toggleControls()">收起控制面板 ▲</button>
  </aside>

  <div class="canvas-container">
    <canvas id="canvas"></canvas>
    <div class="stats-overlay" id="stats-overlay">
      <div><span class="label">方程 Equation:</span> <span class="val" id="stat-eq">y' = y</span></div>
      <div><span class="label">当前步 Step:</span> <span class="val" id="stat-step">0/3</span></div>
      <div><span class="label">状态 State:</span> <span class="state-indicator idle" id="state-dot"></span><span class="val" id="stat-state">就绪</span></div>
      <div><span class="label">用时 Time:</span> <span class="val" id="stat-time">0.0s</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="hint-box" id="hint-box" style="opacity:0">💡 提示：点击步骤按钮逐步完成求解</div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function(){
  // ===== State =====
  const state = {
    equationType: 0, // 0=separable, 1=linear
    coefficient_k: 1.0,
    initialCondition: 1.0,
    showHint: 1,
    currentStep: 0,
    totalSteps: 3,
    running: false,
    ended: false,
    paused: false,
    animTime: 0,
    startTime: null,
    curveAnim: 0, // 0-1 for curve drawing animation
    curvePoints: [],
    evidence: { stepsCompleted: [], stepTimes: [], accuracy: 0 }
  };

  const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let W, H, dpr;

  // ===== Resize =====
  function resize() {
    const container = canvas.parentElement;
    const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
    dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    W = rect.width;
    H = rect.height;
    canvas.width = W * dpr;
    canvas.height = H * dpr;
    canvas.style.width = W + 'px';
    canvas.style.height = H + 'px';
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    draw();
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  const ro = new ResizeObserver(resize);
  ro.observe(canvas.parentElement);

  // ===== Equation Display =====
  function updateEquationDisplay() {
    const el = document.getElementById('eq-display');
    const k = state.coefficient_k;
    const kStr = Math.abs(k).toFixed(1);
    if (state.equationType === 0) {
      if (k >= 0) el.textContent = `y' = ${kStr === '1.0' ? '' : kStr}y`;
      else el.textContent = `y' = -${kStr === '1.0' ? '' : kStr}y`;
    } else {
      const p = k;
      el.textContent = `y' + ${Math.abs(p).toFixed(1)}y = 1`;
    }
    document.getElementById('stat-eq').textContent = el.textContent;
  }

  // ===== Steps =====
  function buildSteps() {
    const area = document.getElementById('steps-area');
    const k = state.coefficient_k;
    const kStr = k.toFixed(1);
    let steps;
    if (state.equationType === 0) {
      steps = [
        { label: '分离变量<br><small>dy/y = k·dx</small>', action: '分离' },
        { label: '两边积分<br><small>∫(1/y)dy = ∫k dx</small>', action: '积分' },
        { label: '代入初值<br><small>y(0) = y₀ 求 C</small>', action: '求解' }
      ];
    } else {
      const pStr = Math.abs(k).toFixed(1);
      steps = [
        { label: '求积分因子<br><small>μ = e<sup>∫p dx</sup></small>', action: '求因子' },
        { label: '两边乘 μ<br><small>乘积分因子整理</small>', action: '乘因子' },
        { label: '识别全导数<br><small>(\u03bcy)\u2019 = \u03bc\u00b7q</small>', action: '积分' }
      ];
    }
    area.innerHTML = '';
    state.totalSteps = steps.length;
    for (let i = 0; i < steps.length; i++) {
      const div = document.createElement('div');
      div.className = 'step-item';
      div.id = 'step-' + i;
      if (i < state.currentStep) div.classList.add('completed');
      else if (i === state.currentStep) div.classList.add('active');
      else div.classList.add('locked');

      div.innerHTML = `
        <div class="step-num">${i < state.currentStep ? '✓' : (i + 1)}</div>
        <div class="step-label">${steps[i].label}</div>
        <button class="step-action" id="step-btn-${i}" ${i !== state.currentStep ? 'disabled' : ''}
          onclick="window.doStep(${i})">${i < state.currentStep ? '已完成' : steps[i].action}</button>
      `;
      area.appendChild(div);
    }
    updateProgress();
  }

  function updateProgress() {
    const pct = (state.currentStep / state.totalSteps) * 100;
    document.getElementById('progress-fill').style.width = pct + '%';
    document.getElementById('stat-step').textContent = state.currentStep + '/' + state.totalSteps;
  }

  // ===== Do Step =====
  window.doStep = function(idx) {
    if (idx !== state.currentStep) return;
    if (state.ended) return;

    if (!state.startTime) state.startTime = Date.now();
    state.evidence.stepTimes.push(Date.now() - state.startTime);

    state.currentStep = idx + 1;
    state.evidence.stepsCompleted.push(idx);

    // Animate curve as steps progress
    state.curveAnim = Math.min(1, state.currentStep / state.totalSteps);

    buildSteps();
    computeSolutionCurve();
    updateButton();

    if (state.currentStep >= state.totalSteps) {
      state.ended = true;
      state.evidence.accuracy = 1.0;
      updateStateDisplay();
      showHint('🎉 求解完成！解曲线已完整显示');
    }

    draw();
  };

  // ===== Solution Curve =====
  function computeSolutionCurve() {
    const k = state.coefficient_k;
    const y0 = state.initialCondition;
    state.curvePoints = [];

    const xMin = -3, xMax = 3, n = 300;
    for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
      const x = xMin + (xMax - xMin) * i / n;
      let y;
      if (state.equationType === 0) {
        y = y0 * Math.exp(k * x);
      } else {
        // y' + k*y = 1, y(0)=y0
        // solution: y = (1/k) + (y0 - 1/k)*exp(-k*x)
        if (Math.abs(k) < 1e-6) {
          y = y0 + x; // y' = 1
        } else {
          y = (1 / k) + (y0 - 1 / k) * Math.exp(-k * x);
        }
      }
      if (Math.abs(y) > 20) y = y * 20 / Math.abs(y); // clamp
      state.curvePoints.push({ x, y });
    }
  }

  // ===== Drawing =====
  function draw() {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Background
    const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
    bg.addColorStop(0, '#1e293b');
    bg.addColorStop(1, '#0f172a');
    ctx.fillStyle = bg;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    // Graph area
    const margin = { top: 30, bottom: 50, left: 50, right: 20 };
    const gw = W - margin.left - margin.right;
    const gh = H - margin.top - margin.bottom;

    // Grid
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(71,85,105,.3)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    const xRange = 6, yRange = 10;
    for (let x = -3; x <= 3; x++) {
      const px = margin.left + (x + 3) / 6 * gw;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(px, margin.top); ctx.lineTo(px, margin.top + gh); ctx.stroke();
    }
    for (let y = -5; y <= 5; y++) {
      const py = margin.top + (5 - y) / 10 * gh;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(margin.left, py); ctx.lineTo(margin.left + gw, py); ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Axes
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(148,163,184,.6)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    // x-axis
    const xAxisY = margin.top + (5 - 0) / 10 * gh;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(margin.left, xAxisY); ctx.lineTo(margin.left + gw, xAxisY); ctx.stroke();
    // y-axis
    const yAxisX = margin.left + (0 + 3) / 6 * gw;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(yAxisX, margin.top); ctx.lineTo(yAxisX, margin.top + gh); ctx.stroke();

    // Axis labels
    ctx.fillStyle = '#94a3b8';
    ctx.font = '11px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    for (let x = -3; x <= 3; x++) {
      if (x === 0) continue;
      const px = margin.left + (x + 3) / 6 * gw;
      ctx.fillText(x, px, xAxisY + 16);
    }
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    for (let y = -5; y <= 5; y += 1) {
      if (y === 0) continue;
      const py = margin.top + (5 - y) / 10 * gh;
      ctx.fillText(y, yAxisX - 6, py + 4);
    }
    ctx.fillText('x', margin.left + gw + 12, xAxisY + 4);
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText('y', yAxisX + 6, margin.top - 6);

    // Draw solution curve
    if (state.curvePoints.length > 0 && state.curveAnim > 0) {
      const visibleCount = Math.floor(state.curvePoints.length * state.curveAnim);
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#8b5cf6';
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      let started = false;
      for (let i = 0; i < visibleCount; i++) {
        const pt = state.curvePoints[i];
        const px = margin.left + (pt.x + 3) / 6 * gw;
        const py = margin.top + (5 - pt.y) / 10 * gh;
        if (!started) { ctx.moveTo(px, py); started = true; }
        else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
      }
      ctx.stroke();

      // Glow effect
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(139,92,246,.3)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 8;
      ctx.beginPath();
      started = false;
      for (let i = 0; i < visibleCount; i++) {
        const pt = state.curvePoints[i];
        const px = margin.left + (pt.x + 3) / 6 * gw;
        const py = margin.top + (5 - pt.y) / 10 * gh;
        if (!started) { ctx.moveTo(px, py); started = true; }
        else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
      }
      ctx.stroke();

      // Draw initial condition point
      if (state.currentStep >= 0) {
        const icPt = state.curvePoints[0];
        if (icPt) {
          const px = margin.left + (icPt.x + 3) / 6 * gw;
          const py = margin.top + (5 - icPt.y) / 10 * gh;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(px, py, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#22c55e';
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.strokeStyle = '#fff';
          ctx.lineWidth = 2;
          ctx.stroke();
          ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
          ctx.font = 'bold 11px sans-serif';
          ctx.textAlign = 'left';
          ctx.fillText(`(${icPt.x.toFixed(1)}, ${icPt.y.toFixed(1)})`, px + 10, py - 6);
        }
      }

      // Moving point on curve
      if (state.running && !state.ended) {
        const t = (Date.now() % 3000) / 3000;
        const idx = Math.floor(t * visibleCount);
        if (idx < visibleCount) {
          const pt = state.curvePoints[idx];
          const px = margin.left + (pt.x + 3) / 6 * gw;
          const py = margin.top + (5 - pt.y) / 10 * gh;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(px, py, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(6,182,212,.6)';
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(px, py, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#06b6d4';
          ctx.fill();
        }
      }
    }

    // Draw step equation on canvas
    drawStepEquation(margin, gw, gh);

    // State indicator
    drawStateBadge();
  }

  function drawStepEquation(margin, gw, gh) {
    const k = state.coefficient_k;
    const kStr = Math.abs(k).toFixed(1);
    const kSign = k >= 0 ? '' : '-';
    const y0 = state.initialCondition;
    const y0Str = y0.toFixed(1);

    ctx.font = 'bold 13px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    const centerX = margin.left + gw / 2;
    const bottomY = margin.top + gh - 8;

    let eqText;
    if (state.equationType === 0) {
      if (state.currentStep >= 1) {
        const C = Math.log(Math.abs(y0)) || '0';
        if (state.currentStep >= 2) {
          eqText = `y = ${y0Str}·e${kSign}${kStr === '1.0' ? '' : kStr}x`;
          ctx.fillStyle = '#22c55e';
        } else {
          eqText = `ln|y| = ${kSign}${kStr === '1.0' ? '' : kStr}x + C`;
          ctx.fillStyle = '#f59e0b';
        }
      } else {
        eqText = `dy/y = ${kSign}${kStr === '1.0' ? '' : kStr}dx`;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#06b6d4';
      }
    } else {
      const pStr = Math.abs(k).toFixed(1);
      if (state.currentStep >= 1) {
        if (state.currentStep >= 2) {
          if (Math.abs(k) < 1e-6) {
            eqText = `y = ${y0Str} + x`;
          } else {
            const eqY = (1/k) + (y0 - 1/k);
            eqText = `y = ${(1/k).toFixed(1)} + (${eqY.toFixed(1)})·e^{-${pStr}x}`;
          }
          ctx.fillStyle = '#22c55e';
        } else {
          eqText = `μ = e${kSign}${pStr === '1.0' ? '' : pStr}x`;
          ctx.fillStyle = '#f59e0b';
        }
      } else {
        eqText = `μ = e^{∫±${pStr}dx}`;
        ctx.fillStyle = '#06b6d4';
      }
    }

    // Background for equation
    ctx.font = 'bold 14px Courier New';
    const tw = ctx.measureText(eqText).width + 24;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(15,23,42,.85)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    roundRect(ctx, centerX - tw/2, bottomY - 28, tw, 28, 8);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = state.currentStep >= 2 ? 'rgba(34,197,94,.5)' : 'rgba(139,92,246,.5)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    roundRect(ctx, centerX - tw/2, bottomY - 28, tw, 28, 8);
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = state.currentStep >= 2 ? '#22c55e' : (state.currentStep >= 1 ? '#f59e0b' : '#06b6d4');
    ctx.font = 'bold 13px Courier New';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(eqText, centerX, bottomY - 9);
  }

  function roundRect(ctx, x, y, w, h, r) {
    ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w - r, y);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + r);
    ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h - r);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + w, y + h, x + w - r, y + h);
    ctx.lineTo(x + r, y + h);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + h, x, y + h - r);
    ctx.lineTo(x, y + r);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y, x + r, y);
  }

  function drawStateBadge() {
    let label, color;
    if (state.ended) { label = '✅ 求解完成'; color = '#22c55e'; }
    else if (state.running) { label = '▶ 进行中'; color = '#06b6d4'; }
    else if (state.paused) { label = '⏸ 已暂停'; color = '#f59e0b'; }
    else { label = '⏳ 就绪'; color = '#94a3b8'; }

    ctx.font = 'bold 12px sans-serif';
    const tw = ctx.measureText(label).width + 20;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(15,23,42,.8)';
    ctx.beginPath();
    roundRect(ctx, W - tw - 10, 10, tw, 24, 6);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.fillText(label, W - tw + 2, 27);
  }

  // ===== UI Updates =====
  function updateButton() {
    // Not using a main start button - using step buttons instead
  }

  function updateStateDisplay() {
    const dot = document.getElementById('state-dot');
    const st = document.getElementById('stat-state');
    dot.className = 'state-indicator';
    if (state.ended) { dot.classList.add('ended'); st.textContent = '已完成'; }
    else if (state.running) { dot.classList.add('running'); st.textContent = '进行中'; }
    else if (state.paused) { dot.classList.add('paused'); st.textContent = '已暂停'; }
    else { dot.classList.add('idle'); st.textContent = '就绪'; }
  }

  function showHint(text) {
    const box = document.getElementById('hint-box');
    box.textContent = text;
    box.style.opacity = '1';
    setTimeout(() => { if (state.showHint === 0) box.style.opacity = '0'; }, 4000);
  }

  // ===== Equation Type =====
  window.setEqType = function(type) {
    state.equationType = type;
    document.querySelectorAll('.eq-type-btn').forEach(b => {
      b.classList.toggle('active', parseInt(b.dataset.type) === type);
    });
    resetSimulation();
  };

  // ===== Reset =====
  function resetSimulation() {
    state.currentStep = 0;
    state.running = false;
    state.ended = false;
    state.paused = false;
    state.animTime = 0;
    state.startTime = null;
    state.curveAnim = 0;
    state.curvePoints = [];
    state.evidence = { stepsCompleted: [], stepTimes: [], accuracy: 0 };

    computeSolutionCurve();
    buildSteps();
    updateEquationDisplay();
    updateStateDisplay();
    updateProgress();

    document.getElementById('stat-time').textContent = '0.0s';
    document.getElementById('hint-box').style.opacity = '0';

    draw();
  }

  // ===== Sliders =====
  document.querySelectorAll('input[type=range]').forEach(slider => {
    slider.addEventListener('input', function() {
      const val = parseFloat(this.value);
      const varName = this.dataset.var || this.id.replace('-slider', '');

      if (varName === 'coefficient_k') {
        state.coefficient_k = val;
        document.getElementById('coefficient_k-display').textContent = val.toFixed(1);
        document.getElementById('k-display').textContent = val.toFixed(1);
      } else if (varName === 'initial_condition') {
        state.initialCondition = val;
        document.getElementById('initial_condition-display').textContent = val.toFixed(1);
        document.getElementById('ic-display').textContent = val.toFixed(1);
      } else if (varName === 'integration_step_hint') {
        state.showHint = val;
        document.getElementById('integration_step_hint-display').textContent = val ? '显示' : '隐藏';
      } else if (varName === 'equation_type') {
        state.equationType = Math.round(val);
        document.querySelectorAll('.eq-type-btn').forEach(b => {
          b.classList.toggle('active', parseInt(b.dataset.type) === Math.round(val));
        });
      }

      updateEquationDisplay();
      resetSimulation();
    });
  });

  // ===== Presets =====
  function buildPresets() {
    const config = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('widget-config').textContent);
    const area = document.getElementById('presets-area');
    area.innerHTML = '';
    config.presets.forEach(p => {
      const btn = document.createElement('button');
      btn.className = 'preset-btn';
      btn.textContent = p.name;
      btn.onclick = () => applyPreset(p);
      area.appendChild(btn);
    });
  }

  function applyPreset(preset) {
    const vars = preset.variables;
    state.equationType = vars.equation_type || 0;
    state.coefficient_k = vars.coefficient_k || 1;
    state.initialCondition = vars.initial_condition || 1;
    state.showHint = vars.integration_step_hint !== undefined ? vars.integration_step_hint : 1;

    // Update UI
    document.getElementById('coefficient_k-slider').value = state.coefficient_k;
    document.getElementById('coefficient_k-display').textContent = state.coefficient_k.toFixed(1);
    document.getElementById('k-display').textContent = state.coefficient_k.toFixed(1);

    document.getElementById('initial_condition-slider').value = state.initialCondition;
    document.getElementById('initial_condition-display').textContent = state.initialCondition.toFixed(1);
    document.getElementById('ic-display').textContent = state.initialCondition.toFixed(1);

    document.getElementById('integration_step_hint-slider').value = state.showHint;
    document.getElementById('integration_step_hint-display').textContent = state.showHint ? '显示' : '隐藏';

    document.getElementById('equation_type-slider').value = state.equationType;
    document.querySelectorAll('.eq-type-btn').forEach(b => {
      b.classList.toggle('active', parseInt(b.dataset.type) === state.equationType);
    });

    updateEquationDisplay();
    resetSimulation();
  }

  // ===== Keyboard =====
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      // Auto-complete next step
      if (!state.ended && state.currentStep < state.totalSteps) {
        window.doStep(state.currentStep);
      }
    }
    if (e.key === 'r' || e.key === 'R') {
      resetSimulation();
    }
  });

  // ===== Timer =====
  function updateTimer() {
    if (state.startTime && !state.ended) {
      const elapsed = (Date.now() - state.startTime) / 1000;
      document.getElementById('stat-time').textContent = elapsed.toFixed(1) + 's';
    }
  }
  setInterval(updateTimer, 200);

  // ===== Animation Loop =====
  function animate() {
    if (state.running && !state.ended) {
      draw();
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }

  // ===== postMessage Listener =====
  window.addEventListener('message', function(event) {
    const { type, target, state: widgetState, content } = event.data || {};

    switch (type) {
      case 'SET_WIDGET_STATE':
        if (widgetState) {
          Object.entries(widgetState).forEach(([key, value]) => {
            if (key === 'equation_type') {
              state.equationType = parseInt(value);
              document.querySelectorAll('.eq-type-btn').forEach(b => {
                b.classList.toggle('active', parseInt(b.dataset.type) === state.equationType);
              });
              const slider = document.getElementById('equation_type-slider');
              if (slider) { slider.value = value; }
            } else if (key === 'coefficient_k') {
              state.coefficient_k = parseFloat(value);
              const slider = document.getElementById('coefficient_k-slider');
              if (slider) { slider.value = value; slider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); }
            } else if (key === 'initial_condition') {
              state.initialCondition = parseFloat(value);
              const slider = document.getElementById('initial_condition-slider');
              if (slider) { slider.value = value; slider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); }
            } else if (key === 'integration_step_hint') {
              state.showHint = parseInt(value);
              const slider = document.getElementById('integration_step_hint-slider');
              if (slider) { slider.value = value; slider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); }
            }
          });
          updateEquationDisplay();
          resetSimulation();
        }
        break;

      case 'HIGHLIGHT_ELEMENT':
        const highlightEl = document.querySelector(target);
        if (highlightEl) {
          highlightEl.style.outline = '3px solid rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.8)';
          highlightEl.style.outlineOffset = '4px';
          highlightEl.style.animation = 'pulse-highlight 2s infinite';
          setTimeout(() => {
            highlightEl.style.outline = '';
            highlightEl.style.animation = '';
          }, 3000);
        }
        break;

      case 'ANNOTATE_ELEMENT':
        const annotateEl = document.querySelector(target);
        if (annotateEl && content) {
          const rect = annotateEl.getBoundingClientRect();
          const tooltip = document.createElement('div');
          tooltip.className = 'teacher-annotation';
          tooltip.style.cssText = 'position:fixed; top:' + (rect.top - 40) + 'px; left:' + rect.left + 'px; background:rgba(139,92,246,.95); color:white; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:8px; font-size:14px; z-index:1000; animation:fadeIn 0.3s;';
          tooltip.textContent = content;
          document.body.appendChild(tooltip);
          setTimeout(() => tooltip.remove(), 4000);
        }
        break;

      case 'REVEAL_ELEMENT':
        const revealEl = document.querySelector(target);
        if (revealEl) {
          revealEl.style.display = '';
          revealEl.style.opacity = '1';
        }
        break;
    }
  });

  // ===== Toggle Controls =====
  window.toggleControls = function() {
    const panel = document.getElementById('controls');
    const btn = document.querySelector('.toggle-btn');
    panel.classList.toggle('collapsed');
    btn.textContent = panel.classList.contains('collapsed') ? '展开控制面板 ▼' : '收起控制面板 ▲';
  };

  // ===== Init =====
  function init() {
    buildPresets();
    updateEquationDisplay();
    computeSolutionCurve();
    buildSteps();
    updateStateDisplay();
    resize();
    animate();

    // Show initial hint
    setTimeout(() => {
      showHint('💡 选择方程类型，然后点击步骤按钮逐步求解');
    }, 500);
  }

  init();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

widgetConfig.description: 交互式求解可分离变量方程与一阶线性微分方程。学生通过选择方程类型、调整参数，逐步完成变量分离或积分因子法，观察解曲线的实时变化。

actions.text: 本场景通过交互探索“可分离变量与一阶线性方程：拖动实验”。不错，刚才我们提到，解微分方程的关键不是机械移项，而是寻找一种“整体变化率”的对应关系。现在，我们就用面前这个交互工具，亲自拖动试试，看这个思想如何在可分离变量和一阶线性方程中体现。

actions.content: 加载经典可分离变量方程 y' = y
这是切换方程类型的关键控件

actions.text: 我们先从最简单的 y' = y 开始。大家，别急着用代数方法去解。请你先拖动“方程类型”旁边的滑块，试试能不能切换到“一阶线性方程”模式，再切回来。感受一下，不同的方程结构，在这个工具里是如何被区分的。

actions.content: 选择“分离变量”模式后，点击这里开始移项

actions.text: 好。你来观察：当我们面对 y' = y 这种形式时，进度条提示我们，应该点击“移项”按钮，把y放到左边，x留在右边。这一步，其实就是在为寻找像导数一样的“整体变化率”做准备。你想想，如果现在是冷却定律 y' = -0.5y，第一步移动的项，本质上还是一样的吗？

actions.content: 切换到 冷却定律: y'=-0.5y

actions.text: 切换到冷却定律看看。系数变了，但分离的模式没有变。从这里，我们就能体会到，为什么有的方程被归为“可分离变量”，而有的必须用“积分因子”。接下来，大家多试试不同的预设选项，特别是那个 y' + 2y = 1，看看它在工具里的处理路径，和之前的有什么根本不同。

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>可分离变量与一阶线性方程：关系图</title>
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
:root{
  --bg:#0d1117;--bg2:#161b22;--node:#ffffff;--text:#e6edf3;
  --accent:#58a6ff;--sep:#3fb950;--lin:#d2a8ff;--edge:#484f58;
  --arrow:#8b949e;--sidebar-w:320px;
}
html,body{height:100%;font-family:'Segoe UI',system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);overflow:hidden}
#app{display:flex;height:100vh;width:100vw}

/* Sidebar */
#sidebar{
  width:var(--sidebar-w);min-width:var(--sidebar-w);background:var(--bg2);
  border-right:1px solid #30363d;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  transition:margin-left .3s ease,opacity .3s ease;z-index:100;position:relative;
}
#sidebar.collapsed{margin-left:calc(-1 * var(--sidebar-w));opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
#sidebar-header{padding:16px;border-bottom:1px solid #30363d;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
#sidebar-header h2{font-size:15px;color:var(--accent)}
#toggle-btn{
  position:fixed;top:12px;z-index:110;background:var(--bg2);border:1px solid #30363d;
  color:var(--text);width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;
  font-size:18px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  transition:left .3s ease;
}
#toggle-btn.left{left:calc(var(--sidebar-w) + 8px)}
#toggle-btn.right{left:8px}
#sidebar-content{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:16px}
#node-detail{display:none}
#node-detail.active{display:block}
#node-detail .icon{font-size:36px;margin-bottom:8px}
#node-detail .title{font-size:18px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px;color:#fff}
#node-detail .subtitle{font-size:13px;color:var(--accent);margin-bottom:12px}
#node-detail .desc{font-size:14px;line-height:1.7;color:#c9d1d9}
#node-detail .math{
  background:#1c2333;border:1px solid #30363d;border-radius:8px;
  padding:12px 16px;margin:12px 0;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;
  font-size:15px;color:#ffa657;text-align:center;
}
#node-detail .tip{
  background:#1a3a2a;border:1px solid #238636;border-radius:8px;
  padding:10px 14px;margin:12px 0;font-size:13px;color:#3fb950;
}
#sidebar-footer{padding:12px 16px;border-top:1px solid #30363d;display:flex;gap:8px}
#sidebar-footer button{
  flex:1;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid #30363d;border-radius:6px;
  background:var(--bg2);color:var(--text);cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;
  transition:background .2s;
}
#sidebar-footer button:hover:not(:disabled){background:#30363d}
#sidebar-footer button:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:default}
#step-indicator{text-align:center;padding:8px;font-size:12px;color:#8b949e;border-top:1px solid #30363d}

/* Main SVG area */
#diagram-area{flex:1;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
#svg-container{width:100%;height:100%}
#diagram-area svg{width:100%;height:100%}

/* SVG styles */
.node-group{cursor:pointer;transition:opacity .5s ease}
.node-group .node-rect{
  rx:12;ry:12;fill:var(--node);stroke:none;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.4));
  transition:stroke .2s,stroke-width .2s;
}
.node-group:hover .node-rect{stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:2}
.node-group.active .node-rect{stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:3}
.node-group.dimmed{opacity:.25;pointer-events:none}
.node-group .node-icon{font-size:20px;fill:var(--bg);pointer-events:none}
.node-group .node-label{font-size:12px;fill:var(--bg);font-weight:600;text-anchor:middle;pointer-events:none}
.node-group .node-label-en{font-size:10px;fill:#6e7681;text-anchor:middle;pointer-events:none}

.edge-path{fill:none;stroke:var(--edge);stroke-width:2;transition:opacity .5s ease,stroke .3s}
.edge-path.active{stroke:var(--accent)}
.edge-path.dimmed{opacity:.1}
.edge-label-bg{fill:var(--bg);rx:4;ry:4}
.edge-label{font-size:11px;fill:#8b949e;text-anchor:middle;transition:opacity .5s ease,fill .3s}
.edge-label.active{fill:var(--accent)}
.edge-label.dimmed{opacity:.1}
.arrow-head{fill:var(--arrow);transition:opacity .5s ease,fill .3s}
.arrow-head.active{fill:var(--accent)}
.arrow-head.dimmed{opacity:.1}

/* Reveal animation */
@keyframes nodeAppear{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.7)}to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}}
.node-group.revealing{animation:nodeAppear .4s ease forwards}

/* Legend */
#legend{
  position:absolute;bottom:12px;left:12px;background:rgba(22,27,34,.9);
  border:1px solid #30363d;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;font-size:11px;
}
#legend div{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin:3px 0}
#legend .dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block}

/* Responsive */
@media(max-width:768px){
  :root{--sidebar-w:280px}
  #toggle-btn{top:8px}
}
@media(max-width:480px){
  :root{--sidebar-w:100vw}
  .node-group .node-label{font-size:10px}
  .node-group .node-label-en{font-size:8px}
}
</style>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const katexOptions = {
        delimiters: [
            {left: '\\[', right: '\\]', display: true},
            {left: '\\(', right: '\\)', display: false},
            {left: '$$', right: '$$', display: true},
            {left: '$', right: '$', display: false}
        ],
        throwOnError: false,
        strict: false,
        trust: true
    };

    let renderTimeout;
    function safeRender() {
        if (renderTimeout) clearTimeout(renderTimeout);
        renderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);
        }, 100);
    }

    renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);

    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        let shouldRender = false;
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
            if (mutation.target &&
                mutation.target.className &&
                typeof mutation.target.className === 'string' &&
                mutation.target.className.includes('katex')) {
                return;
            }
            shouldRender = true;
        });

        if (shouldRender) {
            safeRender();
        }
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        characterData: true
    });

    setInterval(() => {
        const text = document.body.innerText;
        if (text.includes('\\(') || text.includes('$$')) {
            safeRender();
        }
    }, 2000);
});

    <div id="sidebar-header"><h2>📐 节点详情</h2></div>
    <div id="sidebar-content">
      <div id="node-detail"></div>
    </div>
    <div id="step-indicator">步骤 0 / 0</div>
    <div id="sidebar-footer">
      <button id="btn-prev" onclick="prevStep()" disabled>◀ 上一步</button>
      <button id="btn-next" onclick="nextStep()">下一步 ▶</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div id="diagram-area">
    <div id="svg-container"></div>
    <div id="legend">
      <div><span class="dot" style="background:var(--sep)"></span> 可分离变量法</div>
      <div><span class="dot" style="background:var(--lin)"></span> 一阶线性方程法</div>
      <div><span class="dot" style="background:var(--accent)"></span> 当前步骤</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script type="application/json" id="widget-config">
{
  "nodes": [
    {"id":"root","label":"一阶常微分方程","labelEn":"First-Order ODE","icon":"📝","color":"#58a6ff","details":"形如 dy/dx = f(x, y) 的方程，包含一个一阶导数。求解的核心思路是<strong>「化未知为已知」</strong>——通过代数变形将方程转化为可以直接积分的形式。","math":"\\frac{dy}{dx} = f(x, y)","tip":"核心直觉：导数描述变化率，积分就是「还原」原始函数。"},
    {"id":"decision","label":"决策：是否存在 y 的一次项？","labelEn":"Decision Point","icon":"🔀","color":"#f0883e","details":"这是求解路径的<strong>分叉点</strong>。检查方程是否可以写成 dy/dx + P(x)y = Q(x) 的形式：<br>• <strong style='color:var(--lin)'>是</strong>→ 一阶线性方程（用积分因子法）<br>• <strong style='color:var(--sep)'>否</strong>→ 尝试可分离变量法","math":"\\text{可分离：}f(x) \\cdot g(y) \\quad \\text{线性：}\\frac{dy}{dx}+P(x)y=Q(x)","tip":"💡 识别条件是后续所有步骤的基础！先观察方程结构，再选择工具。"},
    {"id":"sep_id","label":"识别：可分离变量","labelEn":"Identify Separable","icon":"🔍","color":"#3fb950","details":"方程可以写成 dy/dx = f(x) · g(y) 的形式，即右边能拆成<strong>纯 x 的函数</strong>与<strong>纯 y 的函数</strong>的乘积。这是「可分离」的关键判据。","math":"\\frac{dy}{dx} = f(x) \\cdot g(y)","tip":"🎯 试将方程变形，看能否让所有含 y 的项在一侧，含 x 的项在另一侧。"},
    {"id":"sep_sep","label":"分离变量","labelEn":"Separate Variables","icon":"✂️","color":"#3fb950","details":"将方程两边同时除以 g(y) 并乘以 dx，使含 y 的项全部到左边，含 x 的项全部到右边。这步操作的数学依据是<strong>代数变形</strong>（等价变换）。","math":"\\frac{dy}{g(y)} = f(x)\\, dx","tip":"✂️ 直觉：把「混合在一起的变量」拆开，就像把打结的绳子解开。"},
    {"id":"sep_int","label":"两边积分","labelEn":"Integrate Both Sides","icon":"∫","color":"#3fb950","details":"对等式两边分别积分。左边对 y 积分，右边对 x 积分。积分后得到隐式解，通常包含一个积分常数 C。","math":"\\int \\frac{dy}{g(y)} = \\int f(x)\\, dx + C","tip":"∫ 积分是微分的逆运算——导数告诉你「变化率」，积分帮你「还原整体」。"},
    {"id":"sep_sol","label":"得到通解","labelEn":"General Solution","icon":"✅","color":"#3fb950","details":"从积分结果中解出 y（如果可能），得到通解。通解包含任意常数 C，表示一族曲线。若有初值条件 y(x₀) = y₀，可代入求出 C 得到特解。","math":"y = \\Phi(x, C)","tip":"🌊 通解是一族曲线的「参数家族」，初值条件帮你锁定其中一条。"},
    {"id":"sep_vrf","label":"验证","labelEn":"Verify","icon":"🔬","color":"#3fb950","details":"将求得的解代回原方程，检查 dy/dx 是否等于 f(x)g(y)。这是闭环的关键一步——<strong>验证确保每一步的可靠性</strong>。","math":"\\text{验证：} \\frac{d}{dx}\\Phi(x,C) = f(x)g(\\Phi(x,C))","tip":"🔬 验证不是可有可无的——它是数学思维的「自检机制」。"},
    {"id":"lin_id","label":"识别：一阶线性","labelEn":"Identify Linear","icon":"🔍","color":"#d2a8ff","details":"方程可以写成标准形式 dy/dx + P(x)y = Q(x)。关键特征：y 和 dy/dx 都只以一次项出现，且 y 不与其他函数相乘。","math":"\\frac{dy}{dx} + P(x)y = Q(x)","tip":"📏 线性 = 「y 只出现一次」，就像直线 y = mx + b 中的 y。"},
    {"id":"lin_fac","label":"求积分因子","labelEn":"Integrating Factor","icon":"⚡","color":"#d2a8ff","details":"构造积分因子 μ(x) = e^{∫P(x)dx}。这个看似神奇的因子，其本质是利用<strong>乘积导数法则</strong>的逆过程——让左边变成某个乘积的导数。","math":"\\mu(x) = e^{\\int P(x)\\, dx}","tip":"⚡ 积分因子的直觉：找一个「合适的倍数」，让左边恰好是 d(μ·y)/dx。"},
    {"id":"lin_mul","label":"两边乘以 μ","labelEn":"Multiply by μ","icon":"✖️","color":"#d2a8ff","details":"将原方程两边同乘以积分因子 μ(x)。这一步是整个方法的核心——它把「普通的一阶线性方程」变成了「可以直接积分的形式」。","math":"\\mu(x)\\frac{dy}{dx} + \\mu(x)P(x)y = \\mu(x)Q(x)","tip":"✖️ 为什么乘以 μ 就能简化？因为 μ 被精心构造过，它满足 μ' = μP。"},
    {"id":"lin_rwr","label":"改写为导数形式","labelEn":"Rewrite as Derivative","icon":"🔄","color":"#d2a8ff","details":"利用乘积导数法则 (μy)' = μy' + μ'y，且 μ' = μP，左边恰好合并为 d/dx[μ(x)·y]。这是整个方法最精妙的一步！","math":"\\frac{d}{dx}[\\mu(x) \\cdot y] = \\mu(x) Q(x)","tip":"🔄 乘积导数法则的逆用：看到 μy' + μ'·y 就要想到 d(μy)/dx。"},
    {"id":"lin_int","label":"两边积分求解","labelEn":"Integrate & Solve","icon":"∫","color":"#d2a8ff","details":"对两边积分后得到 μ(x)·y = ∫μ(x)Q(x)dx + C，两边除以 μ(x) 即得通解。注意别忘了积分常数 C。","math":"y = \\frac{1}{\\mu(x)} \\left( \\int \\mu(x)Q(x)\\, dx + C \\right)","tip":"∫ 最后一步：积分后除回 μ(x)，就像「解开」之前乘以的因子。"},
    {"id":"lin_vrf","label":"验证","labelEn":"Verify","icon":"🔬","color":"#d2a8ff","details":"将解代回原方程 dy/dx + P(x)y = Q(x)，确认等式成立。完成「识别 → 整理 → 积分 → 验证」的完整闭环。","math":"\\text{验证：} y' + P(x)y \\stackrel{?}{=} Q(x)","tip":"🔬 闭环完成！验证是数学严谨性的体现。"}
  ],
  "edges": [
    {"from":"root","to":"decision","label":"dy/dx = f(x,y)"},
    {"from":"decision","to":"sep_id","label":"否 → 可分离"},
    {"from":"decision","to":"lin_id","label":"是 → 线性"},
    {"from":"sep_id","to":"sep_sep","label":"代数变形"},
    {"from":"sep_sep","to":"sep_int","label":"∫ 两边积分"},
    {"from":"sep_int","to":"sep_sol","label":"解出 y(x)"},
    {"from":"sep_sol","to":"sep_vrf","label":"代入验证"},
    {"from":"lin_id","to":"lin_fac","label":"构造 μ(x)"},
    {"from":"lin_fac","to":"lin_mul","label":"等价变换"},
    {"from":"lin_mul","to":"lin_rwr","label":"乘积导数法则"},
    {"from":"lin_rwr","to":"lin_int","label":"∫ 积分"},
    {"from":"lin_int","to":"lin_vrf","label":"代入验证"}
  ],
  "revealOrder":["root","decision","sep_id","lin_id","sep_sep","lin_fac","sep_int","lin_mul","sep_sol","lin_rwr","sep_vrf","lin_int","lin_vrf"]
}
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  const cfg = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('widget-config').textContent);
  const NODE_W = 180, NODE_H = 70, ARROW_OFF = 12;
  let revealIdx = -1, sidebarOpen = window.innerWidth > 768;

  // Compute layout positions (tree layout)
  const positions = {};
  const cx = 400; // center x (will be adjusted)
  const topY = 60;
  const levels = {
    root: 0,
    decision: 1,
    sep_id: 2, lin_id: 2,
    sep_sep: 3, lin_fac: 3,
    sep_int: 4, lin_mul: 4,
    sep_sol: 5, lin_rwr: 5,
    sep_vrf: 6, lin_int: 6,
    lin_vrf: 7
  };
  // Left branch x range: 120-280, Right branch x range: 520-680
  const leftX = 200, rightX = 600;
  const branchLeft = {sep_id:leftX, sep_sep:leftX-40, sep_int:leftX, sep_sol:leftX+40, sep_vrf:leftX};
  const branchRight = {lin_id:rightX, lin_fac:rightX-40, lin_mul:rightX, lin_rwr:rightX+40, lin_int:rightX, lin_vrf:rightX};

  const rowY = [topY, topY+110, topY+210, topY+310, topY+410, topY+510, topY+610, topY+710];

  cfg.nodes.forEach(n => {
    const lvl = levels[n.id] || 0;
    let x, y;
    if(n.id === 'root'){ x = cx; y = rowY[0]; }
    else if(n.id === 'decision'){ x = cx; y = rowY[1]; }
    else if(branchLeft[n.id]){ x = branchLeft[n.id]; y = rowY[lvl]; }
    else if(branchRight[n.id]){ x = branchRight[n.id]; y = rowY[lvl]; }
    else { x = cx; y = rowY[lvl]; }
    positions[n.id] = {x, y};
  });

  // SVG namespace
  const NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
  const svg = document.createElementNS(NS,'svg');
  svg.setAttribute('viewBox','0 0 800 820');
  svg.setAttribute('preserveAspectRatio','xMidYMid meet');
  document.getElementById('svg-container').appendChild(svg);

  // Defs for markers
  const defs = document.createElementNS(NS,'defs');
  defs.innerHTML = `
    <marker id="arrow" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="8" refX="9" refY="4" orient="auto" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <path d="M0,0 L10,4 L0,8 Z" class="arrow-head"/>
    </marker>
    <marker id="arrow-active" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="8" refX="9" refY="4" orient="auto" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <path d="M0,0 L10,4 L0,8 Z" class="arrow-head active"/>
    </marker>
    <marker id="arrow-dimmed" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="8" refX="9" refY="4" orient="auto" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <path d="M0,0 L10,4 L0,8 Z" class="arrow-head dimmed"/>
    </marker>
  `;
  svg.appendChild(defs);

  // Edge helper
  function getEdgePoints(from, to){
    const dx = to.x - from.x, dy = to.y - from.y;
    let sx, sy, ex, ey;
    if(Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx)){
      sx = from.x;
      sy = dy > 0 ? from.y + NODE_H/2 : from.y - NODE_H/2;
      ex = to.x;
      ey = dy > 0 ? to.y - NODE_H/2 - ARROW_OFF : to.y + NODE_H/2 + ARROW_OFF;
    } else {
      sx = dx > 0 ? from.x + NODE_W/2 : from.x - NODE_W/2;
      sy = from.y;
      ex = dx > 0 ? to.x - NODE_W/2 - ARROW_OFF : to.x + NODE_W/2 + ARROW_OFF;
      ey = to.y;
    }
    return {sx, sy, ex, ey, path: `M ${sx} ${sy} L ${ex} ${ey}`};
  }

  // Draw edges
  const edgeEls = {};
  const edgeLabelEls = {};
  cfg.edges.forEach((e,i) => {
    const key = e.from+'-'+e.to;
    const pts = getEdgePoints(positions[e.from], positions[e.to]);
    const g = document.createElementNS(NS,'g');
    g.dataset.edgeKey = key;

    const path = document.createElementNS(NS,'path');
    path.setAttribute('d', pts.path);
    path.classList.add('edge-path');
    path.setAttribute('marker-end','url(#arrow)');
    g.appendChild(path);

    // Edge label at midpoint
    const mx = (pts.sx + pts.ex)/2, my = (pts.sy + pts.ey)/2;
    const label = e.label || '';
    if(label){
      const tempText = document.createElementNS(NS,'text');
      tempText.textContent = label;
      svg.appendChild(tempText);
      const tw = tempText.getBBox ? tempText.getBBox().width : 60;
      svg.removeChild(tempText);

      const bg = document.createElementNS(NS,'rect');
      bg.setAttribute('x', mx - tw/2 - 6);
      bg.setAttribute('y', my - 9);
      bg.setAttribute('width', tw + 12);
      bg.setAttribute('height', 18);
      bg.classList.add('edge-label-bg');
      g.appendChild(bg);

      const t = document.createElementNS(NS,'text');
      t.setAttribute('x', mx);
      t.setAttribute('y', my + 4);
      t.textContent = label;
      t.classList.add('edge-label');
      g.appendChild(t);
      edgeLabelEls[key] = {bg, t};
    }
    edgeEls[key] = path;
    svg.appendChild(g);
  });

  // Draw nodes
  const nodeEls = {};
  cfg.nodes.forEach(n => {
    const pos = positions[n.id];
    const g = document.createElementNS(NS,'g');
    g.classList.add('node-group','dimmed');
    g.dataset.nodeId = n.id;
    g.setAttribute('transform',`translate(${pos.x - NODE_W/2},${pos.y - NODE_H/2})`);

    const rect = document.createElementNS(NS,'rect');
    rect.setAttribute('width', NODE_W);
    rect.setAttribute('height', NODE_H);
    rect.classList.add('node-rect');
    g.appendChild(rect);

    // Icon
    const icon = document.createElementNS(NS,'text');
    icon.setAttribute('x', NODE_W/2);
    icon.setAttribute('y', 22);
    icon.textContent = n.icon;
    icon.classList.add('node-icon');
    g.appendChild(icon);

    // Label
    const lbl = document.createElementNS(NS,'text');
    lbl.setAttribute('x', NODE_W/2);
    lbl.setAttribute('y', 40);
    lbl.textContent = n.label;
    lbl.classList.add('node-label');
    g.appendChild(lbl);

    // English label
    if(n.labelEn){
      const lblEn = document.createElementNS(NS,'text');
      lblEn.setAttribute('x', NODE_W/2);
      lblEn.setAttribute('y', 56);
      lblEn.textContent = n.labelEn;
      lblEn.classList.add('node-label-en');
      g.appendChild(lblEn);
    }

    // Click handler
    g.addEventListener('click', () => selectNode(n.id));

    svg.appendChild(g);
    nodeEls[n.id] = g;
  });

  // Reveal logic
  const revealOrder = cfg.revealOrder;
  const revealed = new Set();

  function render(){
    const activeNodes = new Set();
    const activeEdges = new Set();

    for(let i = 0; i <= revealIdx; i++){
      activeNodes.add(revealOrder[i]);
    }

    // Active edges: connect two revealed nodes
    cfg.edges.forEach(e => {
      if(revealed.has(e.from) && revealed.has(e.to)){
        activeEdges.add(e.from+'-'+e.to);
      }
    });

    // Update nodes
    cfg.nodes.forEach(n => {
      const el = nodeEls[n.id];
      if(activeNodes.has(n.id)){
        el.classList.remove('dimmed');
        if(revealIdx >= 0 && n.id === revealOrder[revealIdx]){
          el.classList.add('active');
        } else {
          el.classList.remove('active');
        }
      } else {
        el.classList.add('dimmed');
        el.classList.remove('active');
      }
    });

    // Update edges
    cfg.edges.forEach(e => {
      const key = e.from+'-'+e.to;
      const path = edgeEls[key];
      if(activeEdges.has(key)){
        path.classList.remove('dimmed');
        path.setAttribute('marker-end','url(#arrow-active)');
        path.classList.add('active');
        const lbl = edgeLabelEls[key];
        if(lbl){
          lbl.bg.style.opacity = '1';
          lbl.t.classList.remove('dimmed');
          lbl.t.classList.add('active');
        }
      } else {
        path.classList.add('dimmed');
        path.classList.remove('active');
        path.setAttribute('marker-end','url(#arrow-dimmed)');
        const lbl = edgeLabelEls[key];
        if(lbl){
          lbl.bg.style.opacity = '0.1';
          lbl.t.classList.add('dimmed');
          lbl.t.classList.remove('active');
        }
      }
    });

    // Update step indicator
    document.getElementById('step-indicator').textContent =
      `步骤 ${revealIdx + 1} / ${revealOrder.length}`;

    // Update buttons
    document.getElementById('btn-prev').disabled = revealIdx < 0;
    document.getElementById('btn-next').disabled = revealIdx >= revealOrder.length - 1;

    // If last node revealed, select it
    if(revealIdx >= 0 && revealIdx === revealOrder.length - 1){
      // Auto-select last node
    }
  }

  function nextStep(){
    if(revealIdx < revealOrder.length - 1){
      revealIdx++;
      const nid = revealOrder[revealIdx];
      revealed.add(nid);
      render();
      selectNode(nid);
    }
  }

  function prevStep(){
    if(revealIdx >= 0){
      const nid = revealOrder[revealIdx];
      revealed.delete(nid);
      revealIdx--;
      if(revealIdx >= 0){
        const prevNid = revealOrder[revealIdx];
        selectNode(prevNid);
      } else {
        clearDetail();
      }
      render();
    }
  }

  function selectNode(nid){
    const node = cfg.nodes.find(n => n.id === nid);
    if(!node) return;

    // Highlight active node
    cfg.nodes.forEach(n => {
      nodeEls[n.id].classList.toggle('active', n.id === nid);
    });

    // Show detail
    const detail = document.getElementById('node-detail');
    detail.classList.add('active');
    detail.innerHTML = `
      <div class="icon">${node.icon}</div>
      <div class="title">${node.label}</div>
      <div class="subtitle">${node.labelEn || ''}</div>
      ${node.math ? `<div class="math">$$${node.math}$$</div>` : ''}
      <div class="desc">${node.details}</div>
      ${node.tip ? `<div class="tip">${node.tip}</div>` : ''}
    `;
  }

  function clearDetail(){
    document.getElementById('node-detail').classList.remove('active');
    document.getElementById('node-detail').innerHTML = '';
  }

  // Toggle sidebar
  window.toggleSidebar = function(){
    sidebarOpen = !sidebarOpen;
    const sb = document.getElementById('sidebar');
    const btn = document.getElementById('toggle-btn');
    sb.classList.toggle('collapsed', !sidebarOpen);
    btn.classList.toggle('left', sidebarOpen);
    btn.classList.toggle('right', !sidebarOpen);
    btn.textContent = sidebarOpen ? '◀' : '☰';
  };

  // Initialize sidebar state
  if(!sidebarOpen){
    document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('collapsed');
    document.getElementById('toggle-btn').classList.remove('left');
    document.getElementById('toggle-btn').classList.add('right');
  }

  // Expose functions globally
  window.nextStep = nextStep;
  window.prevStep = prevStep;

  // Initial reveal: first node
  revealIdx = 0;
  revealed.add(revealOrder[0]);
  render();
  selectNode(revealOrder[0]);

})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

actions.text: 本场景通过交互探索“可分离变量与一阶线性方程：关系图”。我们亲手感受了不同方程的处理路径。现在，我们把这两种解题策略的逻辑，整理成一张一目了然的决策树。

actions.content: 这是决策的起点，一个一阶微分方程。

actions.text: 请大家注意看第一个分叉点。判断它到底属于可分离变量，还是一阶线性方程，关键就看它能不能被整理成 dy/dx 等于一个 x 的函数乘以一个 y 的函数这种形式。

actions.content: 展开可分离变量的处理分支。

actions.text: 如果等号右边可以分解成 x 部分和 y 部分相乘，那我们就走这边。它的核心操作很直观，就是先把带 y 的项全部搬到一边，把带 x 的项全部搬到另一边，然后两边同时积分。

actions.content: 展开一阶线性方程的处理分支。

actions.text: 那如果右边不能这样干净地分离，而且方程里出现了单纯的 y 项，就是像 y' + P(x)y = Q(x) 的样子，我们就要启用另一个工具——积分因子。还记得刚才在工具里处理 y'+2y=1 时，自动乘上去的那个 e 的 2x 次方吗？它背后的数学依据，就是乘积导数的逆运算。大家点击一下这个节点，看看旁边的说明。

actions.content: 这里的逻辑依据就是乘积导数法则的反向应用。

scenes.title: 可分离变量与一阶线性方程：误解修复挑战

content.html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>变量分离挑战：修复断裂的求解步骤</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

  body {
    font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0c0c1e 0%, #1a1a3e 50%, #0c0c1e 100%);
    color: #e0e0e0;
    min-height: 100vh;
    overflow-x: hidden;
  }

  #game-container {
    max-width: 900px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 10px;
    position: relative;
    min-height: 100vh;
  }

  /* Header */
  #header {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 15px 0 10px;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 10;
  }

  #header h1 {
    font-size: 1.3em;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #00d4ff, #7b2ff7, #ff6bc1);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    background-clip: text;
    margin-bottom: 5px;
  }

  #header .subtitle {
    font-size: 0.8em;
    color: #8888aa;
  }

  /* HUD */
  #hud {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 8px 15px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    border-radius: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  }

  .hud-item {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    min-width: 70px;
  }

  .hud-label {
    font-size: 0.65em;
    color: #8888aa;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
  }

  .hud-value {
    font-size: 1.2em;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #00d4ff;
  }

  #level-badge {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7b2ff7, #ff6bc1);
    color: white;
    padding: 4px 14px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    font-size: 0.85em;
    font-weight: bold;
  }

  /* Canvas for particle effects */
  #particle-canvas {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 100;
  }

  /* Game Area */
  #game-area {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 5;
  }

  /* Problem Display */
  #problem-display {
    background: rgba(123, 47, 247, 0.15);
    border: 2px solid rgba(123, 47, 247, 0.3);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 15px 20px;
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    position: relative;
  }

  #problem-display .eq {
    font-size: 1.5em;
    font-family: 'Cambria Math', 'Times New Roman', serif;
    color: #fff;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
  }

  #problem-display .hint {
    font-size: 0.75em;
    color: #aaaacc;
    margin-top: 6px;
  }

  /* Solution Chain */
  #solution-chain {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
    padding: 12px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
    border-radius: 16px;
    border: 1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    min-height: 120px;
  }

  .chain-slot {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 10px 15px;
    background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.05);
    border: 2px dashed rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.25);
    border-radius: 12px;
    min-height: 52px;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    position: relative;
  }

  .chain-slot.highlight {
    border-color: #00d4ff;
    background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.12);
    box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.2);
  }

  .chain-slot.filled {
    border-style: solid;
    border-color: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.4);
    background: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.08);
  }

  .chain-slot.wrong {
    border-color: #ff4444;
    background: rgba(255, 68, 68, 0.15);
    animation: shake 0.5s ease;
  }

  .chain-slot .step-num {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(123, 47, 247, 0.3);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 0.8em;
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #cc99ff;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .chain-slot .step-content {
    font-size: 1.1em;
    font-family: 'Cambria Math', 'Times New Roman', serif;
    flex: 1;
    text-align: center;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
  }

  .chain-slot .arrow-down {
    text-align: center;
    color: #7b2ff7;
    font-size: 1.2em;
    margin: 2px 0;
  }

  /* Fragments Pool */
  #fragments-pool {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 12px;
    min-height: 100px;
  }

  #fragments-pool .pool-label {
    font-size: 0.75em;
    color: #8888aa;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    text-align: center;
  }

  #fragments-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 8px;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .fragment {
    padding: 10px 16px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(123,47,247,0.2), rgba(255,107,193,0.2));
    border: 2px solid rgba(123, 47, 247, 0.4);
    border-radius: 10px;
    cursor: grab;
    user-select: none;
    font-family: 'Cambria Math', 'Times New Roman', serif;
    font-size: 1em;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
    touch-action: none;
    position: relative;
    min-height: 44px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  .fragment:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(123, 47, 247, 0.3);
    border-color: #ff6bc1;
  }

  .fragment:active, .fragment.dragging {
    cursor: grabbing;
    transform: scale(1.05);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(123, 47, 247, 0.5);
    z-index: 50;
  }

  .fragment.correct-placed {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0,255,136,0.2), rgba(0,212,255,0.2));
    border-color: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.5);
    cursor: default;
  }

  .fragment.distractor {
    opacity: 0.7;
  }

  .fragment.distractor::after {
    content: '⚠';
    position: absolute;
    top: -6px;
    right: -6px;
    font-size: 0.7em;
    background: #ff4444;
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  /* Feedback Panel */
  #feedback-panel {
    position: fixed;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.8);
    background: rgba(20, 20, 50, 0.97);
    border: 2px solid #ff4444;
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 25px 30px;
    max-width: 420px;
    width: 90%;
    z-index: 200;
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    text-align: center;
  }

  #feedback-panel.show {
    opacity: 1;
    pointer-events: auto;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1);
  }

  #feedback-panel.success {
    border-color: #00ff88;
  }

  #feedback-panel .feedback-icon {
    font-size: 2.5em;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }

  #feedback-panel .feedback-title {
    font-size: 1.2em;
    font-weight: bold;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }

  #feedback-panel .feedback-msg {
    font-size: 0.9em;
    color: #aaaacc;
    line-height: 1.6;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
  }

  #feedback-panel .feedback-rule {
    background: rgba(255, 68, 68, 0.15);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 68, 68, 0.3);
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 10px 15px;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
    font-size: 0.85em;
    color: #ff9999;
  }

  #feedback-panel .feedback-rule .rule-name {
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #ff6666;
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }

  #feedback-panel button {
    padding: 10px 30px;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 25px;
    font-size: 1em;
    font-weight: bold;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.2s;
  }

  #feedback-panel button.retry-btn {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff4444, #ff6b6b);
    color: white;
  }

  #feedback-panel button.next-btn {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00ff88, #00d4ff);
    color: #0a0a2e;
  }

  /* Start Screen */
  #start-screen {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
    background: rgba(10, 10, 30, 0.97);
    z-index: 300;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 20px;
    text-align: center;
  }

  #start-screen.hidden { display: none; }

  #start-screen h1 {
    font-size: 1.8em;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #00d4ff, #7b2ff7, #ff6bc1);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    background-clip: text;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }

  #start-screen .intro-text {
    max-width: 500px;
    color: #aaaacc;
    line-height: 1.7;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    font-size: 0.95em;
  }

  #start-screen .intro-text strong {
    color: #00d4ff;
  }

  #start-screen .how-to-play {
    background: rgba(123,47,247,0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(123,47,247,0.3);
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 18px 25px;
    max-width: 480px;
    margin-bottom: 25px;
    text-align: left;
  }

  #start-screen .how-to-play h3 {
    color: #cc99ff;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    font-size: 1em;
  }

  #start-screen .how-to-play li {
    margin: 6px 0;
    color: #bbb;
    font-size: 0.85em;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  #start-screen .start-btn {
    padding: 15px 50px;
    font-size: 1.2em;
    font-weight: bold;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 30px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7b2ff7, #ff6bc1);
    color: white;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
  }

  #start-screen .start-btn:hover {
    transform: scale(1.05);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(123, 47, 247, 0.5);
  }

  /* Level Complete Overlay */
  #level-complete {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
    background: rgba(10, 10, 30, 0.95);
    z-index: 250;
    display: none;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 20px;
  }

  #level-complete.show { display: flex; }

  #level-complete h2 {
    font-size: 2em;
    color: #00ff88;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }

  #level-complete .stars {
    font-size: 2.5em;
    margin: 10px 0;
  }

  #level-complete .score-detail {
    color: #aaaacc;
    margin: 8px 0;
    font-size: 0.95em;
  }

  #level-complete button {
    margin-top: 15px;
    padding: 12px 40px;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 25px;
    font-size: 1.1em;
    font-weight: bold;
    cursor: pointer;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00ff88, #00d4ff);
    color: #0a0a2e;
    transition: all 0.3s;
  }

  /* Achievement Popup */
  #achievement-popup {
    position: fixed;
    top: 20px;
    right: 20px;
    background: rgba(20, 20, 50, 0.95);
    border: 2px solid #ffcc00;
    border-radius: 16px;
    padding: 15px 20px;
    z-index: 300;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    transform: translateX(150%);
    transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);
    max-width: 320px;
  }

  #achievement-popup.show {
    transform: translateX(0);
  }

  #achievement-popup .ach-icon {
    font-size: 2em;
  }

  #achievement-popup .ach-info .ach-title {
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #ffcc00;
    font-size: 0.9em;
  }

  #achievement-popup .ach-info .ach-desc {
    font-size: 0.75em;
    color: #aaaacc;
    margin-top: 2px;
  }

  /* Pause Button */
  #pause-btn {
    position: fixed;
    top: 10px;
    right: 10px;
    z-index: 150;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
    border-radius: 50%;
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 1.2em;
    color: #ccc;
    transition: all 0.2s;
  }

  #pause-btn:hover {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
  }

  /* Pause Overlay */
  #pause-overlay {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
    background: rgba(10, 10, 30, 0.9);
    z-index: 250;
    display: none;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    text-align: center;
  }

  #pause-overlay.show { display: flex; }

  #pause-overlay h2 {
    font-size: 2em;
    color: #00d4ff;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }

  #pause-overlay button {
    padding: 12px 40px;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 25px;
    font-size: 1.1em;
    cursor: pointer;
    margin: 5px;
    font-weight: bold;
  }

  #pause-overlay .resume-btn {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00d4ff, #7b2ff7);
    color: white;
  }

  #pause-overlay .restart-btn {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    color: #aaaacc;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
  }

  /* Animations */
  @keyframes shake {
    0%, 100% { transform: translateX(0); }
    20% { transform: translateX(-8px); }
    40% { transform: translateX(8px); }
    60% { transform: translateX(-5px); }
    80% { transform: translateX(5px); }
  }

  @keyframes pulse {
    0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); }
    50% { transform: scale(1.05); }
  }

  @keyframes glow {
    0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.3); }
    50% { box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.6); }
  }

  @keyframes float-in {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  }

  .fragment { animation: float-in 0.4s ease backwards; }

  /* Dragging ghost */
  #drag-ghost {
    position: fixed;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 500;
    padding: 10px 16px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(123,47,247,0.4), rgba(255,107,193,0.4));
    border: 2px solid #ff6bc1;
    border-radius: 10px;
    font-family: 'Cambria Math', 'Times New Roman', serif;
    font-size: 1em;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    display: none;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  }

  /* Responsive */
  @media (max-width: 600px) {
    #header h1 { font-size: 1.1em; }
    .fragment { font-size: 0.85em; padding: 8px 12px; }
    .chain-slot .step-content { font-size: 0.9em; }
    #problem-display .eq { font-size: 1.2em; }
    .hud-item { min-width: 55px; }
    .hud-value { font-size: 1em; }
  }

  /* Math special chars */
  .math-frac {
    display: inline-flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    vertical-align: middle;
    margin: 0 3px;
  }
  .math-frac .num { border-bottom: 2px solid #ccc; padding: 0 5px 2px; }
  .math-frac .den { padding: 2px 5px 0; }

  .integral {
    font-size: 1.4em;
    font-style: italic;
    vertical-align: middle;
  }

  .dx-dy {
    font-style: italic;
    color: #00d4ff;
  }

  .var-y { color: #ff6bc1; font-style: italic; }
  .var-x { color: #00d4ff; font-style: italic; }
  .const-c { color: #ffcc00; font-style: italic; }
</style>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const katexOptions = {
        delimiters: [
            {left: '\\[', right: '\\]', display: true},
            {left: '\\(', right: '\\)', display: false},
            {left: '$$', right: '$$', display: true},
            {left: '$', right: '$', display: false}
        ],
        throwOnError: false,
        strict: false,
        trust: true
    };

    let renderTimeout;
    function safeRender() {
        if (renderTimeout) clearTimeout(renderTimeout);
        renderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);
        }, 100);
    }

    renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);

    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        let shouldRender = false;
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
            if (mutation.target &&
                mutation.target.className &&
                typeof mutation.target.className === 'string' &&
                mutation.target.className.includes('katex')) {
                return;
            }
            shouldRender = true;
        });

        if (shouldRender) {
            safeRender();
        }
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        characterData: true
    });

    setInterval(() => {
        const text = document.body.innerText;
        if (text.includes('\\(') || text.includes('$$')) {
            safeRender();
        }
    }, 2000);
});
</script>
