// ===== PARTICLE SYSTEM =====
const particleCanvas = document.getElementById('particle-canvas');
const pCtx = particleCanvas.getContext('2d');
let particles = [];

function resizeParticleCanvas() {
  particleCanvas.width = window.innerWidth;
  particleCanvas.height = window.innerHeight;
}
resizeParticleCanvas();
window.addEventListener('resize', resizeParticleCanvas);

function spawnParticles(x, y, color, count = 20) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const angle = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / count + Math.random() * 0.5;
    const speed = 2 + Math.random() * 4;
    particles.push({
      x, y,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
      life: 1,
      decay: 0.015 + Math.random() * 0.02,
      size: 3 + Math.random() * 5,
      color
    });
  }
}

function spawnConfetti(x, y) {
  const colors = ['#ff6bc1', '#00d4ff', '#7b2ff7', '#00ff88', '#ffcc00', '#ff4444'];
  for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const speed = 3 + Math.random() * 8;
    particles.push({
      x, y,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed - 3,
      life: 1,
      decay: 0.008 + Math.random() * 0.01,
      size: 4 + Math.random() * 6,
      color: colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)],
      gravity: 0.1
    });
  }
}

function updateParticles() {
  pCtx.clearRect(0, 0, particleCanvas.width, particleCanvas.height);
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx;
    p.y += p.vy;
    if (p.gravity) p.vy += p.gravity;
    p.life -= p.decay;
    if (p.life <= 0) {
      particles.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }
    pCtx.globalAlpha = p.life;
    pCtx.fillStyle = p.color;
    pCtx.beginPath();
    pCtx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * p.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    pCtx.fill();
  }
  pCtx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

// ===== DRAG AND DROP SYSTEM =====
let dragState = {
  active: false,
  element: null,
  fragmentId: null,
  ghost: null,
  offsetX: 0,
  offsetY: 0
};

function initDragAndDrop() {
  const container = document.getElementById('fragments-container');
  const chain = document.getElementById('solution-chain');

  // Mouse events
  container.addEventListener('mousedown', onDragStart);
  document.addEventListener('mousemove', onDragMove);
  document.addEventListener('mouseup', onDragEnd);

  // Touch events
  container.addEventListener('touchstart', onTouchStart, { passive: false });
  document.addEventListener('touchmove', onTouchMove, { passive: false });
  document.addEventListener('touchend', onTouchEnd);
}

function onDragStart(e) {
  if (!state.gameActive) return;
  const frag = e.target.closest('.fragment');
  if (!frag || frag.classList.contains('correct-placed')) return;

  e.preventDefault();
  const rect = frag.getBoundingClientRect();
  dragState.active = true;
  dragState.element = frag;
  dragState.fragmentId = frag.dataset.id;
  dragState.offsetX = e.clientX - rect.left;
  dragState.offsetY = e.clientY - rect.top;

  frag.classList.add('dragging');
  frag.style.opacity = '0.3';

  const ghost = document.getElementById('drag-ghost');
  ghost.textContent = frag.textContent;
  ghost.style.display = 'block';
  ghost.style.left = e.clientX + 'px';
  ghost.style.top = e.clientY + 'px';
  dragState.ghost = ghost;

  // Highlight target slots
  highlightSlot(state.currentStepIndex);
}

function onDragMove(e) {
  if (!dragState.active) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  const ghost = dragState.ghost;
  if (ghost) {
    ghost.style.left = e.clientX + 'px';
    ghost.style.top = e.clientY + 'px';
  }

  // Check hover over slots
  const slots = document.querySelectorAll('.chain-slot:not(.filled)');
  slots.forEach(slot => slot.classList.remove('highlight'));
  const target = document.elementFromPoint(e.clientX, e.clientY);
  if (target) {
    const slot = target.closest('.chain-slot:not(.filled)');
    if (slot) slot.classList.add('highlight');
  }
}

function onDragEnd(e) {
  if (!dragState.active) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  finishDrag(e.clientX, e.clientY);
}

function onTouchStart(e) {
  if (!state.gameActive) return;
  const touch = e.touches[0];
  const frag = touch.target.closest('.fragment');
  if (!frag || frag.classList.contains('correct-placed')) return;

  e.preventDefault();
  const rect = frag.getBoundingClientRect();
  dragState.active = true;
  dragState.element = frag;
  dragState.fragmentId = frag.dataset.id;
  dragState.offsetX = touch.clientX - rect.left;
  dragState.offsetY = touch.clientY - rect.top;

  frag.classList.add('dragging');
  frag.style.opacity = '0.3';

  const ghost = document.getElementById('drag-ghost');
  ghost.textContent = frag.textContent;
  ghost.style.display = 'block';
  ghost.style.left = touch.clientX + 'px';
  ghost.style.top = touch.clientY + 'px';
  dragState.ghost = ghost;

  highlightSlot(state.currentStepIndex);
}

function onTouchMove(e) {
  if (!dragState.active) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  const touch = e.touches[0];
  const ghost = dragState.ghost;
  if (ghost) {
    ghost.style.left = touch.clientX + 'px';
    ghost.style.top = touch.clientY + 'px';
  }

  const slots = document.querySelectorAll('.chain-slot:not(.filled)');
  slots.forEach(slot => slot.classList.remove('highlight'));
  const target = document.elementFromPoint(touch.clientX, touch.clientY);
  if (target) {
    const slot = target.closest('.chain-slot:not(.filled)');
    if (slot) slot.classList.add('highlight');
  }
}

function onTouchEnd(e) {
  if (!dragState.active) return;
  e.preventDefault();
  const touch = e.changedTouches[0];
  finishDrag(touch.clientX, touch.clientY);
}

function finishDrag(clientX, clientY) {
  const ghost = document.getElementById('drag-ghost');
  ghost.style.display = 'none';

  const frag = dragState.element;
  if (frag) {
    frag.classList.remove('dragging');
    frag.style.opacity = frag.classList.contains('distractor') ? '0.7' : '1';
  }

  // Check drop target
  const slots = document.querySelectorAll('.chain-slot:not(.filled)');
  slots.forEach(slot => slot.classList.remove('highlight'));

  const target = document.elementFromPoint(clientX, clientY);
  const slot = target ? target.closest('.chain-slot:not(.filled)') : null;

  if (slot && slot.dataset.slotIndex === String(state.currentStepIndex)) {
    handleFragmentDrop(slot, frag);
  }

  dragState.active = false;
  dragState.element = null;
  dragState.fragmentId = null;
  dragState.ghost = null;
}

function highlightSlot(index) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.chain-slot').forEach(s => s.classList.remove('highlight'));
  const slot = document.querySelector(`.chain-slot[data-slot-index="${index}"]`);
  if (slot) slot.classList.add('highlight');
}

function handleFragmentDrop(slot, fragment) {
  const slotIndex = parseInt(slot.dataset.slotIndex);
  const fragId = fragment.dataset.id;
  const level = LEVELS[state.currentLevel];
  const expectedStep = level.steps[slotIndex];

  // Check if this fragment matches the expected step
  const allFragments = [...level.steps, ...level.distractors];
  const droppedFragment = allFragments.find(f => f.text === fragment.textContent);

  if (droppedFragment.text === expectedStep.text) {
    // CORRECT!
    placeFragmentCorrect(slot, fragment, expectedStep);
  } else {
    // WRONG
    handleWrongPlacement(slot, fragment, droppedFragment, level);
  }
}

function placeFragmentCorrect(slot, fragment, step) {
  slot.classList.add('filled');
  slot.querySelector('.step-content').innerHTML = formatMath(step.text);
  slot.querySelector('.step-content').title = step.label;

  fragment.classList.add('correct-placed');
  fragment.style.cursor = 'default';

  state.currentStepIndex++;
  state.placedSteps.push(step);

  // Visual feedback
  const rect = slot.getBoundingClientRect();
  spawnParticles(rect.left + rect.width/2, rect.top + rect.height/2, '#00ff88', 15);

  // Check level complete
  const level = LEVELS[state.currentLevel];
  if (state.currentStepIndex >= level.steps.length) {
    setTimeout(() => completeLevel(), 500);
  }
}

function handleWrongPlacement(slot, fragment, fragData, level) {
  state.levelAttempts++;
  state.totalAttempts++;
  document.getElementById('attempts-display').textContent = state.levelAttempts;

  // Shake animation
  slot.classList.add('wrong');
  setTimeout(() => slot.classList.remove('wrong'), 600);

  // Bounce fragment back
  if (fragment) {
    fragment.style.transition = 'transform 0.3s ease';
    fragment.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)';
    setTimeout(() => {
      fragment.style.transform = '';
    }, 300);
  }

  // Show feedback
  const rule = fragData.rule || level.rules[fragData.text] || "这步有问题，请重新思考。";
  showFeedback(false, fragData.text, rule);

  // Red particle effect
  const rect = slot.getBoundingClientRect();
  spawnParticles(rect.left + rect.width/2, rect.top + rect.height/2, '#ff4444', 10);
}

// ===== MATH FORMATTING =====
function formatMath(text) {
  let html = text;

  // Replace dy/dx
  html = html.replace(/dy\/dx/g, '<span class="math-frac"><span class="num">d<span class="var-y">y</span></span><span class="den">d<span class="var-x">x</span></span></span>');

  // Replace dy/y
  html = html.replace(/dy\/y/g, '<span class="math-frac"><span class="num">d<span class="var-y">y</span></span><span class="den"><span class="var-y">y</span></span></span>');

  // Replace dx/x
  html = html.replace(/dx\/x/g, '<span class="math-frac"><span class="num">d<span class="var-x">x</span></span><span class="den"><span class="var-x">x</span></span></span>');

  // Replace ∫
  html = html.replace(/∫/g, '<span class="integral">∫</span>');

  // Replace ln|y| and ln|x|
  html = html.replace(/ln\|y\|/g, 'ln|<span class="var-y">y</span>|');
  html = html.replace(/ln\|x\|/g, 'ln|<span class="var-x">x</span>|');

  // Replace y and x variables (carefully)
  html = html.replace(/(?<![a-zA-Z/])([yY])(?![a-zA-Z/])/g, '<span class="var-y">$1</span>');
  html = html.replace(/(?<![a-zA-Z/])([xX])(?![a-zA-Z/])/g, '<span class="var-x">$1</span>');

  // Replace C
  html = html.replace(/\b(C)\b/g, '<span class="const-c">C</span>');

  // Replace eˣ and e⁻ˣ
  html = html.replace(/eˣ/g, 'e<sup><span class="var-x">x</span></sup>');
  html = html.replace(/e⁻ˣ/g, 'e<sup>−<span class="var-x">x</span></sup>');

  // Replace dx and dy
  html = html.replace(/dx\b/g, 'd<span class="var-x">x</span>');
  html = html.replace(/dy\b/g, 'd<span class="var-y">y</span>');

  return html;
}

// ===== FEEDBACK SYSTEM =====
function showFeedback(isSuccess, text, rule) {
  const panel = document.getElementById('feedback-panel');
  const icon = panel.querySelector('.feedback-icon');
  const title = panel.querySelector('.feedback-title');
  const msg = panel.querySelector('.feedback-msg');
  const ruleDiv = panel.querySelector('.feedback-rule');
  const retryBtn = panel.querySelector('.retry-btn');
  const nextBtn = panel.querySelector('.next-btn');

  if (isSuccess) {
    panel.className = 'show success';
    icon.textContent = '✅';
    title.textContent = '正确！';
    title.style.color = '#00ff88';
    msg.textContent = text;
    ruleDiv.style.display = 'none';
    retryBtn.style.display = 'none';
    nextBtn.style.display = 'inline-block';
  } else {
    panel.className = 'show';
    icon.textContent = '❌';
    title.textContent = '这步不对！';
    title.style.color = '#ff4444';
    msg.textContent = `你放置了：${text}`;
    ruleDiv.style.display = 'block';
    ruleDiv.innerHTML = `<span class="rule-name">违反的规则：</span>${rule}`;
    retryBtn.style.display = 'inline-block';
    nextBtn.style.display = 'none';
  }
}

function closeFeedback() {
  document.getElementById('feedback-panel').classList.remove('show');
}

// ===== LEVEL MANAGEMENT =====
function initLevel() {
  const level = LEVELS[state.currentLevel];
  state.currentStepIndex = 0;
  state.placedSteps = [];
  state.levelAttempts = 0;
  state.levelStartTime = Date.now();

  document.getElementById('level-badge').textContent = state.currentLevel + 1;
  document.getElementById('attempts-display').textContent = '0';
  document.getElementById('problem-eq').innerHTML = formatMath(level.problem);
  document.getElementById('problem-hint').textContent = level.hint;

  // Build solution chain slots
  const chain = document.getElementById('solution-chain');
  chain.innerHTML = '';

  level.steps.forEach((step, i) => {
    const slot = document.createElement('div');
    slot.className = 'chain-slot';
    slot.dataset.slotIndex = i;
    slot.innerHTML = `
      <div class="step-num">${i + 1}</div>
      <div class="step-content">?</div>
    `;
    chain.appendChild(slot);

    // Add arrow between steps
    if (i < level.steps.length - 1) {
      const arrow = document.createElement('div');
      arrow.className = 'arrow-down';
      arrow.textContent = '↓';
      chain.appendChild(arrow);
    }
  });

  // Build fragments pool (shuffle steps + distractors)
  const container = document.getElementById('fragments-container');
  container.innerHTML = '';

  // Combine correct steps and distractors, then shuffle
  const allItems = [...level.steps.map((s, i) => ({...s, type: 'correct', index: i})),
                     ...level.distractors.map((d, i) => ({...d, type: 'distractor', index: i}))];

  // Shuffle
  for (let i = allItems.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    [allItems[i], allItems[j]] = [allItems[j], allItems[i]];
  }

  allItems.forEach((item, i) => {
    const frag = document.createElement('div');
    frag.className = 'fragment' + (item.type === 'distractor' ? ' distractor' : '');
    frag.dataset.id = item.type + '-' + item.index;
    frag.textContent = item.text;
    frag.style.animationDelay = (i * 0.05) + 's';
    container.appendChild(frag);
  });

  highlightSlot(0);

  // Start timer
  if (state.timerInterval) clearInterval(state.timerInterval);
  state.elapsedSeconds = 0;
  state.timerInterval = setInterval(() => {
    if (state.gameActive) {
      state.elapsedSeconds++;
      const min = Math.floor(state.elapsedSeconds / 60);
      const sec = state.elapsedSeconds % 60;
      document.getElementById('timer-display').textContent =
        `${min}:${sec.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
    }
  }, 1000);
}

function completeLevel() {
  clearInterval(state.timerInterval);

  const level = LEVELS[state.currentLevel];
  const timeBonus = Math.max(0, 30 - state.elapsedSeconds);
  const attemptBonus = Math.max(0, 10 - state.levelAttempts) * 2;
  const levelScore = 10 + timeBonus + attemptBonus;

  state.score += levelScore;
  state.totalCorrect++;
  state.levelScores.push({
    level: state.currentLevel + 1,
    score: levelScore,
    attempts: state.levelAttempts,
    time: state.elapsedSeconds
  });

  document.getElementById('score-display').textContent = state.score;

  // Stars
  let stars = '⭐';
  if (state.levelAttempts === 0 && state.elapsedSeconds < 20) stars = '⭐⭐⭐';
  else if (state.levelAttempts <= 1 || state.elapsedSeconds < 30) stars = '⭐⭐';

  // Show level complete
  const overlay = document.getElementById('level-complete');
  overlay.querySelector('.stars').textContent = stars;
  overlay.querySelector('.score-detail').innerHTML =
    `基础分：10 | 速度奖励：+${timeBonus} | 尝试奖励：+${attemptBonus}<br>` +
    `本关得分：<strong>${levelScore}</strong> | 总尝试：${state.levelAttempts}次 | 用时：${state.elapsedSeconds}秒`;
  overlay.classList.add('show');

  // Confetti
  const rect = overlay.getBoundingClientRect();
  spawnConfetti(rect.width / 2 + rect.left, rect.height / 2 + rect.top);

  // Check achievements
  checkAchievements();
  saveProgress();
}

function nextLevel() {
  document.getElementById('level-complete').classList.remove('show');

  if (state.currentLevel + 1 >= LEVELS.length) {
    // All levels complete!
    showAllComplete();
    return;
  }

  state.currentLevel++;
  initLevel();
}

function showAllComplete() {
  const overlay = document.getElementById('level-complete');
  overlay.querySelector('h2').textContent = '🏆 全部通关！';
  overlay.querySelector('.stars').textContent = '👑';
  overlay.querySelector('.score-detail').innerHTML =
    `恭喜你完成了所有关卡！<br>总得分：<strong>${state.score}</strong><br>` +
    `总尝试次数：${state.totalAttempts}次`;

  const btn = overlay.querySelector('button');
  btn.textContent = '🔄 重新挑战';
  btn.onclick = function() {
    state.currentLevel = 0;
    state.score = 0;
    state.totalAttempts = 0;
    state.totalCorrect = 0;
    state.levelScores = [];
    document.getElementById('score-display').textContent = '0';
    overlay.querySelector('h2').textContent = '🎉 关卡完成！';
    btn.textContent = '下一关 ➡️';
    btn.onclick = nextLevel;
    overlay.classList.remove('show');
    initLevel();
  };
  overlay.classList.add('show');
  spawnConfetti(window.innerWidth/2, window.innerHeight/2);
  checkAchievements();
  saveProgress();
}

// ===== ACHIEVEMENTS =====
function checkAchievements() {
  const checks = [
    {
      id: 'first_solve',
      condition: state.totalCorrect >= 1,
      icon: '🌟',
      name: '初次成功',
      desc: '完成第一个关卡'
    },
    {
      id: 'speed_demon',
      condition: state.levelScores.some(s => s.time <= 15),
      icon: '⚡',
      name: '闪电求解',
      desc: '在15秒内完成关卡'
    },
    {
      id: 'perfect_run',
      condition: state.levelScores.some(s => s.attempts === 0),
      icon: '💎',
      name: '完美通关',
      desc: '零失误完成关卡'
    },
    {
      id: 'all_clear',
      condition: state.totalCorrect >= LEVELS.length,
      icon: '🏆',
      name: '全部通关',
      desc: '完成所有关卡'
    },
    {
      id: 'no_errors',
      condition: state.totalAttempts === 0 && state.totalCorrect >= LEVELS.length,
      icon: '👑',
      name: '零失误大师',
      desc: '所有关卡零失误完成'
    }
  ];

  checks.forEach(check => {
    if (check.condition && !state.unlockedAchievements.includes(check.id)) {
      state.unlockedAchievements.push(check.id);
      setTimeout(() => showAchievement(check), 800);
    }
  });
}

function showAchievement(ach) {
  const popup = document.getElementById('achievement-popup');
  popup.querySelector('.ach-icon').textContent = ach.icon;
  popup.querySelector('.ach-title').textContent = '🏅 ' + ach.name;
  popup.querySelector('.ach-desc').textContent = ach.desc;
  popup.classList.add('show');

  setTimeout(() => popup.classList.remove('show'), 3500);
}

// ===== GAME LOOP =====
function gameLoop() {
  updateParticles();
  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

// ===== GLOBAL FUNCTIONS (for onclick) =====
window.startGame = function() {
  document.getElementById('start-screen').classList.add('hidden');
  state.gameActive = true;
  state.currentLevel = 0;
  state.score = 0;
  state.totalAttempts = 0;
  state.totalCorrect = 0;
  document.getElementById('score-display').textContent = '0';
  initLevel();
  initDragAndDrop();
  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
};

window.pauseGame = function() {
  state.gameActive = false;
  clearInterval(state.timerInterval);
  document.getElementById('pause-overlay').classList.add('show');
};

window.resumeGame = function() {
  state.gameActive = true;
  document.getElementById('pause-overlay').classList.remove('show');
  state.timerInterval = setInterval(() => {
    if (state.gameActive) {
      state.elapsedSeconds++;
      const min = Math.floor(state.elapsedSeconds / 60);
      const sec = state.elapsedSeconds % 60;
      document.getElementById('timer-display').textContent =
        `${min}:${sec.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
    }
  }, 1000);
};

window.restartGame = function() {
  document.getElementById('pause-overlay').classList.remove('show');
  state.gameActive = true;
  state.currentLevel = 0;
  state.score = 0;
  state.totalAttempts = 0;
  state.totalCorrect = 0;
  state.levelScores = [];
  state.elapsedSeconds = 0;
  document.getElementById('score-display').textContent = '0';
  document.getElementById('timer-display').textContent = '0:00';
  initLevel();
};

window.closeFeedback = function() {
  document.getElementById('feedback-panel').classList.remove('show');
};

window.nextLevel = nextLevel;

// Start particle loop
requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);

});
</script>
</body>
</html>

widgetConfig.description: 拖拽算式碎片，修复分离变量法求解步骤的逻辑链

actions.text: 本场景通过交互探索“可分离变量与一阶线性方程：误解修复挑战”。把 dy/dx 拆开，让 y 的‘家当’和 x 的‘家当’各归各位。现在，让我们通过一个拼图游戏，来检验一下这个‘分家’的逻辑，看看有没有同学会不小心把积分符号放错位置。

actions.content: 点击这里开始第一个挑战。

actions.text: 大家为大家准备了一些碎裂的求解步骤，还混进了一些错误的干扰项，比如把积分常数 C 写在左边，或者把 dy 和 dx 的微分符号搞反。你的任务就是把这些正确碎片拼接起来，组成完整的分离变量法求解路径。
大家在拖拽的时候，要时时刻刻在心里问自己：这个积分号，是打在 x 这边的墙壁上，还是打在 y 这边的墙壁上？如果你放错了地方，碎片可是会弹回来的哦。

actions.content: 集中注意力，准备拖拽修复逻辑链。

actions.text: 记住，积分常数 C 代表了那一类函数的所有可能性，它通常是在两边积分完成后，在等式的一侧产生的。让我们开始动手，把断掉的逻辑线修复好，看谁能够零失误通关！

scenes.title: 可分离变量与一阶线性方程：空间视角

content.html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>可分离变量与一阶线性方程：空间视角</title>
  <style>
    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #0a0a1a;
      font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
    }
    #canvas-container { width: 100%; height: 100%; position: relative; }
    canvas { display: block; }

    #loading {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
      background: #0a0a1a;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: #aaa;
      font-size: 16px;
      z-index: 1000;
    }
    #loading .spinner {
      width: 40px; height: 40px;
      border: 3px solid #333;
      border-top-color: #6366f1;
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: spin 1s linear infinite;
      margin: 0 auto 16px;
    }
    @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

    #controls {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      background: rgba(20, 20, 30, 0.92);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      padding: 14px 12px 20px;
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 10px;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    }

    .control-group {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
      min-width: 90px;
    }

    label {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #aaa;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }

    input[type="range"] {
      width: 100%;
      height: 6px;
      -webkit-appearance: none;
      background: #333;
      border-radius: 3px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb {
      -webkit-appearance: none;
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      background: #6366f1;
      border-radius: 50%;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    button {
      padding: 10px 16px;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: #333;
      color: white;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 13px;
      min-width: 44px;
      min-height: 44px;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }

    button:hover { background: #444; }
    button:active { transform: scale(0.95); }
    button.primary { background: #6366f1; }
    button.primary:hover { background: #5558e8; }
    button.success { background: #10b981; }
    button.success:hover { background: #059669; }

    .zoom-btns {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    .zoom-btns button {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      font-size: 22px;
      font-weight: bold;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 0;
    }

    #info {
      position: absolute;
      top: 16px;
      left: 16px;
      background: rgba(20, 20, 30, 0.88);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      padding: 14px 16px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      max-width: 300px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      color: #ddd;
      font-size: 13px;
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    #info h2 {
      font-size: 15px;
      color: #fbbf24;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    #info .equation {
      background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.15);
      border: 1px solid rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.3);
      border-radius: 6px;
      padding: 8px 10px;
      margin: 8px 0;
      font-family: 'Georgia', serif;
      font-size: 14px;
      color: #e0e7ff;
      text-align: center;
    }

    #info .term {
      color: #60a5fa;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    #info .highlight {
      color: #fbbf24;
    }

    /* Verification panel */
    #verification-panel {
      position: absolute;
      top: 16px;
      right: 16px;
      background: rgba(20, 20, 30, 0.9);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      padding: 14px 16px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      width: 260px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      color: #ddd;
      font-size: 12px;
      display: none;
      max-height: 70vh;
      overflow-y: auto;
    }

    #verification-panel h3 {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: #34d399;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    #verification-panel .row {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 4px 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    }

    #verification-panel .row .label { color: #888; }
    #verification-panel .row .value { color: #e0e7ff; font-family: monospace; }
    #verification-panel .match { color: #34d399; }
    #verification-panel .mismatch { color: #f87171; }

    #verification-panel .close-btn {
      position: absolute;
      top: 8px;
      right: 10px;
      background: none;
      border: none;
      color: #888;
      font-size: 18px;
      cursor: pointer;
      min-width: auto;
      min-height: auto;
      padding: 2px 6px;
    }

    .toggle-indicator {
      display: inline-block;
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      margin-right: 4px;
    }

    .toggle-on { background: #34d399; box-shadow: 0 0 6px #34d399; }
    .toggle-off { background: #555; }

    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      #info { display: none; }
      #verification-panel { width: 200px; font-size: 11px; }
      #controls { padding: 10px 6px 18px; gap: 8px; }
      .control-group { min-width: 70px; }
    }
  </style>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const katexOptions = {
        delimiters: [
            {left: '\\[', right: '\\]', display: true},
            {left: '\\(', right: '\\)', display: false},
            {left: '$$', right: '$$', display: true},
            {left: '$', right: '$', display: false}
        ],
        throwOnError: false,
        strict: false,
        trust: true
    };

    let renderTimeout;
    function safeRender() {
        if (renderTimeout) clearTimeout(renderTimeout);
        renderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);
        }, 100);
    }

    renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);

    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        let shouldRender = false;
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
            if (mutation.target &&
                mutation.target.className &&
                typeof mutation.target.className === 'string' &&
                mutation.target.className.includes('katex')) {
                return;
            }
            shouldRender = true;
        });

        if (shouldRender) {
            safeRender();
        }
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        characterData: true
    });

    setInterval(() => {
        const text = document.body.innerText;
        if (text.includes('\\(') || text.includes('$$')) {
            safeRender();
        }
    }, 2000);
});

    import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';

        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        return !!(window.WebGLRenderingContext &&

      } catch(e) {

    async function initScene() {

        if (!checkWebGL()) throw new Error('WebGL not supported');

        const container = document.getElementById('canvas-container');
        const width = container.clientWidth || window.innerWidth;
        const height = container.clientHeight || window.innerHeight;
        if (width === 0 || height === 0) throw new Error('Container has zero dimensions');

        // Scene
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x0a0a1a);
        scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(0x0a0a1a, 0.012);

        // Camera
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(55, width / height, 0.1, 500);
        camera.position.set(8, 10, 12);

        // Renderer
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, alpha: false });
        renderer.setSize(width, height);
        renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
        renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
        container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Controls
        const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
        controls.enableDamping = true;
        controls.dampingFactor = 0.06;
        controls.target.set(0, 2, 0);

        // Lighting
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.5);
        scene.add(ambientLight);

        const hemiLight = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0x8899ff, 0x444444, 0.5);
        scene.add(hemiLight);

        const dirLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.0);
        dirLight.position.set(8, 15, 8);
        dirLight.castShadow = true;
        scene.add(dirLight);

        const pointLight = new THREE.PointLight(0x6366f1, 0.6, 30);
        pointLight.position.set(-5, 8, -5);
        scene.add(pointLight);

        const objects = {};

        // State
        let cValue = 1;
        let animationSpeed = 1;
        let equationType = 0; // 0: dy/dx=y, 1: dy/dx=x*y, 2: dy/dx=y+x
        let validationMode = true;
        let draggingInitialPoint = false;
        let initialPointY = 1;
        const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
        const mouse = new THREE.Vector2();
        const dragPlane = new THREE.Plane(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), 0);

        const equations = [
          { label: "dy/dx = y", f: (x, y) => y, name: "可分离变量" },
          { label: "dy/dx = x·y", f: (x, y) => x * y, name: "可分离变量" },
          { label: "dy/dx = y + x", f: (x, y) => y + x, name: "一阶线性" }
        ];

        // Coordinate axes
        function createAxis(color, length, direction, label) {
          const group = new THREE.Group();
          const points = [new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0), direction.clone().multiplyScalar(length)];
          const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(points);
          const material = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color, linewidth: 2 });
          const line = new THREE.Line(geometry, material);
          group.add(line);

          // Arrow head
          const arrowGeo = new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.15, 0.5, 8);
          const arrowMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color });
          const arrow = new THREE.Mesh(arrowGeo, arrowMat);
          arrow.position.copy(direction.clone().multiplyScalar(length));
          if (direction.y > 0) arrow.rotation.z = Math.PI;
          else if (direction.x > 0) { arrow.rotation.z = -Math.PI / 2; }
          else if (direction.z > 0) { arrow.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2; }
          group.add(arrow);

          // Label sprite
          const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
          canvas.width = 128; canvas.height = 64;
          const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
          ctx.fillStyle = '#' + color.toString(16).padStart(6, '0');
          ctx.font = 'bold 36px Arial';
          ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText(label, 64, 42);
          const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
          const spriteMat = new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: texture, transparent: true });
          const sprite = new THREE.Sprite(spriteMat);
          sprite.position.copy(direction.clone().multiplyScalar(length + 0.5));
          sprite.scale.set(1.2, 0.6, 1);
          group.add(sprite);

        }

        const xSize = 8;
        objects.xAxis = createAxis(0x60a5fa, xSize + 2, new THREE.Vector3(1, 0, 0), 'x');
        objects.yAxis = createAxis(0x34d399, xSize + 2, new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), 'y');
        objects.zAxis = createAxis(0xf472b6, xSize + 2, new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1), 'dy/dx');
        scene.add(objects.xAxis);
        scene.add(objects.yAxis);
        scene.add(objects.zAxis);

        // Grid on x-y plane
        const gridHelper = new THREE.GridHelper(xSize * 2, 16, 0x1a1a3a, 0x111128);
        gridHelper.position.y = 0;
        scene.add(gridHelper);

        // Slope surface: z = f(x,y)
        function buildSlopeSurface() {
          if (objects.slopeSurface) scene.remove(objects.slopeSurface);
          const eq = equations[equationType];
          const res = 30;
          const geo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(xSize * 2, xSize * 2, res, res);
          geo.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2);
          const pos = geo.attributes.position;
          const colors = new Float32Array(pos.count * 3);

          for (let i = 0; i < pos.count; i++) {
            const x = pos.getX(i);
            const y = pos.getY(i);
            const z = eq.f(x, y);
            pos.setZ(i, Math.max(-4, Math.min(4, z)));

            // Color by slope magnitude
            const t = Math.min(1, Math.abs(z) / 4);
            const c = new THREE.Color().lerpColors(
              new THREE.Color(0x1e3a5f),
              new THREE.Color(0xf59e0b),
              t
            );
            colors[i * 3] = c.r;
            colors[i * 3 + 1] = c.g;
            colors[i * 3 + 2] = c.b;
          }

          geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
          geo.computeVertexNormals();

          const mat = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
            vertexColors: true,
            transparent: true,
            opacity: 0.45,
            side: THREE.DoubleSide,
            depthWrite: false
          });

          const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
          objects.slopeSurface = mesh;
          scene.add(mesh);
        }
        buildSlopeSurface();

        // Direction field arrows on the surface
        function buildDirectionField() {
          if (objects.directionField) scene.remove(objects.directionField);
          const group = new THREE.Group();
          const eq = equations[equationType];
          const spacing = 1.2;
          const range = 5;

          for (let x = -range; x <= range; x += spacing) {

              const slope = eq.f(x, y);
              if (Math.abs(slope) > 5) continue;

              const angle = Math.atan2(slope, 1);
              const len = 0.35;
              const dx = Math.cos(angle) * len;
              const dy = Math.sin(angle) * len;
              const dz = slope * 0.3;

              const points = [
                new THREE.Vector3(x - dx / 2, y - dy / 2, Math.min(4, Math.max(-4, slope)) - 0.2),

              const lineMat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({

                transparent: true,
                opacity: 0.4

              group.add(new THREE.Line(lineGeo, lineMat));

          objects.directionField = group;
          scene.add(group);

        buildDirectionField();

        // Solution curves
        function computeSolutionPoints(c, xStart, xEnd, steps) {
          const eq = equations[equationType];
          const points = [];
          const dx = (xEnd - xStart) / steps;

          // Use numerical integration (Euler's method) for visualization
          for (let ci = -2.5; ci <= 2.5; ci += 0.5) {
            let y = ci;
            const curvePoints = [];
            for (let x = xStart; x <= xEnd; x += dx * 0.5) {
              curvePoints.push(new THREE.Vector3(x, y, 0));

              if (Math.abs(slope) > 10) break;
              y += slope * dx;

            if (curvePoints.length > 2) points.push(curvePoints);

        function buildSolutionCurves() {

          const group = new THREE.Group();
          const curves = computeSolutionPoints(cValue, -5, 5, 200);

          const hueStep = 0.12;
          curves.forEach((curve, i) => {
            const points3D = curve.map(p => new THREE.Vector3(p.x, p.y, 0.05 + Math.sin(p.x * 0.5) * 0.02));
            const curveGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(points3D);

            const hue = (i * hueStep + 0.5) % 1;
            const color = new THREE.Color().setHSL(hue, 0.7, 0.55);

            const curveMat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({
              color,
              linewidth: 2,
              transparent: true,
              opacity: 0.8

            group.add(curveLine);

            // Highlight the curve closest to our C value

              curveLine.material.linewidth = 3;

              const tubeGeo = new THREE.TubeGeometry(tubeCurve, 80, 0.04, 8, false);

                emissive: color.clone().multiplyScalar(0.3),
                transparent: true,
                opacity: 0.9

              tubeMesh.userData = { curveIndex: i, isHighlighted: true };
              group.add(tubeMesh);
              objects.highlightedCurve = tubeMesh;
            }
          });

          objects.solutionCurves = group;
          scene.add(group);

        // Draggable initial point
        function createInitialPoint() {

          const mat = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
            color: 0xfbbf24,
            emissive: 0xf59e0b,
            emissiveIntensity: 0.5,
            shininess: 100
          });
          const sphere = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
          sphere.position.set(0, initialPointY, 0.3);
          sphere.userData = { draggable: true };
          objects.initialPoint = sphere;
          scene.add(sphere);

          // Glow ring
          const ringGeo = new THREE.RingGeometry(0.25, 0.35, 32);
          const ringMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
            color: 0xfbbf24,
            transparent: true,
            opacity: 0.5,
            side: THREE.DoubleSide
          });
          const ring = new THREE.Mesh(ringGeo, ringMat);
          ring.position.copy(sphere.position);
          ring.userData = { isRing: true };
          objects.initialPointRing = ring;
          scene.add(ring);
        }
        createInitialPoint();

        function buildVerificationMarkers() {
          if (objects.verificationMarkers) scene.remove(objects.verificationMarkers);
          const group = new THREE.Group();
          const eq = equations[equationType];

          // Place markers along the highlighted curve
          const xValues = [-3, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3];
          xValues.forEach(x => {
            // Find y on the curve closest to cValue using Euler
            let y = cValue;
            const dx = 0.05;
            for (let xi = 0; xi <= x; xi += 0.05) {
              y += eq.f(xi, y) * dx;
            }
            if (Math.abs(y) > 8) return;

            const slope = eq.f(x, y);
            if (Math.abs(slope) > 10) return;

            // Small sphere marker
            const markerGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.08, 12, 12);
            const markerMat = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
              color: 0x34d399,
              emissive: 0x10b981,
              emissiveIntensity: 0.3
            });
            const marker = new THREE.Mesh(markerGeo, markerMat);
            marker.position.set(x, y, 0.3);
            marker.userData = { x, y, slope, isMarker: true };
            group.add(marker);

            // Tangent line
            const angle = Math.atan2(slope, 1);
            const tLen = 0.5;
            const tPoints = [
              new THREE.Vector3(x - Math.cos(angle) * tLen, y - Math.sin(angle) * tLen, 0.35),
              new THREE.Vector3(x + Math.cos(angle) * tLen, y + Math.sin(angle) * tLen, 0.35)
            ];
            const tGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(tPoints);
            const tMat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0xf472b6, transparent: true, opacity: 0.6 });
            const tangent = new THREE.Line(tGeo, tMat);
            tangent.userData = { isTangent: true };

          scene.add(group);
        }

        // Starfield background
        function createStarfield() {

          const positions = new Float32Array(count * 3);
          for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {

            positions[i * 3 + 1] = Math.random() * 60 + 5;
            positions[i * 3 + 2] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 100;
          }
          const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
          geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
          const mat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({
            color: 0xffffff,
            size: 0.15,
            transparent: true,
            opacity: 0.6
          });
          const stars = new THREE.Points(geo, mat);
          scene.add(stars);

          mouse.x = ((clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
          mouse.y = -((clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;

          const intersection = new THREE.Vector3();

            Math.pow(intersection.x - ip.x, 2) + Math.pow(intersection.z - ip.z, 2)

          if (dist < 1.5) {

            controls.enabled = false;

          const intersection = getIntersection(event);
          if (!intersection) return;

          const newY = Math.max(-4, Math.min(4, intersection.y));
          initialPointY = newY;
          objects.initialPoint.position.set(0, newY, 0.3);
          objects.initialPointRing.position.set(0, newY, 0.3);

          cValue = newY;
          document.getElementById('c-slider').value = cValue;

          buildSolutionCurves();
          if (validationMode) buildVerificationMarkers();
        }

        function onPointerUp() {
          if (draggingInitialPoint) {
            draggingInitialPoint = false;
            controls.enabled = true;
          }

        renderer.domElement.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove);
        renderer.domElement.addEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp);

        // Click on curve to show verification
        renderer.domElement.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
          if (draggingInitialPoint) return;
          const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
          mouse.x = ((event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
          mouse.y = -((event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;

          raycaster.setFromCamera(mouse, camera);

          if (objects.verificationMarkers) {
            const markerMeshes = [];
            objects.verificationMarkers.traverse(child => {
              if (child.userData && child.userData.isMarker) markerMeshes.push(child);
            });

            const intersects = raycaster.intersectObjects(markerMeshes);
            if (intersects.length > 0) {
              const data = intersects[0].object.userData;
              showVerificationDetail(data.x, data.y, data.slope);
            }
          }
        });

        function showVerificationDetail(x, y, slope) {
          const eq = equations[equationType];
          const panel = document.getElementById('verification-panel');
          const content = document.getElementById('verification-content');

          const expectedSlope = eq.f(x, y);
          const match = Math.abs(slope - expectedSlope) < 0.01;

          content.innerHTML = `
            <div class="row">
              <span class="label">位置 (x, y)</span>
              <span class="value">(${x.toFixed(1)}, ${y.toFixed(3)})</span>
            </div>
            <div class="row">
              <span class="label">方程: ${eq.label}</span>
              <span class="value">${eq.name}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="row">
              <span class="label">dy/dx (方程计算)</span>
              <span class="value">${expectedSlope.toFixed(4)}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="row">
              <span class="label">dy/dx (曲线切线)</span>
              <span class="value">${slope.toFixed(4)}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="row" style="margin-top:8px;padding-top:8px;border-top:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);">
              <span class="label">匹配结果</span>
              <span class="value ${match ? 'match' : 'mismatch'}">${match ? '✅ 匹配!' : '❌ 不匹配'}</span>
            </div>
            <div style="margin-top:10px;padding:8px;background:rgba(99,102,241,0.1);border-radius:6px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;color:#aaa;">
              💡 <strong>验证原理：</strong>在该点处，曲线的切线斜率应与方程给出的 dy/dx 值一致。若两者匹配，说明该曲线是方程的解。
            </div>
          `;

          panel.style.display = 'block';
        }

        // Slider controls
        document.getElementById('c-slider').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
          cValue = parseFloat(e.target.value);
          initialPointY = cValue;
          objects.initialPoint.position.set(0, cValue, 0.3);
          objects.initialPointRing.position.set(0, cValue, 0.3);
          buildSolutionCurves();
          if (validationMode) buildVerificationMarkers();
        });

        document.getElementById('speed-slider').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
          animationSpeed = parseFloat(e.target.value);
        });

        // Equation toggle
        document.getElementById('toggle-eq-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
          equationType = (equationType + 1) % equations.length;
          document.getElementById('toggle-eq-btn').textContent = `切换 ${equations[equationType].label}`;
          buildSlopeSurface();
          buildDirectionField();
          buildSolutionCurves();
          if (validationMode) buildVerificationMarkers();
        });

        // Validation toggle
        document.getElementById('toggle-validation').addEventListener('click', () => {
          validationMode = !validationMode;
          const dot = document.getElementById('validation-dot');
          dot.className = validationMode ? 'toggle-indicator toggle-on' : 'toggle-indicator toggle-off';

          if (validationMode) {
            buildVerificationMarkers();
          } else {
            if (objects.verificationMarkers) {
              scene.remove(objects.verificationMarkers);
              objects.verificationMarkers = null;
            }
            document.getElementById('verification-panel').style.display = 'none';
          }
        });

        // Zoom controls
        document.getElementById('zoom-in-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
          const direction = new THREE.Vector3();
          camera.getWorldDirection(direction);
          camera.position.addScaledVector(direction, 3);
        });

        document.getElementById('zoom-out-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
          const direction = new THREE.Vector3();
          camera.getWorldDirection(direction);
          camera.position.addScaledVector(direction, -3);
        });

        // Reset
        document.getElementById('reset-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
          camera.position.set(8, 10, 12);
          controls.target.set(0, 2, 0);
          cValue = 1;
          initialPointY = 1;
          equationType = 0;
          document.getElementById('c-slider').value = 1;
          document.getElementById('speed-slider').value = 1;
          animationSpeed = 1;
          document.getElementById('toggle-eq-btn').textContent = '切换 dy/dx = y';
          objects.initialPoint.position.set(0, 1, 0.3);
          objects.initialPointRing.position.set(0, 1, 0.3);
          buildSlopeSurface();
          buildDirectionField();
          buildSolutionCurves();
          if (validationMode) buildVerificationMarkers();
        });

        // Animation loop
        let time = 0;
        function animate() {
          requestAnimationFrame(animate);
          time += 0.016 * animationSpeed;

          controls.update();

          // Animate initial point ring
          if (objects.initialPointRing) {
            const ring = objects.initialPointRing;
            ring.rotation.z = time * 0.5;
            ring.material.opacity = 0.3 + Math.sin(time * 2) * 0.2;
            ring.scale.setScalar(1 + Math.sin(time * 3) * 0.1);
          }

          // Pulse highlighted curve
          if (objects.highlightedCurve) {
            objects.highlightedCurve.material.emissiveIntensity = 0.3 + Math.sin(time * 2) * 0.15;
          }

          // Animate slope surface subtly
          if (objects.slopeSurface) {
            objects.slopeSurface.material.opacity = 0.4 + Math.sin(time * 0.5) * 0.05;
          }

          // Animate verification markers
          if (objects.verificationMarkers) {
            objects.verificationMarkers.children.forEach(child => {
              if (child.userData && child.userData.isMarker) {
                const s = 0.08 + Math.sin(time * 3 + child.userData.x) * 0.02;
                child.scale.setScalar(s / 0.08);
              }
            });
          }

          renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }
        animate();

        // Resize
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
          const newWidth = container.clientWidth || window.innerWidth;
          const newHeight = container.clientHeight || window.innerHeight;
          camera.aspect = newWidth / newHeight;
          camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
          renderer.setSize(newWidth, newHeight);
        });

        // postMessage listener for teacher actions
        window.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
          const { action, payload } = event.data || {};

          switch (action) {
            case 'SET_WIDGET_STATE': {
              if (payload.cameraPosition) {
                camera.position.set(...payload.cameraPosition);
              }
              if (payload.cameraTarget) {
                controls.target.set(...payload.cameraTarget);
              }
              if (payload.cValue !== undefined) {
                cValue = payload.cValue;
                initialPointY = cValue;
                objects.initialPoint.position.set(0, cValue, 0.3);
                objects.initialPointRing.position.set(0, cValue, 0.3);
                document.getElementById('c-slider').value = cValue;
                buildSolutionCurves();
                if (validationMode) buildVerificationMarkers();
              }
              if (payload.equationType !== undefined) {
                equationType = payload.equationType;
                buildSlopeSurface();
                buildDirectionField();
                buildSolutionCurves();
              }
              break;
            }

            case 'HIGHLIGHT_ELEMENT': {
              const { elementId, highlight } = payload;
              if (elementId === 'initialPoint' && objects.initialPoint) {
                objects.initialPoint.material.emissiveIntensity = highlight ? 1.0 : 0.5;
                objects.initialPoint.material.color.set(highlight ? 0xff6b6b : 0xfbbf24);
              }
              if (elementId === 'slopeSurface' && objects.slopeSurface) {
                objects.slopeSurface.material.opacity = highlight ? 0.7 : 0.45;
              }
              if (elementId === 'solutionCurves' && objects.solutionCurves) {
                objects.solutionCurves.traverse(child => {
                  if (child.isLine && child.material) {
                    child.material.opacity = highlight ? 1.0 : 0.8;
                  }
                });
              }
              if (elementId === 'directionField' && objects.directionField) {
                objects.directionField.traverse(child => {
                  if (child.isLine && child.material) {
                    child.material.opacity = highlight ? 0.8 : 0.4;
                  }
                });
              }
              break;
            }

            case 'ANNOTATE_ELEMENT': {
              const { elementId, text } = payload;
              if (elementId === 'initialPoint' && objects.initialPoint) {
                // Remove existing annotation
                if (objects.annotation) scene.remove(objects.annotation);

                const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
                canvas.width = 256; canvas.height = 64;
                const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
                ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.9)';
                ctx.roundRect(0, 0, 256, 64, 12);
                ctx.fill();
                ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
                ctx.font = 'bold 18px Arial';
                ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                ctx.fillText(text || '初始点 (C = ' + cValue.toFixed(1) + ')', 128, 38);

                const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
                const spriteMat = new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: texture, transparent: true });
                const sprite = new THREE.Sprite(spriteMat);
                sprite.position.copy(objects.initialPoint.position);
                sprite.position.y += 0.7;
                sprite.scale.set(2, 0.5, 1);
                objects.annotation = sprite;
                scene.add(sprite);
              }
              break;
            }
          }
        });

        // Hide loading
        document.getElementById('loading').style.display = 'none';

      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Scene initialization failed:', error);
        document.getElementById('loading').innerHTML =
          `<div style="text-align:center;color:#ff6b6b;">
            <div style="font-size:24px;margin-bottom:16px;">⚠️</div>
            3D 场景加载失败<br>
            <small style="color:#888;">${error.message}</small><br>
            <button onclick="location.reload()" style="margin-top:16px;padding:8px 16px;background:#6366f1;color:white;border:none;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;">重试</button>
          </div>`;
      }
    }

    initScene();
  </script>

questions.analysis: 参考解释：想象一个雪球从山上滚下。雪球当前粘的雪越多（存量 P 大），它在滚动一圈时能粘上的新雪（增量 dP/dt）也越多。所以，每过一段相同的时间，新粘上的雪并不是一个常数，而是随着雪球变大而变得越来越多。这就导致雪球不是匀速变大，而是滚得越远，变大得越快，最终呈现出爆炸式的高速增长。
questions.question: 承接上一题。请用微积分直觉简要描述：为什么“增长与存量成正比”的关系，最终会让数量呈现出“越来越多、越增越快”的爆炸式或指数式曲线，而不是一条简单的匀速直线？不要进行公式推导，请用直观的“雪球效应”或类似比喻来解释。

actions.text: 这是一组关于“形成性测验：检查第一组场景并承接下一组知识点”的独立测验。好了，刚才我们花了些时间在空间视角里感受了斜率场，也动手验证了曲线上的解。现在是时候检验一下我们前两部分探索的成果了。大家放轻松，这个测验的目的是帮我们回顾关键证据，并为接下来的新模型做铺垫。
请先独立完成这五道题。前三道选择题直接回顾了我们在场景 3 的斜率场预测和场景 8 的方程分类，想一想你当时拖动的图形和找到的规律。最后两道是衔接下一组场景的‘预诊断’题，没有对错之分，就看你对‘变化率与存量’的直觉能走多远。
做完了吗？那我们一起来看看。第一题，斜率场里特定点上的小线段，它给出的斜率就是微分方程在该点的导数 dy/dx 的近似值，这是整个变化的核心信息。第二题，区分微分方程的关键，就在于它必须包含未知函数的导数，并且描述的是变量间的变化率关系，这一点大家在分类时整理得很清晰。
第三题，顺着斜率场里的一条‘流动线’追踪下去，你找到的就是微分方程的一条积分曲线，也叫解曲线。至于第四和第五题，‘增长速度与存量成正比’的背后逻辑，就像小雪球从山顶滚下，它越滚大、表面积越大，粘的雪就越多，长得也就越快，这就是一种指数式的自我强化效应，而不是匀速的简单累加。本场景中，我们就会重点探索这类指数模型。

actions.text: 本场景聚焦“指数增长与衰减模型”。现在我们就正式进入指数增长与衰减模型。这张图展示的，就是自然界里最常见的一类变化规律。
它的核心只有一句话：增长率与当前状态成正比。什么意思呢？就是存量越大，长得越快；存量越小，衰减得也越慢。不是均匀地增加，而是像滚雪球一样，自我放大。
用数学语言写出来，就是这个简单的微分方程 dy/dt = k y。左边是变化率，右边是当前值 y 乘上一个常数比例 k。注意，这里最关键的是 y 出现在等式右边，意味着变化率和状态本身直接挂钩。
k 大于 0 时，就是指数增长；k 小于 0 时，就是指数衰减。这个 k 就是比例系数，决定了变化是正向放大还是反向收缩。
这里有一个常见的误解需要提前纠正。很多人一看到“指数”两个字，脑子里就只有 e 的 x 次方。但指数模型本质上不是死记一个函数形式，而是源于“比例增长”这条底层规则。只要变化率和存量成正比，结果自然就是指数形式。
所以，这条规则的核心后果就是：状态随时间呈指数级变化，而不是线性变化。这也是为什么它在人口增长、放射性衰变、复利计算里会反复出现。先抓住这个“比例变化”的感觉，后面的方程求解就会轻松很多。

      min-width: 320px;
      max-height: 100vh;

      border-bottom: none;
      border-right: 2px solid #334155;

      overflow: visible;

  .collapse-btn {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 10px;
    background: #334155;
    color: #94a3b8;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 8px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 14px;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    min-height: 44px;
  }

  .panel-title {
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #a78bfa;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }
  .panel-subtitle {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #64748b;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }

  .control-group {
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }
  .control-label {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #cbd5e1;
  }
  .control-label .var-name {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #e2e8f0;
  }
  .control-label .var-value {
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
    color: #a78bfa;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 14px;
    background: #0f172a;
    padding: 2px 8px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    min-width: 70px;
    text-align: right;
  }

  input[type="range"] {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    width: 100%;
    height: 32px;
    background: transparent;
    cursor: pointer;
    touch-action: none;
  }
  input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-runnable-track {
    height: 6px;
    border-radius: 3px;
    background: #334155;
  }

    -webkit-appearance: none;
    width: 24px;
    height: 24px;
    border-radius: 50%;

    height: 6px;
    border-radius: 3px;

    width: 24px;
    height: 24px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #a78bfa;
    border: 2px solid #7c3aed;

  .slider-row {
    display: flex;

    font-size: 10px;
    color: #475569;
    margin-top: 2px;

  .info-display {
    background: #0f172a;
    border: 1px solid #334155;
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }
  .info-title {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #64748b;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }
  .info-row {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 3px 0;
    font-size: 13px;
  }
  .info-row .label {
    color: #94a3b8;
  }
  .info-row .value {
    font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #34d399;
  }
  .info-row .value.highlight {
    color: #fbbf24;
    font-size: 15px;

  .formula-box {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a2e, #16213e);
    border: 1px solid #4f46e5;
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    text-align: center;
  }
  .formula-box .formula {
    font-family: 'Georgia', 'Times New Roman', serif;
    font-size: 18px;
    color: #e2e8f0;
    margin: 4px 0;
  }
  .formula-box .formula-sub {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #94a3b8;
  }

  /* Buttons */
  .btn-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }
  .btn {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 12px 8px;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 8px;
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 700;
    cursor: pointer;
    min-height: 44px;
    transition: all 0.2s;
  }
  .btn:active { transform: scale(0.96); }
  .btn-primary {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7c3aed, #a78bfa);
    color: white;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.4);
  }
  .btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.6); }

    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f59e0b, #fbbf24);

  .btn-primary.ended {

    margin-bottom: 8px;

  .preset-btn {
    padding: 10px 6px;
    background: #1e3a5f;
    color: #93c5fd;
    border: 1px solid #1e40af;
    border-radius: 6px;
    font-size: 12px;
    cursor: pointer;
    min-height: 44px;
    transition: all 0.2s;
    text-align: center;
    line-height: 1.3;
  }
  .preset-btn:hover {
    background: #1e40af;
    color: white;
  }
  .preset-btn:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

  /* Canvas Area */
  .canvas-container {

    min-height: 300px;
    position: relative;
    background: #0f172a;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;

      min-height: 500px;

  canvas {

  /* State indicator */
  .state-indicator {
    position: absolute;
    top: 12px;

    border-radius: 20px;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 600;
    z-index: 10;

    line-height: 1.4;
  }

  .teacher-annotation {
    position: fixed;
    z-index: 1000;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const katexOptions = {
        delimiters: [
            {left: '\\[', right: '\\]', display: true},
            {left: '\\(', right: '\\)', display: false},
            {left: '$$', right: '$$', display: true},
            {left: '$', right: '$', display: false}
        ],
        throwOnError: false,
        strict: false,
        trust: true
    };

    let renderTimeout;
    function safeRender() {
        if (renderTimeout) clearTimeout(renderTimeout);
        renderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);
        }, 100);
    }

    renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);

    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        let shouldRender = false;
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
            if (mutation.target &&
                mutation.target.className &&
                typeof mutation.target.className === 'string' &&
                mutation.target.className.includes('katex')) {
                return;
            }
            shouldRender = true;
        });

        if (shouldRender) {
            safeRender();
        }
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        characterData: true
    });

    setInterval(() => {
        const text = document.body.innerText;
        if (text.includes('\\(') || text.includes('$$')) {
            safeRender();
        }
    }, 2000);
});
</script>

    </div>

    <div class="control-group">

    </div>

    <div class="control-group">

  plotH = H - TOP_MARGIN - BOTTOM_MARGIN;
  draw();
}

window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);
const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(resizeCanvas);
resizeObserver.observe(canvasContainer);

// ==================== Coordinate Mapping ====================
function getYmax() {
  const k = state.k;
  const y0 = state.y0;
  const tmax = state.tmax;
  let yend = y0 * Math.exp(k * tmax);
  let ymax = Math.max(y0, Math.abs(yend), y0 * 2);
  // Add some padding
  if (k > 0) {
    yend = y0 * Math.exp(k * tmax);
    ymax = Math.max(yend * 1.15, y0 * 2);
  } else {
    yend = y0 * Math.exp(k * tmax);
    ymax = y0 * 1.15;
  }
  // Avoid extreme values
  ymax = Math.min(ymax, 1e6);
  return ymax;
}

function toX(t) {
  return LEFT_MARGIN + (t / state.tmax) * plotW;
}

function toY(y, yMax) {
  return TOP_MARGIN + plotH - (y / yMax) * plotH;
}

// ==================== Drawing ====================
function draw() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
  
  const yMax = getYmax();
  const k = state.k;
  const y0 = state.y0;
  
  // Background
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  
  // Grid
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#1e293b';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  
  // Vertical grid lines (time)
  const tStep = niceStep(state.tmax, 5);
  for (let t = 0; t <= state.tmax; t += tStep) {
    const x = toX(t);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, TOP_MARGIN);
    ctx.lineTo(x, TOP_MARGIN + plotH);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  
  // Horizontal grid lines (y)
  const yStep = niceStep(yMax, 5);
  for (let y = 0; y <= yMax; y += yStep) {
    const py = toY(y, yMax);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(LEFT_MARGIN, py);
    ctx.lineTo(LEFT_MARGIN + plotW, py);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  
  // Axes
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#475569';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(LEFT_MARGIN, TOP_MARGIN);
  ctx.lineTo(LEFT_MARGIN, TOP_MARGIN + plotH);
  ctx.lineTo(LEFT_MARGIN + plotW, TOP_MARGIN + plotH);
  ctx.stroke();
  
  // Axis labels
  ctx.fillStyle = '#94a3b8';
  ctx.font = '12px -apple-system, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  
  // Time axis labels
  for (let t = 0; t <= state.tmax; t += tStep) {
    const x = toX(t);
    ctx.fillText(t.toFixed(tStep < 1 ? 1 : 0), x, TOP_MARGIN + plotH + 20);
  }
  
  // Y axis labels
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  for (let y = 0; y <= yMax; y += yStep) {
    const py = toY(y, yMax);
    let label = y < 0.01 && y > 0 ? y.toExponential(1) : 
                y % 1 === 0 ? y.toFixed(0) : y.toFixed(1);
    if (y > 1000) label = y.toExponential(1);
    ctx.fillText(label, LEFT_MARGIN - 8, py + 4);
  }
  
  // Axis titles
  ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
  ctx.font = '13px -apple-system, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText('时间 t (Time)', LEFT_MARGIN + plotW / 2, TOP_MARGIN + plotH + 40);
  
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(18, TOP_MARGIN + plotH / 2);
  ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
  ctx.fillText(k > 0 ? '种群数量 y(t)' : '浓度 y(t)', 0, 0);
  ctx.restore();
  
  // Draw y=y0 reference line
  const y0y = toY(y0, yMax);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.4)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.setLineDash([5, 5]);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(LEFT_MARGIN, y0y);
  ctx.lineTo(LEFT_MARGIN + plotW, y0y);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
  ctx.font = '11px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('y₀=' + y0, LEFT_MARGIN + plotW + 4, y0y + 4);
  
  // Draw curve
  if (state.trace.length > 1) {
    // Glow effect
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.15)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 8;
    ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i < state.trace.length; i++) {
      const pt = state.trace[i];
      const px = toX(pt.t);
      const py = toY(pt.y, yMax);
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py);
      else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
    
    // Main curve
    const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(LEFT_MARGIN, 0, LEFT_MARGIN + plotW, 0);
    if (k > 0) {
      gradient.addColorStop(0, '#34d399');
      gradient.addColorStop(1, '#fbbf24');
    } else {
      gradient.addColorStop(0, '#f87171');
      gradient.addColorStop(1, '#60a5fa');
    }
    
    ctx.strokeStyle = gradient;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i < state.trace.length; i++) {
      const pt = state.trace[i];
      const px = toX(pt.t);
      const py = toY(pt.y, yMax);
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py);
      else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
    
    // Fill under curve
    if (state.trace.length > 1) {
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let i = 0; i < state.trace.length; i++) {
        const pt = state.trace[i];
        const px = toX(pt.t);
        const py = toY(pt.y, yMax);
        if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py);
        else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
      }
      ctx.lineTo(toX(state.trace[state.trace.length - 1].t), toY(0, yMax));
      ctx.lineTo(toX(state.trace[0].t), toY(0, yMax));
      ctx.closePath();
      const fillGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, TOP_MARGIN, 0, TOP_MARGIN + plotH);
      if (k > 0) {
        fillGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.15)');
        fillGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.02)');
      } else {
        fillGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.15)');
        fillGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(96, 165, 250, 0.02)');
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = fillGrad;
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
  
  // Draw half-life or doubling time markers
  if (k !== 0 && state.trace.length > 0) {
    let keyTime;
    if (k > 0) {
      keyTime = Math.log(2) / k;
    } else {
      keyTime = Math.log(2) / Math.abs(k);
    }
    
    if (keyTime <= state.tmax && state.t >= keyTime * 0.5) {
      const keyX = toX(keyTime);
      
      // Vertical dashed line at key time
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.5)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.setLineDash([6, 4]);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(keyX, TOP_MARGIN);
      ctx.lineTo(keyX, TOP_MARGIN + plotH);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
      
      // Label
      ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24';
      ctx.font = 'bold 12px -apple-system, sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      const labelText = k > 0 ? `倍增时间=${keyTime.toFixed(2)}` : `半衰期 t₁/₂=${keyTime.toFixed(2)}`;
      ctx.fillText(labelText, keyX, TOP_MARGIN - 8);
      
      // Show the point on curve at key time
      const yAtKey = y0 * Math.exp(k * keyTime);
      const pyAtKey = toY(yAtKey, yMax);
      
      // Half/double reference line
      if (k < 0) {
        // Half-life: y = y0/2
        const halfY = toY(y0 / 2, yMax);
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.4)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(LEFT_MARGIN, halfY);
        ctx.lineTo(LEFT_MARGIN + plotW, halfY);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.setLineDash([]);
        
        ctx.fillStyle = '#f87171';
        ctx.font = '11px monospace';
        ctx.textAlign = 'left';
        ctx.fillText('y₀/2=' + (y0/2).toFixed(1), LEFT_MARGIN + plotW + 4, halfY + 4);
      }
      
      // Dot at key time point
      if (keyX >= LEFT_MARGIN && keyX <= LEFT_MARGIN + plotW) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(keyX, pyAtKey, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = k > 0 ? '#fbbf24' : '#f87171';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'white';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
  }
  
  // Draw current position marker
  if (state.trace.length > 0) {
    const lastPt = state.trace[state.trace.length - 1];
    const cx = toX(lastPt.t);
    const cy = toY(lastPt.y, yMax);
    
    // Pulse ring
    if (state.running) {
      const pulsePhase = (Date.now() % 1000) / 1000;
      const pulseRadius = 8 + pulsePhase * 16;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, pulseRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(167, 139, 250, ${0.4 * (1 - pulsePhase)})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    
    // Main dot
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cx, cy, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#a78bfa';
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'white';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.stroke();
    
    // Value label near dot
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.85)';
    const labelY = cy - 24;
    const labelX = cx;
    ctx.font = 'bold 12px monospace';
    const textW = ctx.measureText(`t=${lastPt.t.toFixed(1)}, y=${lastPt.y.toFixed(1)}`).width;
    const pad = 6;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.9)';
    ctx.fillRect(labelX - textW/2 - pad, labelY - 12, textW + pad*2, 18);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(167, 139, 250, 0.5)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.strokeRect(labelX - textW/2 - pad, labelY - 12, textW + pad*2, 18);
    
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e2e8f0';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText(`t=${lastPt.t.toFixed(1)}, y=${lastPt.y.toFixed(1)}`, labelX, labelY);
  }
  
  // Draw initial point
  const initX = toX(0);
  const initY = toY(y0, yMax);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(initX, initY, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = k > 0 ? '#34d399' : '#f87171';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'white';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.stroke();
  
  // Title
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e2e8f0';
  ctx.font = 'bold 15px -apple-system, sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  const titleText = k > 0 ? '指数增长 Exponential Growth' : k < 0 ? '指数衰减 Exponential Decay' : '常数 Constant';
  ctx.fillText(titleText + '  y(t) = ' + y0 + '·e^(' + (k >= 0 ? '' : '') + k.toFixed(2) + 't)', LEFT_MARGIN + 4, 24);
  
  // k sign indicator
  const indicatorX = LEFT_MARGIN + plotW - 10;
  const indicatorY = 20;
  ctx.fillStyle = k > 0 ? 'rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.2)' : k < 0 ? 'rgba(248, 113, 113, 0.2)' : 'rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2)';
  ctx.font = 'bold 13px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  const kText = k > 0 ? 'k > 0 增长 ↑' : k < 0 ? 'k < 0 衰减 ↓' : 'k = 0 不变 —';
  ctx.fillText(kText, indicatorX, indicatorY);
}

function niceStep(range, targetTicks) {
  const rough = range / targetTicks;
  const pow = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(rough)));
  const norm = rough / pow;
  let step;
  if (norm <= 1.5) step = 1;
  else if (norm <= 3.5) step = 2;
  else if (norm <= 7.5) step = 5;
  else step = 10;
  return step * pow;
}

// ==================== Simulation Logic ====================
let lastTimestamp = null;

function animate(timestamp) {
  if (!state.running || state.paused) {
    lastTimestamp = null;
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    return;
  }
  
  if (!lastTimestamp) lastTimestamp = timestamp;
  const dt = (timestamp - lastTimestamp) / 1000; // seconds
  lastTimestamp = timestamp;
  
  // Update simulation time
  const simDt = dt * state.speed;
  state.t += simDt;
  
  if (state.t >= state.tmax) {
    state.t = state.tmax;
    state.running = false;
    state.ended = true;
    state.paused = false;
    updateButton('重新开始');
    updateStateIndicator('stopped');
  }
  
  // Calculate current y
  const y = state.y0 * Math.exp(state.k * state.t);
  
  // Add to trace (limit to avoid too many points)
  if (state.trace.length === 0 || state.t - state.trace[state.trace.length - 1].t > 0.02) {
    state.trace.push({ t: state.t, y: y });
  }
  
  // Update displays
  updateDisplays(y);
  
  // Draw
  draw();
  
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
}

function updateDisplays(y) {
  currentTimeDisplay.textContent = state.t.toFixed(2);
  currentYDisplay.textContent = y.toFixed(2);
  const deriv = state.k * y;
  derivativeDisplay.textContent = deriv >= 0 ? deriv.toFixed(2) : '-' + Math.abs(deriv).toFixed(2);
  derivativeDisplay.style.color = deriv >= 0 ? '#34d399' : '#f87171';
  
  // Key time (doubling or half-life)
  if (state.k !== 0) {
    const keyTime = Math.log(2) / Math.abs(state.k);
    keyTimeDisplay.textContent = keyTime.toFixed(3);
    if (state.k > 0) {
      keyTimeLabel.textContent = '倍增时间 Doubling Time';
    } else {
      keyTimeLabel.textContent = '半衰期 Half-life t₁/₂';
    }
  } else {
    keyTimeDisplay.textContent = '∞';
    keyTimeLabel.textContent = '无变化 No Change';
  }
}

// ==================== Button Handlers ====================
function handleMainButton() {
  if (state.ended) {
    resetSimulation();
    setTimeout(() => {
      startSimulation();
    }, 50);
  } else if (state.running) {
    pauseSimulation();
  } else {
    startSimulation();
  }
}

function startSimulation() {
  state.running = true;
  state.paused = false;
  state.ended = false;
  lastTimestamp = null;
  updateButton('⏸ 暂停');
  updateStateIndicator('running');
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
}

function pauseSimulation() {
  state.running = false;
  state.paused = true;
  updateButton('▶ 继续');
  updateStateIndicator('paused');
}

function resetSimulation() {
  state.running = false;
  state.paused = false;
  state.ended = false;
  state.t = 0;
  state.trace = [];
  lastTimestamp = null;
  
  // Update displays
  const y = state.y0;
  currentTimeDisplay.textContent = '0.00';
  currentYDisplay.textContent = y.toFixed(2);
  const deriv = state.k * y;
  derivativeDisplay.textContent = deriv.toFixed(2);
  
  if (state.k !== 0) {
    const keyTime = Math.log(2) / Math.abs(state.k);
    keyTimeDisplay.textContent = keyTime.toFixed(3);
    if (state.k > 0) {
      keyTimeLabel.textContent = '倍增时间 Doubling Time';
    } else {
      keyTimeLabel.textContent = '半衰期 Half-life t₁/₂';
    }
  } else {
    keyTimeDisplay.textContent = '∞';
    keyTimeLabel.textContent = '无变化 No Change';
  }
  
  updateButton('▶ 启动');
  updateStateIndicator('stopped');
  draw();
}

function updateButton(text) {
  mainBtn.textContent = text;
  mainBtn.className = 'btn btn-primary';
  if (text === '⏸ 暂停') {
    // running state
  } else if (text === '重新开始') {
    mainBtn.classList.add('ended');
  } else if (text === '▶ 继续') {
    mainBtn.classList.add('paused');
  }
}

function updateStateIndicator(status) {
  stateIndicator.className = 'state-indicator ' + status;
  if (status === 'running') {
    stateIndicator.textContent = '● 运行中 Running';
  } else if (status === 'paused') {
    stateIndicator.textContent = '❚❚ 已暂停 Paused';
  } else {
    stateIndicator.textContent = '● 已停止 Stopped';
  }
}

mainBtn.addEventListener('click', handleMainButton);
resetBtn.addEventListener('click', resetSimulation);

// ==================== Slider Handlers ====================
function setupSlider(slider, varName, displayEl, formatter) {
  const handler = () => {
    const val = parseFloat(slider.value);
    state[varName] = val;
    displayEl.textContent = formatter(val);
    
    // If not running, recalculate
    if (!state.running && state.trace.length === 0) {
      const y = state.y0 * Math.exp(state.k * state.t);
      updateDisplays(y);
    }
    
    // Update key time display immediately
    if (varName === 'k' || varName === 'y0') {
      if (state.k !== 0) {
        const keyTime = Math.log(2) / Math.abs(state.k);
        keyTimeDisplay.textContent = keyTime.toFixed(3);
        if (state.k > 0) {
          keyTimeLabel.textContent = '倍增时间 Doubling Time';
        } else {
          keyTimeLabel.textContent = '半衰期 Half-life t₁/₂';
        }
      } else {
        keyTimeDisplay.textContent = '∞';
        keyTimeLabel.textContent = '无变化 No Change';
      }
    }
    
    // Update challenge description
    updateChallenge();
    
    // If simulation is not running, redraw with new parameters
    if (!state.running) {
      draw();
    } else {
      // If running, clear trace to apply new parameters
      state.trace = [];
    }
  };
  
  slider.addEventListener('input', handler);
}

setupSlider(kSlider, 'k', kDisplay, v => v.toFixed(2));
setupSlider(y0Slider, 'y0', y0Display, v => v.toFixed(0));
setupSlider(tmaxSlider, 'tmax', tmaxDisplay, v => v.toFixed(0));
setupSlider(speedSlider, 'speed', speedDisplay, v => v.toFixed(1) + '×');

// ==================== Challenge System ====================
function updateChallenge() {
  const k = state.k;
  const y0 = state.y0;
  const targetY = 50;
  const targetT = 5;
  
  if (k > 0) {
    const neededK = Math.log(targetY / y0) / targetT;
    const diff = Math.abs(k - neededK);
    if (diff < 0.05) {
      challengeDesc.innerHTML = '🎉 <strong>太棒了！</strong>你的 k 值非常接近目标！<br>y(5) = ' + (y0 * Math.exp(k * targetT)).toFixed(1) + ' ≈ ' + targetY;
    } else {
      const currentY = y0 * Math.exp(k * targetT);
      challengeDesc.innerHTML = '调节 k 值，让曲线在 t=5 时达到 y≈' + targetY + '。<br>当前 y(5) = ' + currentY.toFixed(1) + 
        (currentY > targetY ? ' (太大了，减小 k)' : ' (太小了，增大 k)');
    }
  } else {
    challengeDesc.innerHTML = '📌 当前为衰减模式 (k<0)。<br>试试将 k 设为正值来挑战倍增问题！<br>或观察半衰期 t₁/₂ = ' + (Math.log(2) / Math.abs(k)).toFixed(2);
  }
}

// ==================== Presets ====================
function applyPreset(name) {
  const presets = {
    'growth': { k: 0.7, y0: 10, tmax: 10, speed: 1 },
    'decay': { k: -0.3, y0: 100, tmax: 15, speed: 1 },
    'radioactive': { k: -0.693, y0: 100, tmax: 10, speed: 1 },
    'compound': { k: 0.08, y0: 1000, tmax: 30, speed: 1 }
  };
  
  const preset = presets[name];
  if (!preset) return;
  
  // Reset first
  resetSimulation();
  
  // Apply values
  state.k = preset.k;
  state.y0 = preset.y0;
  state.tmax = preset.tmax;
  state.speed = preset.speed;
  
  // Update sliders
  kSlider.value = preset.k;
  y0Slider.value = preset.y0;
  tmaxSlider.value = preset.tmax;
  speedSlider.value = preset.speed;
  
  // Update displays
  kDisplay.textContent = preset.k.toFixed(2);
  y0Display.textContent = preset.y0.toFixed(0);
  tmaxDisplay.textContent = preset.tmax.toFixed(0);
  speedDisplay.textContent = preset.speed.toFixed(1) + '×';
  
  // Update key time
  if (preset.k !== 0) {
    const keyTime = Math.log(2) / Math.abs(preset.k);
    keyTimeDisplay.textContent = keyTime.toFixed(3);
    if (preset.k > 0) {
      keyTimeLabel.textContent = '倍增时间 Doubling Time';
    } else {
      keyTimeLabel.textContent = '半衰期 Half-life t₁/₂';
    }
  }
  
  updateChallenge();
  draw();
}

  const panel = document.getElementById('controlPanel');
  panel.classList.toggle('collapsed');
  const btn = panel.querySelector('.collapse-btn');
  if (panel.classList.contains('collapsed')) {
    btn.textContent = '▲ 展开控制';
