}

// ==================== Keyboard Shortcuts ====================
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.target.tagName === 'INPUT') return;
  
  switch(e.key) {
    case ' ':
    case 'Enter':
      e.preventDefault();
      handleMainButton();
      break;
    case 'r':
    case 'R':
      resetSimulation();
      break;
  }
});

// ==================== postMessage Listener (REQUIRED) ====================
window.addEventListener('message', function(event) {
  const { type, target, state: msgState, content } = event.data;

  switch (type) {
    case 'SET_WIDGET_STATE':
      if (msgState) {
        Object.entries(msgState).forEach(([key, value]) => {
          const slider = document.getElementById(key + '-slider') || document.querySelector('[data-var="' + key + '"]');
          if (slider) {
            slider.value = value;
            slider.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
          }
        });
      }
      break;

    case 'HIGHLIGHT_ELEMENT':
      const highlightEl = document.querySelector(target);
      if (highlightEl) {
        highlightEl.style.outline = '3px solid rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.8)';
        highlightEl.style.outlineOffset = '4px';
        highlightEl.style.animation = 'pulse-highlight 2s infinite';
        setTimeout(() => {
          highlightEl.style.outline = '';
          highlightEl.style.animation = '';
        }, 3000);
      }
      break;

    case 'ANNOTATE_ELEMENT':
      const annotateEl = document.querySelector(target);
      if (annotateEl && content) {
        const rect = annotateEl.getBoundingClientRect();
        const tooltip = document.createElement('div');
        tooltip.className = 'teacher-annotation';
        tooltip.style.cssText = 'position:fixed; top:' + (rect.top - 40) + 'px; left:' + rect.left + 'px; background:rgba(139,92,246,0.95); color:white; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:8px; font-size:14px; z-index:1000; animation:fadeIn 0.3s;';
        tooltip.textContent = content;
        document.body.appendChild(tooltip);
        setTimeout(() => tooltip.remove(), 4000);
      }
      break;

    case 'REVEAL_ELEMENT':
      const revealEl = document.querySelector(target);
      if (revealEl) {
        revealEl.style.display = '';
        revealEl.style.opacity = '1';
      }
      break;
  }
});

const style = document.createElement('style');
style.textContent = '@keyframes pulse-highlight { 0%, 100% { outline-color: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.8); } 50% { outline-color: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.4); } } @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }';
document.head.appendChild(style);

function init() {
  // Load config
  const configEl = document.getElementById('widget-config');
  if (configEl) {
    try {
      const config = JSON.parse(configEl.textContent);
      // Config is available for external systems
      console.log('Widget config loaded:', config.concept);
    } catch(e) {
      console.warn('Failed to parse widget config:', e);
    }
  }
  
  updateChallenge();
  resizeCanvas();
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
}

init();
</script>

widgetConfig.description: 指数增长与衰减模型：调节比例系数 k 观察人口增长或药物衰减。通过设置 k<0 模拟药物浓度减半过程，读取半衰期。

actions.text: 本场景通过交互探索“指数增长与衰减模型：拖动实验”。我们就把这个感觉放进一个可以动手拖动的模型里，亲手调一调。

actions.content: 应用人口增长预设，展示曲线快速上升的趋势。

actions.text: 大家看这个界面。k 是比例系数，也就是增长率占当前人口的比例。我现在把它设成 0.7，相当于每过一个时间单位，增长率是当前人数的 70%。这条曲线一开始还挺平缓，但很快就‘飞’起来了。

actions.content: 这是主控制滑动条，可以实时改变曲线的走势。

actions.text: 最关键的就是这个滑动条。你试着一手慢慢拖动 k，盯着曲线的形状看。当 k 从很小的正数慢慢变大，它就跟我们刚刚说的线性增长彻底拉开了距离，变成了爆炸式增长。

actions.content: 切换到药物衰减预设，展示k<0时的递减曲线。

actions.text: 反过来，如果你把 k 拉到负数，比如 -0.3，它就变成了衰减模型，就像药物在体内慢慢被代谢掉。这时候屏幕上还会自动标出半衰期 —— 浓度减少一半所需要的时间。接下来，请你试着拖动 k，看看能不能在不看公式的情况下，让半衰期正好等于 2 个时间单位。

content.html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>指数增长与衰减模型：关系图</title>
<style>
  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  body {
    background: #0d1117;
    color: #e6edf3;
    font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif;
    overflow: hidden;
    height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
  }

  #diagram-container {
    flex: 1;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  svg#main-svg {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
  }

  .node-group { cursor: pointer; }
  .node-group .node-rect {
    fill: #ffffff;
    stroke: #30363d;
    stroke-width: 2;
    rx: 12;
    ry: 12;
    transition: filter 0.2s, stroke 0.2s;
  }
  .node-group:hover .node-rect {
    filter: brightness(0.95);
    stroke: #58a6ff;
  }
  .node-group.active .node-rect {
    stroke: #58a6ff;
    stroke-width: 3;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(88,166,255,0.5));
  }
  .node-group .node-icon { font-size: 22px; }
  .node-group .node-label {
    fill: #1a1a2e;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-anchor: middle;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .node-group .node-sublabel {
    fill: #57606a;
    font-size: 11px;
    text-anchor: middle;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .node-group .node-bg {
    fill: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
    rx: 12; ry: 12;
  }

  .edge-path {
    fill: none;
    stroke: #484f58;
    stroke-width: 2;
    transition: stroke 0.4s, opacity 0.4s;
  }
  .edge-path.visible {
    stroke: #79c0ff;
  }
  .edge-arrow {
    fill: #484f58;
    transition: fill 0.4s, opacity 0.4s;
  }
  .edge-arrow.visible {
    fill: #79c0ff;
  }
  .edge-label {
    fill: #c9d1d9;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 500;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.4s;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .edge-label.visible { opacity: 1; }

  .feedback-label {
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 700;
    pointer-events: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.4s;
  }
  .feedback-label.visible { opacity: 1; }

  /* Sidebar */
  #sidebar {
    width: 340px;
    min-width: 340px;
    background: #161b22;
    border-left: 1px solid #30363d;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    transition: transform 0.3s, opacity 0.3s;
    z-index: 10;
    overflow-y: auto;
  }
  #sidebar.collapsed {
    transform: translateX(100%);
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    min-width: 0;
    width: 0;
    border: none;
  }
  #sidebar-toggle {
    position: absolute;
    right: 340px;
    top: 12px;
    background: #21262d;
    border: 1px solid #30363d;
    color: #c9d1d9;
    padding: 8px 10px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 16px;
    z-index: 11;
    transition: right 0.3s;
  }
  #sidebar.collapsed ~ #sidebar-toggle {
    right: 0;
  }
  .sidebar-header {
    padding: 20px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #30363d;
  }
  .sidebar-header h2 {
    font-size: 16px;
    color: #58a6ff;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }
  .sidebar-header p {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #8b949e;
  }
  .sidebar-body {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 16px 20px;
    overflow-y: auto;
  }
  .detail-card {
    background: #0d1117;
    border: 1px solid #30363d;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 14px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    display: none;
  }
  .detail-card.active { display: block; }
  .detail-card h3 {
    font-size: 14px;
    color: #e6edf3;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
  }
  .detail-card p {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #8b949e;
    line-height: 1.7;
  }
  .detail-card .math {
    background: #161b22;
    border: 1px solid #30363d;
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    margin: 8px 0;
    font-family: "Cambria Math", "Times New Roman", serif;
    font-size: 15px;
    color: #79c0ff;
    text-align: center;
  }
  .detail-card .tag {
    display: inline-block;
    background: rgba(88,166,255,0.15);
    color: #58a6ff;
    padding: 2px 8px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 11px;
    margin-top: 6px;
  }

  /* Controls */
  .controls {
    padding: 16px 20px;
    border-top: 1px solid #30363d;
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .btn {
    background: #21262d;
    border: 1px solid #30363d;
    color: #c9d1d9;
    padding: 8px 16px;
    border-radius: 8px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-family: inherit;
    transition: background 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;
    flex: 1;
    text-align: center;
    min-width: 80px;
  }
  .btn:hover { background: #30363d; border-color: #58a6ff; }
  .btn:disabled { opacity: 0.3; cursor: not-allowed; }
  .btn.primary { background: #1f6feb; border-color: #1f6feb; color: #fff; }
  .btn.primary:hover { background: #388bfd; }

  /* Progress */
  .progress-bar {
    height: 3px;
    background: #21262d;
    margin: 12px 0 0;
    border-radius: 2px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .progress-fill {
    height: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, #58a6ff, #79c0ff);
    transition: width 0.4s;
    border-radius: 2px;
  }

  /* Simulation canvas area */
  #sim-container {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 16px;
    left: 16px;
    background: rgba(22,27,34,0.92);
    border: 1px solid #30363d;
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 12px;
    z-index: 5;
    display: none;
  }
  #sim-container.visible { display: block; }
  #sim-container h4 {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #8b949e;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }
  #sim-canvas {
    border-radius: 6px;
  }
  .sim-controls {
    display: flex;
    gap: 6px;
    margin-top: 8px;
    align-items: center;
  }
  .sim-controls label {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #8b949e;
  }
  .sim-controls select, .sim-controls input {
    background: #0d1117;
    border: 1px solid #30363d;
    color: #c9d1d9;
    padding: 4px 8px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-family: inherit;
  }
  .sim-btn {
    background: #21262d;
    border: 1px solid #30363d;
    color: #c9d1d9;
    padding: 4px 10px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-family: inherit;
  }
  .sim-btn:hover { border-color: #58a6ff; }

  /* Mobile */
  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    #sidebar {
      position: absolute;
      right: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0;
      width: 300px;
      min-width: 300px;
      transform: translateX(100%);
      opacity: 0;
      z-index: 20;
    }
    #sidebar.mobile-open {
      transform: translateX(0);
      opacity: 1;
    }
    #sidebar-toggle {
      right: 8px;
      top: 8px;
      z-index: 21;
    }
    #sim-container {
      left: 8px;
      bottom: 8px;
      right: 8px;
    }
  }
</style>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const katexOptions = {
        delimiters: [
            {left: '\\[', right: '\\]', display: true},
            {left: '\\(', right: '\\)', display: false},
            {left: '$$', right: '$$', display: true},
            {left: '$', right: '$', display: false}
        ],
        throwOnError: false,
        strict: false,
        trust: true
    };

    let renderTimeout;
    function safeRender() {
        if (renderTimeout) clearTimeout(renderTimeout);
        renderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);
        }, 100);
    }

    renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);

    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        let shouldRender = false;
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
            if (mutation.target &&
                mutation.target.className &&
                typeof mutation.target.className === 'string' &&
                mutation.target.className.includes('katex')) {
                return;
            }
            shouldRender = true;
        });

        if (shouldRender) {
            safeRender();
        }
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        characterData: true
    });

    setInterval(() => {
        const text = document.body.innerText;
        if (text.includes('\\(') || text.includes('$$')) {
            safeRender();
        }
    }, 2000);
});
</script>

        <option value="0.3">+0.3（缓增）</option>
        <option value="0">0（不变）</option>
        <option value="-0.3">-0.3（衰减）</option>
        <option value="-0.8">-0.8（快减）</option>
      </select>
      <label>y₀ =</label>
      <input id="sim-y0" type="number" value="1" min="0.1" max="10" step="0.5" style="width:50px">
      <button class="sim-btn" id="sim-run">▶ 运行</button>
      <button class="sim-btn" id="sim-reset">↺ 重置</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<button id="sidebar-toggle" title="切换面板">☰</button>

<div id="sidebar">
  <div class="sidebar-header">
    <h2>🔬 指数增长与衰减模型</h2>
    <p>系统反馈动力学 · 点击节点查看详情</p>
    <div class="progress-bar"><div class="progress-fill" id="progress-fill" style="width:0%"></div></div>
  </div>
  <div class="sidebar-body" id="sidebar-body">
    <p style="color:#8b949e;font-size:13px;text-align:center;padding:20px 0;" id="placeholder-text">
      👆 点击「下一步」逐步探索反馈环路，<br>或点击图中的节点查看详情。
    </p>
  </div>
  <div class="controls">
    <button class="btn" id="btn-prev">◀ 上一步</button>
    <button class="btn primary" id="btn-next">下一步 ▶</button>
    <button class="btn" id="btn-reset">↺ 重置</button>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function() {
  const config = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('widget-config').textContent);
  const NODE_W = 170, NODE_H = 68, ARROW_OFF = 8;
  const svg = document.getElementById('main-svg');
  const edgesLayer = document.getElementById('edges-layer');
  const nodesLayer = document.getElementById('nodes-layer');
  const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
  const sidebarBody = document.getElementById('sidebar-body');
  const progressFill = document.getElementById('progress-fill');
  const simContainer = document.getElementById('sim-container');

  // Node positions
  const positions = {
    n1: { x: 480, y: 80 },
    n2: { x: 780, y: 170 },
    n3: { x: 780, y: 430 },
    n4: { x: 580, y: 590 },
    n5: { x: 380, y: 590 },
    n6: { x: 180, y: 430 },
    n7: { x: 180, y: 170 }
  };

  const revealOrder = config.revealOrder;
  let currentStep = 0;
  let revealedNodes = new Set();
  let revealedEdges = new Set();
  let activeNodeId = null;

  // Build edges
  const edgeData = [];
  config.edges.forEach(e => {
    const fromPos = positions[e.from];
    const toPos = positions[e.to];
    if (!fromPos || !toPos) return;

    const dx = toPos.x - fromPos.x, dy = toPos.y - fromPos.y;
    let sx, sy, ex, ey;

    if (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx)) {
      sx = fromPos.x;
      sy = dy > 0 ? fromPos.y + NODE_H/2 : fromPos.y - NODE_H/2;
      ex = toPos.x;
      ey = dy > 0 ? toPos.y - NODE_H/2 - ARROW_OFF : toPos.y + NODE_H/2 + ARROW_OFF;
    } else {
      sx = dx > 0 ? fromPos.x + NODE_W/2 : fromPos.x - NODE_W/2;
      sy = fromPos.y;
      ex = dx > 0 ? toPos.x - NODE_W/2 - ARROW_OFF : toPos.x + NODE_W/2 + ARROW_OFF;
      ey = toPos.y;
    }

    const path = `M ${sx} ${sy} L ${ex} ${ey}`;
    const mx = (sx + ex) / 2, my = (sy + ey) / 2;
    const labelOffset = Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) ? (dx > 0 ? -14 : 14) : (dy > 0 ? -14 : 14);

    edgeData.push({
      ...e, path, sx, sy, ex, ey,
      labelX: mx + labelOffset * (Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy) ? 0 : 1),
      labelY: my + labelOffset * (Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) ? 0 : 1),
      labelAngle: Math.abs(dy) > Math.abs(dx) ? 0 : (dx > 0 ? 0 : 180)
    });
  });

  // Draw edges
  edgeData.forEach((e, i) => {
    const g = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "g");
    g.setAttribute("class", "edge-group");
    g.dataset.from = e.from;
    g.dataset.to = e.to;

    const path = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "path");
    path.setAttribute("d", e.path);
    path.setAttribute("class", "edge-path");
    path.setAttribute("marker-end", "url(#arrowhead)");
    path.id = `edge-path-${i}`;
    g.appendChild(path);

    const label = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
    label.setAttribute("x", e.labelX);
    label.setAttribute("y", e.labelY);
    label.setAttribute("class", "edge-label");
    label.setAttribute("text-anchor", "middle");
    label.setAttribute("dominant-baseline", "middle");
    label.textContent = e.label;
    g.appendChild(label);

    edgesLayer.appendChild(g);
  });

  // Draw nodes
  const nodeMap = {};
  config.nodes.forEach(n => {
    const pos = positions[n.id];
    if (!pos) return;

    const g = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "g");
    g.setAttribute("class", "node-group");
    g.setAttribute("data-id", n.id);
    g.setAttribute("transform", `translate(${pos.x - NODE_W/2}, ${pos.y - NODE_H/2})`);

    const bg = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "rect");
    bg.setAttribute("class", "node-rect");
    bg.setAttribute("width", NODE_W);
    bg.setAttribute("height", NODE_H);
    g.appendChild(bg);

    const icon = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
    icon.setAttribute("class", "node-icon");
    icon.setAttribute("x", 24);
    icon.setAttribute("y", 28);
    icon.textContent = n.icon;
    g.appendChild(icon);

    const label = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
    label.setAttribute("class", "node-label");
    label.setAttribute("x", NODE_W / 2 + 6);
    label.setAttribute("y", 28);
    label.textContent = n.label;
    g.appendChild(label);

    if (n.sublabel) {
      const sub = document.createElementNS("http://www.w3.org/2000/svg", "text");
      sub.setAttribute("class", "node-sublabel");
      sub.setAttribute("x", NODE_W / 2 + 6);
      sub.setAttribute("y", 48);
      sub.textContent = n.sublabel;
      g.appendChild(sub);
    }

    g.addEventListener('click', () => selectNode(n.id));
    nodesLayer.appendChild(g);
    nodeMap[n.id] = { group: g, data: n, pos };
  });

  function selectNode(id) {
    if (!revealedNodes.has(id)) return;
    activeNodeId = id;
    document.querySelectorAll('.node-group').forEach(g => g.classList.remove('active'));
    const ng = document.querySelector(`.node-group[data-id="${id}"]`);
    if (ng) ng.classList.add('active');
    showDetail(id);
  }

  function showDetail(id) {
    const n = config.nodes.find(n => n.id === id);
    if (!n) return;
    document.getElementById('placeholder-text')?.remove();

    // Remove old cards
    sidebarBody.querySelectorAll('.detail-card').forEach(c => c.remove());

    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'detail-card active';
    card.innerHTML = `
      <h3>${n.icon} ${n.label}</h3>
      <p>${n.details}</p>
      ${(n.tags || []).map(t => `<span class="tag">${t}</span>`).join(' ')}
    `;
    sidebarBody.appendChild(card);
  }

  function revealNode(id) {
    if (revealedNodes.has(id)) return;
    revealedNodes.add(id);
    const ng = document.querySelector(`.node-group[data-id="${id}"]`);
    if (ng) {
      ng.style.opacity = '1';
      ng.style.transition = 'opacity 0.5s';
    }
    selectNode(id);
  }

  function revealEdge(fromId, toId) {
    const key = `${fromId}->${toId}`;
    if (revealedEdges.has(key)) return;
    revealedEdges.add(key);

    const g = document.querySelector(`.edge-group[data-from="${fromId}"][data-to="${toId}"]`);
    if (g) {
      const path = g.querySelector('.edge-path');
      const label = g.querySelector('.edge-label');
      if (path) {
        path.classList.add('visible');
        path.setAttribute('marker-end', 'url(#arrowhead-vis)');
      }
      if (label) label.classList.add('visible');
    }
  }

  function updateProgress() {
    const pct = (currentStep / revealOrder.length) * 100;
    progressFill.style.width = pct + '%';
    document.getElementById('btn-prev').disabled = currentStep <= 0;
    document.getElementById('btn-next').disabled = currentStep >= revealOrder.length;

    if (currentStep >= 4) {
      simContainer.classList.add('visible');
    } else {
      simContainer.classList.remove('visible');
    }
  }

  function stepForward() {
    if (currentStep >= revealOrder.length) return;
    const id = revealOrder[currentStep];
    revealNode(id);

    // Reveal edges connected to this node from previously revealed nodes
    config.edges.forEach(e => {
      if ((e.from === id || e.to === id) && revealedNodes.has(e.from) && revealedNodes.has(e.to)) {
        revealEdge(e.from, e.to);
      }
    });

    currentStep++;
    updateProgress();
  }

  function stepBackward() {
    if (currentStep <= 0) return;
    currentStep--;
    const id = revealOrder[currentStep];
    // Re-hide
    const ng = document.querySelector(`.node-group[data-id="${id}"]`);
    if (ng) { ng.style.opacity = '0.15'; ng.classList.remove('active'); }
    revealedNodes.delete(id);

    // Hide edges connected to this node
    config.edges.forEach(e => {
      if (e.from === id || e.to === id) {
        const key = `${e.from}->${e.to}`;
        revealedEdges.delete(key);
        const g = document.querySelector(`.edge-group[data-from="${e.from}"][data-to="${e.to}"]`);
        if (g) {
          g.querySelector('.edge-path')?.classList.remove('visible');
          g.querySelector('.edge-path')?.setAttribute('marker-end', 'url(#arrowhead)');
          g.querySelector('.edge-label')?.classList.remove('visible');
        }
      }
    });

    // Show previous detail
    if (currentStep > 0) {
      const prevId = revealOrder[currentStep - 1];
      if (revealedNodes.has(prevId)) selectNode(prevId);
    } else {
      activeNodeId = null;
      document.getElementById('placeholder-text')?.remove();
      sidebarBody.querySelectorAll('.detail-card').forEach(c => c.remove());
      const ph = document.createElement('p');
      ph.style.cssText = 'color:#8b949e;font-size:13px;text-align:center;padding:20px 0;';
      ph.id = 'placeholder-text';
      ph.innerHTML = '👆 点击「下一步」逐步探索反馈环路，<br>或点击图中的节点查看详情。';
      sidebarBody.appendChild(ph);
    }
    updateProgress();
  }

  function resetAll() {
    currentStep = 0;
    revealedNodes.clear();
    revealedEdges.clear();
    activeNodeId = null;

    document.querySelectorAll('.node-group').forEach(g => {
      g.style.opacity = '0.15';
      g.classList.remove('active');
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.edge-path').forEach(p => {
      p.classList.remove('visible');
      p.setAttribute('marker-end', 'url(#arrowhead)');
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.edge-label').forEach(l => l.classList.remove('visible'));

    sidebarBody.querySelectorAll('.detail-card').forEach(c => c.remove());
    const ph = document.createElement('p');
    ph.style.cssText = 'color:#8b949e;font-size:13px;text-align:center;padding:20px 0;';
    ph.id = 'placeholder-text';
    ph.innerHTML = '👆 点击「下一步」逐步探索反馈环路，<br>或点击图中的节点查看详情。';
    sidebarBody.appendChild(ph);

    updateProgress();
    resetSimulation();
  }

  // Sidebar toggle
  const sidebarToggle = document.getElementById('sidebar-toggle');
  sidebarToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
    if (window.innerWidth <= 768) {
      sidebar.classList.toggle('mobile-open');
    } else {
      sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
    }
  });

  // Button events
  document.getElementById('btn-next').addEventListener('click', stepForward);
  document.getElementById('btn-prev').addEventListener('click', stepBackward);
  document.getElementById('btn-reset').addEventListener('click', resetAll);

  // Init: hide all nodes and edges
  document.querySelectorAll('.node-group').forEach(g => g.style.opacity = '0.15');
  updateProgress();

  // ==================== SIMULATION ====================
  const canvas = document.getElementById('sim-canvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let simRunning = false;
  let simAnimId = null;
  let simTime = 0;
  let simK = 0.5;
  let simY0 = 1;
  let simY = 1;

  function drawSim(t) {
    const w = canvas.width, h = canvas.height;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

    // Background grid
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(48,54,61,0.6)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 0.5;
    for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {
      const y = (h / 4) * i;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(w, y); ctx.stroke();
    }
    for (let i = 0; i <= 5; i++) {
      const x = (w / 5) * i;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, 0); ctx.lineTo(x, h); ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Axes
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#484f58';
    ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(30, 0); ctx.lineTo(30, h); ctx.lineTo(w, h);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Axis labels
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8b949e';
    ctx.font = '10px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText('t', w - 14, h - 4);
    ctx.fillText('y', 34, 12);

    // Draw exponential curve
    const maxT = 6;
    const maxTDisplay = t > maxT ? maxT : t;
    const maxTShow = maxTDisplay || 1;

    // Compute max y for scaling
    let maxY = simY0 * Math.exp(Math.abs(simK) * maxTShow);
    if (simK <= 0) maxY = Math.max(simY0, 1.5 * simY0);
    maxY = Math.max(maxY, 1);

    // Draw full curve up to current time
    if (t > 0) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = simK > 0 ? '#f85149' : (simK < 0 ? '#3fb950' : '#c9d1d9');
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      const steps = 100;
      for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
        const tt = (i / steps) * Math.min(t, maxTShow);
        const yy = simY0 * Math.exp(simK * tt);
        const px = 30 + (tt / maxTShow) * (w - 40);
        const py = h - 10 - (yy / maxY) * (h - 20);
        if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py);
        else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
      }
      ctx.stroke();

      // Current point
      const curY = simY0 * Math.exp(simK * Math.min(t, maxTShow));
      const cx = 30 + (Math.min(t, maxTShow) / maxTShow) * (w - 40);
      const cy = h - 10 - (curY / maxY) * (h - 20);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(cx, cy, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = simK > 0 ? '#f85149' : (simK < 0 ? '#3fb950' : '#c9d1d9');
      ctx.fill();

      // Value label
      ctx.fillStyle = '#e6edf3';
      ctx.font = '10px sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText(`y=${curY.toFixed(2)}`, cx + 8, cy - 6);
    }

    // Draw tangent line at current point if k != 0
    if (t > 0 && simK !== 0) {
      const curY = simY0 * Math.exp(simK * Math.min(t, maxTShow));
      const cx = 30 + (Math.min(t, maxTShow) / maxTShow) * (w - 40);
      const cy = h - 10 - (curY / maxY) * (h - 20);
      const slope = simK * curY;
      const tangentLen = 30;
      const dxReal = tangentLen * maxTShow / (w - 40);
      const dyReal = slope * dxReal;
      const px2 = cx + tangentLen;
      const py2 = cy - (dyReal / maxY) * (h - 20);

      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(88,166,255,0.5)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      ctx.setLineDash([4, 3]);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(cx - tangentLen, cy + (dyReal / maxY) * (h - 20));
      ctx.lineTo(px2, py2);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.setLineDash([]);

      ctx.fillStyle = '#58a6ff';
      ctx.font = '9px sans-serif';
      ctx.fillText('斜率 = dy/dt', px2 + 4, py2 - 4);
    }

    // Color legend
    ctx.fillStyle = simK > 0 ? '#f85149' : (simK < 0 ? '#3fb950' : '#c9d1d9');
    ctx.font = 'bold 10px sans-serif';
    const legend = simK > 0 ? '增长 k>0' : (simK < 0 ? '衰减 k<0' : '不变 k=0');
    ctx.fillText(legend, 34, 24);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#8b949e';
    ctx.font = '10px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(`k=${simK}  y₀=${simY0}`, 34, 38);
  }

  function runSimulation() {
    if (simRunning) return;
    simRunning = true;
    simTime = 0;
    simK = parseFloat(document.getElementById('sim-k').value);
    simY0 = parseFloat(document.getElementById('sim-y0').value);

    function animate() {
      simTime += 0.03;
      if (simTime > 6) {
        simRunning = false;
        drawSim(simTime);
        return;
      }
      drawSim(simTime);
      simAnimId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    }
    animate();
  }

  function resetSimulation() {
    simRunning = false;
    if (simAnimId) cancelAnimationFrame(simAnimId);
    simTime = 0;
    simK = parseFloat(document.getElementById('sim-k').value);
    simY0 = parseFloat(document.getElementById('sim-y0').value);
    drawSim(0);
  }

  document.getElementById('sim-run').addEventListener('click', runSimulation);
  document.getElementById('sim-reset').addEventListener('click', resetSimulation);
  document.getElementById('sim-k').addEventListener('change', () => { if (!simRunning) resetSimulation(); });
  document.getElementById('sim-y0').addEventListener('change', () => { if (!simRunning) resetSimulation(); });

  // Initial draw
  drawSim(0);

  // Keyboard shortcuts
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); stepForward(); }
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') { e.preventDefault(); stepBackward(); }
  });
})();
</script>
</body>

nodes.label: 当前量 y(t)
nodes.details:
系统中某一时刻的观测量。它是时间的函数 y(t)，例如细菌数量、放射性物质质量、账户余额等。

在微积分直觉中，y(t) 描述的是「此刻有多少」这一状态。

nodes.label: 乘以比例系数 k
nodes.details:
比例系数 k 是系统的核心参数，决定了变化速度的大小和方向。

🔹 k > 0：变化与当前量同向 → 增长
🔹 k < 0：变化与当前量反向 → 衰减

k 的物理意义：单位时间内每个单位产生的「新增」或「损失」量。

nodes.label: dy/dt 导数
nodes.details:
导数 dy/dt 表示 y 在时刻 t 的瞬时变化率。

核心方程：dy/dt = k·y

直觉理解：y 越大，变化越快——这就是指数行为的本质。变化率与当前量成正比。

nodes.label: 正反馈 (k > 0)
nodes.details:
当 k > 0 时，y 越大 → dy/dt 越正 → y 增长越快。

这是「富者愈富」的正反馈机制：
• 复利增长（银行存款）
• 人口无限制增长
• 病毒传播初期

曲线：y(t) = y₀e^(kt)，向上弯曲加速增长。

nodes.label: 负反馈 (k < 0)
nodes.details:
当 k < 0 时，y 越大 → dy/dt 越负 → y 减少越快。

这是「自我抑制」的负反馈机制：
• 放射性衰变
• 药物代谢消除
• 冷却过程（牛顿冷却定律）

曲线：y(t) = y₀e^(-|k|t)，逐渐趋近于零。

nodes.label: ∫ 积分 (累积)
nodes.details:
积分是将瞬时变化率 dy/dt 累积回总量 y 的过程。

dy/dt = k·y ⟹ y(t) = ∫ k·y dt

积分是微分的逆运算：导数看「瞬间变化」，积分看「整体积累」。两者共同构成闭环。

nodes.label: y = y₀e^(kt)
nodes.details:
指数函数是 dy/dt = k·y 的解析解：y(t) = y₀ · e^(kt)

其中 y₀ = y(0) 是初始值，e ≈ 2.718 是自然常数。

关键性质：在任意时刻，曲线在该点的切线斜率与纵坐标之比为常数 k。

actions.text: 本场景通过交互探索“指数增长与衰减模型：关系图”。让我们把这个直觉串起来，看看指数增长和衰减背后那个自我驱动的反馈循环。屏幕上出现的，就是我们刚经历过的所有环节连接成的闭环系统图。

actions.content: 展示起点：当前量 y(t)

actions.text: 我们从「当前量 y(t)」开始。它就是你在拖动实验中看到的那一时刻的数量——细菌个数、放射性物质质量，或者账户里的钱。它不是一个死数字，而是这个循环的起点。

actions.content: 指向节点 n1
展示：乘以比例系数 k

actions.text: y(t) 会流向下一个关键节点——「乘以比例系数 k」。这就是你刚才拖动的那个滑块。如果 k 是正的，变化就和当前量同向，越变越多；如果 k 是负的，就像药物代谢，越变越少。

actions.content: 指向节点 n2
展示：导数 dy/dt

actions.text: 乘以 k 之后，我们就得到了导数 dy/dt——瞬时变化率。核心方程 dy/dt = k·y 就在这儿。它告诉我们一个深刻的直觉：变化的速度，永远和当前拥有量成正比。这就是指数行为的根本原因。

actions.content: 展示正反馈分支
展示负反馈分支

actions.text: 现在看，导数这条路会分岔。如果 k 大于零，系统走上红色的正反馈分支——富者愈富，增长曲线向上加速。如果 k 小于零，系统走上蓝色的负反馈分支——自我抑制，逐渐衰减趋向于零。

actions.content: 指向正反馈分支
展示积分累积环节

actions.text: 无论哪条路，最终都会汇聚到积分这个环节。积分把瞬时变化率一点一点累积起来，更新出下一个时刻的 y，然后这个新的 y 又被送回起点，重新开始下一轮乘 k 的循环。

actions.content: 指向积分节点
展示解析解 y=y₀e^(kt)

actions.text: 最后，积分还会通向解析解——y = y₀ e^(kt)。它就是我们在拖动实验中看到的那条优美曲线。现在，来看看你们能不能跟着连线，把这个自我强化的因果链自己走一遍。

scenes.title: 指数增长与衰减模型：误解修复挑战

content.html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>🧬 种群管理员 — 指数增长与衰减挑战</title>
<style>
* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
body {
  font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif;
  background: #0a0e27;
  color: #e0e0e0;
  overflow: hidden;
  height: 100vh;
  user-select: none;
}
#gameContainer {
  width: 100vw; height: 100vh;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  position: relative;
}
/* HUD */
#hud {
  position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
  height: 70px; z-index: 10;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 8px 16px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(10,14,39,0.95) 0%, rgba(10,14,39,0.0) 100%);
  pointer-events: none;
}
#hud > * { pointer-events: auto; }
.hud-item {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  border-radius: 12px; padding: 6px 14px;
  min-width: 80px;
}
.hud-label { font-size: 11px; color: #8899aa; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; }
.hud-value { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; }
.hud-value.score { color: #f1c40f; }
.hud-value.population { color: #2ecc71; }
.hud-value.level { color: #3498db; }
#pauseBtn {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); border: none; color: #fff;
  width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 20px;
  cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s;
}
#pauseBtn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); }

/* Canvas */
#gameCanvas {
  width: 100%; flex: 1;
  display: block;
}

/* Controls */
#controls {
  position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
  height: 160px; z-index: 10;
  background: linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(10,14,39,0.98) 0%, rgba(10,14,39,0.85) 80%, rgba(10,14,39,0.0) 100%);
  padding: 30px 16px 12px;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px;
}
.control-row {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center;
}
.control-label {
  font-size: 13px; color: #aabbcc;
  min-width: 120px;
  font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
}
.control-label .math { color: #e74c3c; font-weight: bold; }
.slider-container {
  flex: 1; min-width: 200px; max-width: 500px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
}
input[type="range"] {
  -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none;
  flex: 1; height: 12px; border-radius: 6px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #e74c3c 0%, #f39c12 40%, #2ecc71 50%, #2ecc71 60%, #3498db 100%);
  outline: none; cursor: pointer;
}
input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb {
  -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none;
  width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: #fff; border: 3px solid #3498db;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
  cursor: grab;
}
input[type="range"]::-moz-range-thumb {
  width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: #fff; border: 3px solid #3498db;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
  cursor: grab;
}
.k-value-display {
  font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; color: #f39c12;
  min-width: 60px; text-align: center;
  font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
}
.info-bar {
  display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 20px;
  font-size: 12px; color: #778899;
}
.info-bar span { white-space: nowrap; }
.info-bar .highlight { color: #2ecc71; font-weight: 600; }

/* Overlay screens */
.overlay {
  position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
  z-index: 100;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  background: rgba(10, 14, 39, 0.92);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
}
.overlay.hidden { display: none; }
.overlay-content {
  text-align: center; max-width: 520px; padding: 30px;
}
.overlay-content h1 {
  font-size: 32px; margin-bottom: 8px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f39c12, #e74c3c, #3498db);
  -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  background-clip: text;
}
.overlay-content h2 {
  font-size: 22px; color: #f39c12; margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.overlay-content p {
  font-size: 15px; color: #aabbcc; line-height: 1.7; margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.overlay-content .formula {
  display: inline-block; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  padding: 6px 16px; border-radius: 8px; margin: 8px 0;
  font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: 18px;
  color: #e74c3c; font-weight: bold;
}
.overlay-content .tip {
  background: rgba(52,152,219,0.15); border-left: 3px solid #3498db;
  padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
  margin: 12px 0; text-align: left; font-size: 13px; color: #88bbdd;
}
.btn {
  display: inline-block; padding: 14px 40px;
  border: none; border-radius: 30px; font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s;
  margin: 8px;
}
.btn-primary {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3498db, #2ecc71);
  color: #fff;
}
.btn-primary:hover { transform: scale(1.05); box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(52,152,219,0.5); }
.btn-secondary {
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color: #fff;
}
.btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }

/* Achievement popup */
#achievementPopup {
  position: absolute; top: 80px; right: 16px;
  z-index: 200; pointer-events: none;
  transition: transform 0.5s, opacity 0.5s;
  transform: translateX(120%); opacity: 0;
}
#achievementPopup.show {
  transform: translateX(0); opacity: 1;
}
.achievement-card {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(241,196,15,0.2), rgba(231,76,60,0.2));
  border: 1px solid rgba(241,196,15,0.4);
  border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px 20px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  min-width: 260px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
}
.achievement-icon { font-size: 36px; }
.achievement-text h3 { font-size: 14px; color: #f1c40f; margin-bottom: 2px; }
.achievement-text p { font-size: 12px; color: #aabbcc; margin: 0; }

/* Disaster warning */
#disasterWarning {
  position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  z-index: 50; pointer-events: none;
  font-size: 28px; font-weight: 900;
  color: #e74c3c; text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(231,76,60,0.8);
  opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s;
}
#disasterWarning.show {
  opacity: 1;
  animation: pulse 0.5s ease-in-out 3;
}
@keyframes pulse {
  0%, 100% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1); }
  50% { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.15); }
}

/* Level transition */
#levelBanner {
  position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  z-index: 60; pointer-events: none;
  text-align: center; opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.5s;
}
#levelBanner.show { opacity: 1; }
#levelBanner h2 {
  font-size: 36px; color: #f1c40f;
  text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(241,196,15,0.6);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
#levelBanner p { font-size: 16px; color: #aabbcc; }

/* Progress bar */
#progressBar {
  position: absolute; top: 72px; left: 16px; right: 16px;
  height: 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
  border-radius: 3px; z-index: 10;
}
#progressFill {
  height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #3498db, #2ecc71);
  border-radius: 3px; transition: width 0.3s;
  width: 0%;
}

/* Target zone indicator */
.target-indicator {
  position: absolute; left: 16px; top: 85px;
  z-index: 10; background: rgba(46,204,113,0.15);
  border: 1px solid rgba(46,204,113,0.3);
  border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 12px;
  font-size: 12px; color: #2ecc71;
}

/* Responsive */
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  #hud { height: 56px; padding: 4px 8px; }
  .hud-item { min-width: 60px; padding: 4px 8px; }
  .hud-label { font-size: 9px; }
  .hud-value { font-size: 16px; }
  #controls { height: 140px; padding: 24px 8px 8px; }
  .control-label { font-size: 11px; min-width: 90px; }
  .k-value-display { font-size: 15px; min-width: 50px; }
  .overlay-content h1 { font-size: 24px; }
  .btn { padding: 12px 30px; font-size: 16px; }
  #disasterWarning { font-size: 22px; }
  .target-indicator { font-size: 10px; padding: 4px 8px; }
}
</style>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const katexOptions = {
        delimiters: [
            {left: '\\[', right: '\\]', display: true},
            {left: '\\(', right: '\\)', display: false},
            {left: '$$', right: '$$', display: true},
            {left: '$', right: '$', display: false}
        ],
        throwOnError: false,
        strict: false,
        trust: true
    };

    let renderTimeout;
    function safeRender() {
        if (renderTimeout) clearTimeout(renderTimeout);
        renderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);
        }, 100);
    }

    renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);

    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        let shouldRender = false;
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
            if (mutation.target &&
                mutation.target.className &&
                typeof mutation.target.className === 'string' &&
                mutation.target.className.includes('katex')) {
                return;
            }
            shouldRender = true;
        });

        if (shouldRender) {
            safeRender();
        }
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        characterData: true
    });

    setInterval(() => {
        const text = document.body.innerText;
        if (text.includes('\\(') || text.includes('$$')) {
            safeRender();
        }
    }, 2000);
});
</script>

let startTime = 0;
let elapsedTime = 0;
let score = 0;
let currentLevel = 1;
let population = 100;
let k = 0.3;
let capacity = 200;
let targetMin = 80;
let targetMax = 120;
let levelDuration = 45;
let levelStartTime = 0;
let stableTime = 0;
let history = []; // {time, population}
let particles = [];
let disasterActive = false;
let disasterCooldown = 0;
let disasterChance = 0.002;
let capacityChangeEnabled = false;
let lastCapacityChange = 0;
let gracePeriod = 5;
let graceEnd = 0;
let achievedFirstStable = false;
let achievedDisaster = false;
let achievedLevel2 = false;
let achievedLevel3 = false;
let achievedPerfectK = false;
let lastKChangeTime = 0;
let disasterTimestamp = 0;
let lastFrameTime = 0;
let animFrameId = null;

// DOM elements
const levelDisplay = document.getElementById('levelDisplay');
const popDisplay = document.getElementById('popDisplay');
const scoreDisplay = document.getElementById('scoreDisplay');
const timeDisplay = document.getElementById('timeDisplay');
const kSlider = document.getElementById('kSlider');
const kDisplay = document.getElementById('kDisplay');
const capacityDisplay = document.getElementById('capacityDisplay');
const growthRateDisplay = document.getElementById('growthRateDisplay');
const stableTimeDisplay = document.getElementById('stableTimeDisplay');
const progressFill = document.getElementById('progressFill');
const targetRange = document.getElementById('targetRange');
const disasterWarning = document.getElementById('disasterWarning');
const levelBanner = document.getElementById('levelBanner');
const levelBannerTitle = document.getElementById('levelBannerTitle');
const levelBannerDesc = document.getElementById('levelBannerDesc');
const achievementPopup = document.getElementById('achievementPopup');
const achieveIcon = document.getElementById('achieveIcon');
const achieveName = document.getElementById('achieveName');
const achieveDesc = document.getElementById('achieveDesc');

// Canvas setup
canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

function resizeCanvas() {
  const container = document.getElementById('gameContainer');
  canvas.width = container.clientWidth;
  canvas.height = container.clientHeight;
}
window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);
resizeCanvas();

// Slider event
kSlider.addEventListener('input', function() {
  k = parseFloat(this.value);
  kDisplay.textContent = 'k=' + k.toFixed(2);
  lastKChangeTime = Date.now();
  updateGrowthRateDisplay();
});

function updateGrowthRateDisplay() {
  const pct = (k * 100).toFixed(0);
  const sign = k >= 0 ? '+' : '';
  growthRateDisplay.textContent = sign + pct + '%/s';
  growthRateDisplay.style.color = k > 0 ? '#2ecc71' : '#e74c3c';
}

// ==================== GAME LOOP ====================
function gameLoop(timestamp) {
  if (!gameActive) return;
  if (!lastFrameTime) lastFrameTime = timestamp;
  const dt = Math.min((timestamp - lastFrameTime) / 1000, 0.05); // cap delta
  lastFrameTime = timestamp;

  if (!paused) {
    update(dt);
  }
  render();
  animFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

function update(dt) {
  // Update elapsed time
  elapsedTime += dt;

  // Grace period check
  if (elapsedTime < gracePeriod) {
    // During grace, no failure
  }

  // Update population: dy/dt = k*y (Euler integration)
  // Add slight environmental resistance near capacity
  let effectiveK = k;
  if (capacityChangeEnabled) {
    // Logistic-like resistance: as population approaches capacity, growth slows
    const resistance = 1 - (population / (capacity * 1.5));
    effectiveK = k * Math.max(0.1, resistance);
  }

  // dy/dt = k * y => y_new = y + k * y * dt
  const dy = effectiveK * population * dt;
  population = Math.max(0, population + dy);

  // Small natural noise
  population += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5;

  // Record history
  const maxHistoryPoints = 600;
  history.push({ time: elapsedTime, population: population });
  if (history.length > maxHistoryPoints) history.shift();

  // Check target zone
  const inZone = population >= targetMin && population <= targetMax;
  if (inZone) {
    stableTime += dt;
    score += Math.floor(10 * dt); // 10 points per second in zone
  } else {
    stableTime = Math.max(0, stableTime - dt * 0.5);
  }

  // Check achievements
  if (stableTime >= 5 && !achievedFirstStable) {
    unlockAchievement('first_stable', '🌱', '初入行', '首次保持种群稳定5秒');
    achievedFirstStable = true;
  }

  // Disaster events
  disasterCooldown -= dt;
  if (disasterCooldown <= 0 && !disasterActive && elapsedTime > 12) {
    if (Math.random() < disasterChance) {
      triggerDisaster();
    }
  }

  // Capacity changes (level 2+)
  if (capacityChangeEnabled) {
    lastCapacityChange += dt;
    if (lastCapacityChange > 15 + Math.random() * 10) {
      capacity = 150 + Math.random() * 150;
      capacityDisplay.textContent = Math.round(capacity);
      lastCapacityChange = 0;
      // Flash the capacity display
      capacityDisplay.style.color = '#e74c3c';
      setTimeout(() => capacityDisplay.style.color = '#2ecc71', 1500);
    }
  }

  // Level progression
  const levelProgress = (elapsedTime - levelStartTime) / levelDuration;
  if (levelProgress >= 1 && !disasterActive) {
    advanceLevel();
  }

  // Failure conditions (after grace period)
  if (elapsedTime > gracePeriod) {
    if (population <= 1) {
      endGame('种群数量归零！生态系统崩溃了。', '💀');
      return;
    }
    if (population > capacity * 1.2) {
      endGame('种群数量超过了环境承载极限！生态系统崩溃。', '💥');
      return;
    }
  }

  // Update particles
  updateParticles(dt);

  // Update UI
  updateUI();
}

function updateParticles(dt) {
  for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const p = particles[i];
    p.x += p.vx * dt;
    p.y += p.vy * dt;
    p.vy += p.gravity * dt;
    p.life -= dt;
    if (p.life <= 0) {
      particles.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }
}

function spawnParticles(x, y, count, color, speed) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const spd = speed * (0.5 + Math.random());
    particles.push({
      x: x, y: y,
      vx: Math.cos(angle) * spd,
      vy: Math.sin(angle) * spd - speed * 0.5,
      gravity: 80,
      life: 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.7,
      maxLife: 1.5,
      color: color,
      size: 2 + Math.random() * 4
    });
  }
}

function triggerDisaster() {
  disasterActive = true;
  disasterTimestamp = Date.now();
  disasterWarning.classList.add('show');

  // Reduce population by 30-50%
  const reduction = 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.2;
  population = Math.max(10, population * (1 - reduction));

  // Spawn disaster particles at random positions
  const cx = canvas.width / 2;
  const cy = canvas.height / 2;
  spawnParticles(cx, cy, 30, '#e74c3c', 150);

  setTimeout(() => {
    disasterWarning.classList.remove('show');
    disasterActive = false;
    disasterCooldown = 8 + Math.random() * 5;

    // Check if player adjusted k quickly
    const timeSinceDisaster = (Date.now() - disasterTimestamp) / 1000;
    // Already checked above for perfect K
  }, 2000);

  // Check perfect K achievement (adjusted within 1 second)
  setTimeout(() => {
    if ((Date.now() - disasterTimestamp) < 1500 && !achievedPerfectK) {
      unlockAchievement('survive_disaster', '🔥', '灾后重建', '成功应对一次灾害');
      achievedDisaster = true;
    }
  }, 1000);
}

function advanceLevel() {
  if (currentLevel >= 3) {
    endGame('🎉 恭喜通关！你掌握了指数增长与衰减的动态调控！', '🏆');
    return;
  }

  currentLevel++;
  levelStartTime = elapsedTime;

  // Update level params
  const configs = [
    { targetMin: 80, targetMax: 120, duration: 45, disasterChance: 0.002, capacityChange: false },
    { targetMin: 60, targetMax: 140, duration: 50, disasterChance: 0.004, capacityChange: true },
    { targetMin: 50, targetMax: 150, duration: 55, disasterChance: 0.006, capacityChange: true }
  ];

  const cfg = configs[currentLevel - 1];
  targetMin = cfg.targetMin;
  targetMax = cfg.targetMax;
  levelDuration = cfg.duration;
  disasterChance = cfg.disasterChance;
  capacityChangeEnabled = cfg.capacityChange;

  targetRange.textContent = targetMin + ' - ' + targetMax;

  // Show level banner
  levelBannerTitle.textContent = '🎯 关卡 ' + currentLevel;
  const descs = ['', '环境容量开始波动！', '灾害更加频繁！'];
  levelBannerDesc.textContent = descs[currentLevel - 1] || '挑战升级！';
  levelBanner.classList.add('show');

  setTimeout(() => {
    levelBanner.classList.remove('show');
  }, 2500);

  // Achievement
  if (currentLevel === 2 && !achievedLevel2) {
    unlockAchievement('level2_clear', '⭐', '经验老道', '完成第2关');
    achievedLevel2 = true;
  }
  if (currentLevel === 3 && !achievedLevel3) {
    unlockAchievement('level3_clear', '🏆', '种群大师', '完成第3关');
    achievedLevel3 = true;
  }

  levelDisplay.textContent = currentLevel;
}

function updateUI() {
  popDisplay.textContent = Math.round(population);
  scoreDisplay.textContent = score;
  const mins = Math.floor(elapsedTime / 60);
  const secs = Math.floor(elapsedTime % 60);
  timeDisplay.textContent = mins + ':' + (secs < 10 ? '0' : '') + secs;
  stableTimeDisplay.textContent = Math.round(stableTime) + 's';

  // Progress
  const progress = Math.min(1, (elapsedTime - levelStartTime) / levelDuration) * 100;
  progressFill.style.width = progress + '%';

  // Color population display
  if (population >= targetMin && population <= targetMax) {
    popDisplay.style.color = '#2ecc71';
  } else if (population > targetMax) {
    popDisplay.style.color = '#e74c3c';
  } else {
    popDisplay.style.color = '#f39c12';
  }
}

// ==================== RENDERING ====================
function render() {
  const W = canvas.width;
  const H = canvas.height;
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Background gradient
  const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0a0e27');
  bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0d1530');
  ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  // Chart area
  const chartMarginLeft = 60;
  const chartMarginRight = 20;
  const chartMarginTop = 20;
  const chartMarginBottom = 20;
  const chartW = W - chartMarginLeft - chartMarginRight;
  const chartH = H - chartMarginTop - chartMarginBottom;

  // Determine scale
  let maxPop = Math.max(capacity * 1.2, ...history.map(h => h.population), targetMax * 1.3);
  maxPop = Math.max(maxPop, 200);
  const timeWindow = 20; // seconds visible
  const minTime = Math.max(0, elapsedTime - timeWindow);

  // Draw grid
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  const gridLines = 6;
  for (let i = 0; i <= gridLines; i++) {
    const y = chartMarginTop + (chartH / gridLines) * i;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(chartMarginLeft, y);
    ctx.lineTo(W - chartMarginRight, y);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Y labels
    const val = maxPop * (1 - i / gridLines);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
    ctx.font = '11px monospace';
    ctx.textAlign = 'right';
    ctx.fillText(Math.round(val), chartMarginLeft - 8, y + 4);
  }

  // Time labels
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {
    const t = minTime + (timeWindow / 4) * i;
    const x = chartMarginLeft + (chartW / 4) * i;
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)';
    ctx.fillText(Math.round(t) + 's', x, H - 5);
  }

  // Target zone
  const targetTop = chartMarginTop + chartH * (1 - targetMax / maxPop);
  const targetBottom = chartMarginTop + chartH * (1 - targetMin / maxPop);

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(46, 204, 113, 0.08)';
  ctx.fillRect(chartMarginLeft, targetTop, chartW, targetBottom - targetTop);

  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(46, 204, 113, 0.4)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.setLineDash([8, 4]);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(chartMarginLeft, targetTop);
  ctx.lineTo(W - chartMarginRight, targetTop);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(chartMarginLeft, targetBottom);
  ctx.lineTo(W - chartMarginRight, targetBottom);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);

  // Target label
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(46, 204, 113, 0.6)';
  ctx.font = 'bold 11px sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('🎯 目标区', chartMarginLeft + 5, targetTop - 5);

  // Capacity line
  const capY = chartMarginTop + chartH * (1 - capacity / maxPop);
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(231, 76, 60, 0.4)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(chartMarginLeft, capY);
  ctx.lineTo(W - chartMarginRight, capY);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(231, 76, 60, 0.6)';
  ctx.font = '10px sans-serif';
  ctx.fillText('环境容量: ' + Math.round(capacity), W - chartMarginRight - 10, capY - 5);

  // Draw population curve
  if (history.length > 1) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#3498db';
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.lineJoin = 'round';

    let started = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < history.length; i++) {
      const h = history[i];
      if (h.time < minTime) continue;
      const x = chartMarginLeft + ((h.time - minTime) / timeWindow) * chartW;
      const y = chartMarginTop + chartH * (1 - h.population / maxPop);
      if (!started) {
        ctx.moveTo(x, y);
        started = true;
      } else {
        ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      }
    }
    ctx.stroke();

    // Glow effect
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(52, 152, 219, 0.3)';
    ctx.lineWidth = 6;
    ctx.beginPath();
    started = false;
    for (let i = 0; i < history.length; i++) {
      const h = history[i];
      if (h.time < minTime) continue;
      const x = chartMarginLeft + ((h.time - minTime) / timeWindow) * chartW;
      const y = chartMarginTop + chartH * (1 - h.population / maxPop);
      if (!started) {
        ctx.moveTo(x, y);
        started = true;
      } else {
        ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      }
    }
    ctx.stroke();
  }

  // Current population dot
  const currentX = chartMarginLeft + ((elapsedTime - minTime) / timeWindow) * chartW;
  const currentY = chartMarginTop + chartH * (1 - population / maxPop);

  // Pulsing dot
  const pulseSize = 6 + Math.sin(Date.now() / 200) * 2;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(currentX, currentY, pulseSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = population >= targetMin && population <= targetMax ? '#2ecc71' : '#e74c3c';
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(currentX, currentY, pulseSize + 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = population >= targetMin && population <= targetMax ? 'rgba(46,204,113,0.2)' : 'rgba(231,76,60,0.2)';
  ctx.fill();

  // Draw population organisms (small dots)
  const orgCount = Math.min(50, Math.floor(population / 10));
  for (let i = 0; i < orgCount; i++) {
    const ox = chartMarginLeft + 20 + (Math.sin(Date.now() / 1000 + i * 2.3) * 0.5 + 0.5) * (chartW - 40);
    const oy = currentY + (Math.cos(Date.now() / 800 + i * 1.7) * 0.5) * 30;
    const size = 2 + Math.random() * 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ox, oy, size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(46, 204, 113, ${0.3 + Math.random() * 0.3})`;
    ctx.fill();
  }

  // Draw particles
  for (const p of particles) {
    const alpha = p.life / p.maxLife;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * alpha, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }

  // k value indicator on graph
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(243, 156, 18, 0.8)';
  ctx.font = 'bold 14px monospace';
  ctx.textAlign = 'left';
  ctx.fillText('k = ' + k.toFixed(2), chartMarginLeft + 10, chartMarginTop + 20);

  // dy/dt indicator
  const dyDt = k * population;
  ctx.fillStyle = dyDt > 0 ? 'rgba(46,204,113,0.8)' : 'rgba(231,76,60,0.8)';
  ctx.fillText('dy/dt = ' + dyDt.toFixed(1), chartMarginLeft + 10, chartMarginTop + 38);

  // Stable time bar (bottom of chart area)
  const stableBarW = Math.min(1, stableTime / 30) * chartW * 0.6;
  const barX = W - chartMarginRight - stableBarW - 20;
  const barY = chartMarginTop + chartH - 10;
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(46,204,113,0.15)';
  ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, chartW * 0.6, 6);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2ecc71';
  ctx.fillRect(barX, barY, stableBarW, 6);
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)';
  ctx.font = '10px sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'right';
  ctx.fillText('稳定时间: ' + Math.round(stableTime) + 's / 30s 目标', W - chartMarginRight - 5, barY - 3);
}

// ==================== ACHIEVEMENTS ====================
function unlockAchievement(id, icon, name, desc) {
  achieveIcon.textContent = icon;
  achieveName.textContent = name;
  achieveDesc.textContent = desc;
  achievementPopup.classList.add('show');

  setTimeout(() => {
    achievementPopup.classList.remove('show');
  }, 3500);

  // Save achievement
  let achievements = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('popManager_achievements') || '[]');
  if (!achievements.includes(id)) {
    achievements.push(id);
    localStorage.setItem('popManager_achievements', JSON.stringify(achievements));
  }
}

// ==================== GAME CONTROL ====================
window.startGame = function() {
  document.getElementById('startScreen').classList.add('hidden');
  gameActive = true;
  paused = false;
  startTime = Date.now();
  initLevel();
  lastFrameTime = 0;
  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
};

function initLevel() {
  population = 100;
  k = 0.3;
  kSlider.value = 0.3;
  kDisplay.textContent = 'k=0.30';
  updateGrowthRateDisplay();
  score = 0;
  currentLevel = 1;
  elapsedTime = 0;
  levelStartTime = 0;
  stableTime = 0;
  history = [];
  particles = [];
  graceEnd = 5;
  disasterCooldown = 12;
  disasterActive = false;
  lastCapacityChange = 0;
  capacity = 200;
  targetMin = 80;
  targetMax = 120;
  levelDuration = 45;
  disasterChance = 0.002;
  capacityChangeEnabled = false;
  achievedFirstStable = false;
  achievedDisaster = false;
  achievedLevel2 = false;
  achievedLevel3 = false;
  achievedPerfectK = false;

  levelDisplay.textContent = '1';
  capacityDisplay.textContent = '200';
  targetRange.textContent = '80 - 120';
  progressFill.style.width = '0%';
}

window.togglePause = function() {
  paused = !paused;
  document.getElementById('pauseScreen').classList.toggle('hidden', !paused);
  document.getElementById('pauseBtn').textContent = paused ? '▶' : '⏸';
  if (!paused) {
    lastFrameTime = 0;
  }
};

window.restartGame = function() {
  document.getElementById('pauseScreen').classList.add('hidden');
  document.getElementById('gameOverScreen').classList.add('hidden');
  document.getElementById('startScreen').classList.add('hidden');
  gameActive = true;
  paused = false;
  lastFrameTime = 0;
  initLevel();
  requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
};

function endGame(reason, emoji) {
  gameActive = false;
  if (animFrameId) cancelAnimationFrame(animFrameId);

  const gameOverScreen = document.getElementById('gameOverScreen');
  const gameOverTitle = document.getElementById('gameOverTitle');
  const gameOverReason = document.getElementById('gameOverReason');
  const gameOverStats = document.getElementById('gameOverStats');
  const gameOverTip = document.getElementById('gameOverTip');

  gameOverTitle.textContent = emoji + ' 游戏结束';
  gameOverReason.textContent = reason;
  gameOverStats.textContent = '最终得分: ' + score + ' | 最高关卡: ' + currentLevel;

  // Educational tip
  const tips = [
    '💡 记住：dy/dt = k·y 中，k 不是固定值！它需要根据环境动态调整。',
    '💡 指数增长的直觉：增长率 k 决定了变化的"速度"，而非变化的"量"。',
    '💡 当环境改变时（k值突变、容量变化），你需要重新评估你的策略。'
  ];
  gameOverTip.textContent = tips[Math.floor(Math.random() * tips.length)];

  gameOverScreen.classList.remove('hidden');

  // Save high score
  const highScore = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('popManager_highScore') || '0');
  if (score > highScore) {
    localStorage.setItem('popManager_highScore', score);
  }
}

// ==================== LOAD SAVED DATA ====================
const savedHighScore = localStorage.getItem('popManager_highScore');
if (savedHighScore) {
  // Could display on start screen
}

// ==================== TOUCH SUPPORT ====================
// Ensure slider is touch-friendly
kSlider.style.minHeight = '44px';

}); // end DOMContentLoaded
</script>

</body>
</html>

scenes.title: 指数增长与衰减模型：空间视角

content.html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>指数增长与衰减模型 - 空间视角</title>
  <style>
    * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #0a0a1a;
    }
    #canvas-container { width: 100%; height: 100%; position: relative; }
    canvas { display: block; }

    #loading {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
      background: #0a0a1a;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: #aaa;
      font-size: 16px;
      z-index: 1000;
    }
    #loading .spinner {
      width: 40px; height: 40px;
      border: 3px solid #333;
      border-top-color: #6366f1;
      border-radius: 50%;
      animation: spin 1s linear infinite;
      margin: 0 auto 16px;
    }
    @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

    #controls {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      background: rgba(20, 20, 30, 0.92);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      padding: 16px;
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
      justify-content: center;
      align-items: center;
      border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    }

    .control-group {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
      min-width: 120px;
    }

    label {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #aaa;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }

    input[type="range"] {
      width: 100%;
      height: 6px;
      -webkit-appearance: none;
      background: #333;
      border-radius: 3px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb {
      -webkit-appearance: none;
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      background: #6366f1;
      border-radius: 50%;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    button {
      padding: 12px 20px;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 8px;
      background: #333;
      color: white;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 13px;
      min-width: 44px;
      min-height: 44px;
      transition: all 0.2s;
    }

    button:hover { background: #444; }
    button:active { transform: scale(0.95); }
    button.primary { background: #6366f1; }
    button.primary:hover { background: #5558e8; }
    button.warn { background: #f59e0b; color: #000; }
    button.danger { background: #ef4444; }

    .zoom-btns {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .zoom-btns button {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      font-size: 24px;
      font-weight: bold;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 0;
    }

    #info {
      position: absolute;
      top: 20px;
      left: 20px;
      background: rgba(20, 20, 30, 0.88);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      max-width: 320px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      z-index: 10;
    }

    #info h2 {
      font-size: 16px;
      color: #fbbf24;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    #info p {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: #ccc;
      line-height: 1.6;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    #info .equation {
      background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.2);
      padding: 8px 12px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
      font-size: 14px;
      color: #a5b4fc;
      margin: 8px 0;
      text-align: center;
    }

    #info .legend {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-top: 8px;
    }

    #info .legend-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #bbb;
    }

    #info .legend-dot {
      width: 10px;
      height: 10px;
      border-radius: 50%;
    }

    #slice-label {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      right: 20px;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      background: rgba(20, 20, 30, 0.88);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      padding: 12px 16px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      color: #ccc;
      font-size: 13px;
      z-index: 10;
      text-align: center;
    }

    #slice-label .k-value {
      font-size: 24px;
      font-weight: bold;
      color: #fbbf24;
    }

    #slice-label .k-type {
      font-size: 12px;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }

    .k-positive { color: #f87171; }
    .k-negative { color: #60a5fa; }
    .k-zero { color: #34d399; }

    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      #info { display: none; }
      #slice-label { display: none; }
      #controls { padding: 12px 8px 24px; gap: 8px; }
      .control-group { min-width: 90px; }
    }
  </style>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
    const katexOptions = {
        delimiters: [
            {left: '\\[', right: '\\]', display: true},
            {left: '\\(', right: '\\)', display: false},
            {left: '$$', right: '$$', display: true},
            {left: '$', right: '$', display: false}
        ],
        throwOnError: false,
        strict: false,
        trust: true
    };

    let renderTimeout;
    function safeRender() {
        if (renderTimeout) clearTimeout(renderTimeout);
        renderTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);
        }, 100);
    }

    renderMathInElement(document.body, katexOptions);

    const observer = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
        let shouldRender = false;
        mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
            if (mutation.target &&
                mutation.target.className &&
                typeof mutation.target.className === 'string' &&
                mutation.target.className.includes('katex')) {
                return;
            }
            shouldRender = true;
        });

        if (shouldRender) {
            safeRender();
        }
    });

    observer.observe(document.body, {
        childList: true,
        subtree: true,
        characterData: true
    });

    setInterval(() => {
        const text = document.body.innerText;
        if (text.includes('\\(') || text.includes('$$')) {
            safeRender();
        }
    }, 2000);
});
</script>
