<body>
  <div id="loading">
    <div style="text-align:center;">
      <div class="spinner"></div>
      加载 3D 场景...
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="canvas-container"></div>

  <div id="info">
    <h2>指数增长与衰减模型</h2>
    <p>微分方程 Differential Equation 的空间可视化</p>
    <div class="equation">dy/dt = k · y</div>
    <p>通解: y(t) = y₀ · e<sup>kt</sup></p>
    <p>k > 0: 指数增长 Exponential Growth<br>
       k < 0: 指数衰减 Exponential Decay<br>
       k = 0: 临界状态 Critical State</p>
    <div class="legend">
      <div class="legend-item"><div class="legend-dot" style="background:#f87171"></div>k > 0 增长</div>
      <div class="legend-item"><div class="legend-dot" style="background:#60a5fa"></div>k < 0 衰减</div>
      <div class="legend-item"><div class="legend-dot" style="background:#34d399"></div>k = 0 临界</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="slice-label">
    <div>当前切片 k =</div>
    <div class="k-value" id="k-display">0.00</div>
    <div class="k-type" id="k-type-display">临界状态</div>
  </div>

  <div id="controls">
    <div class="control-group">
      <label>k 值 (growth rate)</label>
      <input type="range" id="k-slider" min="-3" max="3" step="0.1" value="0">
    </div>
    <div class="control-group">
      <label>时间范围 (time range)</label>
      <input type="range" id="t-slider" min="2" max="8" step="0.5" value="5">
    </div>
    <div class="control-group">
      <label>曲线数量 (curves)</label>
      <input type="range" id="curves-slider" min="3" max="15" step="1" value="9">
    </div>
    <div class="zoom-btns">
      <button id="zoom-in-btn" title="放大">+</button>
      <button id="zoom-out-btn" title="缩小">−</button>
    </div>
    <button id="toggle-surface" class="primary">显示曲面</button>
    <button id="toggle-slopes">显示斜率</button>
    <button id="reset-btn" class="warn">重置</button>
  </div>

  <script type="importmap">{"imports":{"three":"data:text/javascript;base64,","three/addons/":"https://unpkg.com/three@0.157.0/examples/jsm/","three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js":"data:text/javascript;base64,"}}</script>

  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from 'three';
    import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';

    function checkWebGL() {
      try {
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
        return !!(window.WebGLRenderingContext &&
          (canvas.getContext('webgl') || canvas.getContext('experimental-webgl')));
      } catch(e) { return false; }
    }

    async function initScene() {
      try {
        if (!checkWebGL()) throw new Error('浏览器不支持 WebGL');

        const container = document.getElementById('canvas-container');
        const width = container.clientWidth || window.innerWidth;
        const height = container.clientHeight || window.innerHeight;
        if (width === 0 || height === 0) throw new Error('容器尺寸为零');

        // Scene
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x0a0a1a);
        scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(0x0a0a1a, 0.015);

        // Camera
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(55, width / height, 0.1, 200);
        camera.position.set(8, 8, 12);

        // Renderer
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(width, height);
        renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
        renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
        container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Controls
        const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
        controls.enableDamping = true;
        controls.dampingFactor = 0.06;
        controls.target.set(0, 1.5, 0);

        // Lighting
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.5);
        scene.add(ambientLight);

        const hemiLight = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xddeeff, 0x444466, 0.6);
        scene.add(hemiLight);

        const dirLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.2);
        dirLight.position.set(10, 20, 10);
        dirLight.castShadow = true;
        scene.add(dirLight);

        const pointLight = new THREE.PointLight(0x6366f1, 0.8, 50);
        pointLight.position.set(-5, 10, -5);
        scene.add(pointLight);

        const objects = {};
        let animationSpeed = 1;
        let currentK = 0;
        let currentTimeRange = 5;
        let numCurves = 9;
        let showSurface = true;
        let showSlopes = false;
        let time = 0;

        // ─── Coordinate Axes ───
        function createAxis(length, color, label, startOffset, direction) {
          const group = new THREE.Group();
          const axisMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color, transparent: true, opacity: 0.8 });
          const axisGeom = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.04, 0.04, length, 8);

          const axis = new THREE.Mesh(axisGeom, axisMat);
          if (direction === 'y') axis.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
          else if (direction === 'z') axis.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;
          else if (direction === 'x') axis.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;

          if (direction === 'y') {
            axis.position.y = length / 2 + startOffset;
          } else if (direction === 'z') {
            axis.position.z = length / 2 + startOffset;
          } else {
            axis.position.x = length / 2 + startOffset;
          }
          group.add(axis);

          // Arrow
          const arrowGeom = new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.15, 0.4, 8);
          const arrow = new THREE.Mesh(arrowGeom, axisMat);
          if (direction === 'y') {
            arrow.position.y = length + startOffset;
          } else if (direction === 'z') {
            arrow.position.z = length + startOffset;
          } else {
            arrow.position.x = length + startOffset;
          }
          group.add(arrow);

          scene.add(group);
          return group;
        }

        // t-axis (x direction, horizontal forward)
        createAxis(8, 0xfbbf24, 't', -4, 'x');
        // y-axis (vertical)
        createAxis(8, 0xf87171, 'y', -1, 'y');
        // k-axis (z direction, horizontal right)
        createAxis(8, 0x60a5fa, 'k', -4, 'z');

        // Axis labels using sprites
        function createLabel(text, position, color = '#ffffff') {
          const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
          canvas.width = 128;
          canvas.height = 64;
          const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
          ctx.fillStyle = color;
          ctx.font = 'bold 36px Arial';
          ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.fillText(text, 64, 44);

          const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
          const spriteMat = new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: texture, transparent: true });
          const sprite = new THREE.Sprite(spriteMat);
          sprite.position.copy(position);
          sprite.scale.set(1.5, 0.75, 1);
          scene.add(sprite);
          return sprite;
        }

        createLabel('t (时间 time)', new THREE.Vector3(4.5, -0.3, 0), '#fbbf24');
        createLabel('y (值 value)', new THREE.Vector3(0, 5.5, 0), '#f87171');
        createLabel('k (增长率 rate)', new THREE.Vector3(0, -0.3, 4.5), '#60a5fa');

        // ─── Grid floor ───
        const gridHelper = new THREE.GridHelper(20, 20, 0x222244, 0x111133);
        gridHelper.position.y = -0.5;
        scene.add(gridHelper);

        // ─── k=0 Divider Plane ───
        function createDividerPlane() {
          const geom = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(10, 8, 1, 1);
          const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
            color: 0x34d399,
            transparent: true,
            opacity: 0.12,
            side: THREE.DoubleSide
          });
          const plane = new THREE.Mesh(geom, mat);
          plane.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
          plane.position.y = 0;
          scene.add(plane);

          // Edge glow
          const edgeGeom = new THREE.EdgesGeometry(geom);
          const edgeMat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0x34d399, transparent: true, opacity: 0.5 });
          const edges = new THREE.LineSegments(edgeGeom, edgeMat);
          edges.position.copy(plane.position);
          edges.rotation.copy(plane.rotation);
          scene.add(edges);

          return { plane, edges };
        }

        const dividerPlane = createDividerPlane();
        objects.dividerPlane = dividerPlane;

        // Label for k=0
        createLabel('k = 0 临界', new THREE.Vector3(-4.5, 0.5, 0), '#34d399');

        // ─── Exponential Curves ───
        function createExponentialCurve(k, tMax, segments = 120) {
          const points = [];
          const color = k > 0.05 ? new THREE.Color(0xf87171) :
                        k < -0.05 ? new THREE.Color(0x60a5fa) :
                        new THREE.Color(0x34d399);

          for (let i = 0; i <= segments; i++) {
            const t = -2 + (tMax / 2 + 2) * (i / segments);
            const y = Math.exp(k * t);
            // Clamp to prevent extreme values
            const clampedY = Math.min(Math.max(y, -5), 8);
            points.push(new THREE.Vector3(t, clampedY, k));
          }

          const geom = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(points);
          const mat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({
            color: color,
            transparent: true,
            opacity: 0.7
          });
          const line = new THREE.Line(geom, mat);
          line.userData.k = k;
          return line;
        }

        function buildCurves(kValues) {
          // Remove old curves
          if (objects.curves) {
            objects.curves.forEach(c => scene.remove(c));
          }
          objects.curves = [];

          kValues.forEach(k => {
            const curve = createExponentialCurve(k, currentTimeRange);
            scene.add(curve);
            objects.curves.push(curve);
          });
        }

        function getKValues(num) {
          const values = [];
          const step = 6 / (num - 1);
          for (let i = 0; i < num; i++) {
            values.push(-3 + i * step);
          }
          return values;
        }

        // Initial curves
        const kValues = getKValues(numCurves);
        buildCurves(kValues);

        // ─── Surface ───
        function createSurface(tMax, kMin, kMax, tSegs, kSegs) {
          const geom = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(tMax + 4, kMax - kMin, tSegs, kSegs);
          const positions = geom.attributes.position;

          for (let i = 0; i < positions.count; i++) {
            const x = positions.getX(i); // t
            const y = positions.getY(i); // k (will become z)
            const t = x - 2;
            const k = y + Math.abs(kMin);

            const value = Math.exp(k * t);
            const clamped = Math.min(Math.max(value, -5), 8);

            // x = t, y = value, z = k
            positions.setXYZ(i, t, clamped, k);
          }

          geom.computeVertexNormals();

          // Color vertices based on k
          const colors = new Float32Array(positions.count * 3);
          for (let i = 0; i < positions.count; i++) {
            const k = positions.getZ(i);
            const t = positions.getX(i);
            const y = positions.getY(i);

            let r, g, b;
            if (k > 0.05) {
              // Growth: warm red-orange gradient based on y value
              const intensity = Math.min(y / 6, 1);
              r = 0.6 + 0.4 * intensity;
              g = 0.2 + 0.3 * intensity;
              b = 0.1;
            } else if (k < -0.05) {
              // Decay: cool blue gradient
              const intensity = Math.min(Math.abs(k) / 3, 1);
              r = 0.1;
              g = 0.3 + 0.4 * intensity;
              b = 0.7 + 0.3 * intensity;
            } else {
              // k ≈ 0: green
              r = 0.2;
              g = 0.8;
              b = 0.5;
            }
            colors[i * 3] = r;
            colors[i * 3 + 1] = g;
            colors[i * 3 + 2] = b;
          }
          geom.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors, 3));

          const mat = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
            vertexColors: true,
            transparent: true,
            opacity: 0.55,
            side: THREE.DoubleSide,
            wireframe: false,
            shininess: 30
          });

          const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, mat);
          return mesh;
        }

        const surface = createSurface(currentTimeRange, -3, 3, 60, 40);
        scene.add(surface);
        objects.surface = surface;

        // Surface wireframe overlay
        const surfaceWire = createSurface(currentTimeRange, -3, 3, 30, 20);
        surfaceWire.material = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
          color: 0xffffff,
          transparent: true,
          opacity: 0.06,
          side: THREE.DoubleSide,
          wireframe: true
        });
        scene.add(surfaceWire);
        objects.surfaceWire = surfaceWire;

        // ─── Slice Plane ───
        function createSlicePlane(k) {
          const geom = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(currentTimeRange + 4, 8, 1, 1);
          const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
            color: 0xfbbf24,
            transparent: true,
            opacity: 0.15,
            side: THREE.DoubleSide
          });
          const plane = new THREE.Mesh(geom, mat);
          plane.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
          plane.position.set(1, 2.5, k);

          // Edge
          const edgeGeom = new THREE.EdgesGeometry(geom);
          const edgeMat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0xfbbf24, transparent: true, opacity: 0.7 });
          const edges = new THREE.LineSegments(edgeGeom, edgeMat);
          edges.position.copy(plane.position);
          edges.rotation.copy(plane.rotation);

          return { plane, edges };
        }

        let slicePlane = createSlicePlane(currentK);
        scene.add(slicePlane.plane);
        scene.add(slicePlane.edges);
        objects.slicePlane = slicePlane;

        // ─── Highlighted k Curve ───
        function createHighlightedCurve(k, tMax) {
          return createExponentialCurve(k, tMax, 150);
        }

        let highlightCurve = createHighlightedCurve(currentK, currentTimeRange);
        highlightCurve.material.opacity = 1.0;
        // Rebuild with proper geometry
        const hlPoints = [];
        for (let i = 0; i <= 150; i++) {
          const t = -2 + ((currentTimeRange / 2) + 2) * (i / 150);
          const y = Math.min(Math.max(Math.exp(currentK * t), -5), 8);
          hlPoints.push(new THREE.Vector3(t, y, currentK));
        }
        highlightCurve.geometry.dispose();
        highlightCurve.geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(hlPoints);

        scene.add(highlightCurve);
        objects.highlightCurve = highlightCurve;

        // ─── Slope Indicators ───
        function createSlopeIndicator(t, k, scale) {
          const y = Math.exp(k * t);
          const dy_dt = k * y; // derivative

          const group = new THREE.Group();

          // Arrow shaft
          const arrowLength = Math.min(Math.abs(dy_dt) * scale, 3);
          if (arrowLength < 0.01) return group;

          const shaftGeom = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.015, 0.015, arrowLength, 6);
          const shaftMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
            color: k > 0 ? 0xff6b6b : 0x60a5fa,
            transparent: true,
            opacity: 0.8
          });
          const shaft = new THREE.Mesh(shaftGeom, shaftMat);
          shaft.position.y = arrowLength / 2;
          group.add(shaft);

          // Arrow head
          const headGeom = new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.06, 0.15, 6);
          const head = new THREE.Mesh(headGeom, shaftMat);
          head.position.y = arrowLength + 0.075;
          group.add(head);

          group.position.set(t, Math.min(y, 7), k);
          return group;
        }

        let slopeGroup = new THREE.Group();
        scene.add(slopeGroup);
        objects.slopeGroup = slopeGroup;

        function updateSlopes() {
          // Clear old
          while (slopeGroup.children.length > 0) {
            slopeGroup.remove(slopeGroup.children[0]);
          }

          if (!showSlopes) return;

          const kVals = getKValues(7);
          const tVals = [-1, 0, 1, 2];

          kVals.forEach(k => {
            tVals.forEach(t => {
              const indicator = createSlopeIndicator(t, k, 0.5);
              slopeGroup.add(indicator);
            });
          });
        }

        // ─── t=0 vertical plane ───
        const t0Geom = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(8, 8, 1, 1);
        const t0Mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
          color: 0xfbbf24,
          transparent: true,
          opacity: 0.06,
          side: THREE.DoubleSide
        });
        const t0Plane = new THREE.Mesh(t0Geom, t0Mat);
        t0Plane.rotation.y = Math.PI / 2;
        t0Plane.position.set(0, 3, 0);
        scene.add(t0Plane);

        createLabel('t = 0', new THREE.Vector3(0, 5, -4), '#fbbf24');

        // ─── y=1 horizontal reference ───
        const y1Geom = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(8, 8, 1, 1);
        const y1Mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
          color: 0xa78bfa,
          transparent: true,
          opacity: 0.08,
          side: THREE.DoubleSide
        });
        const y1Plane = new THREE.Mesh(y1Geom, y1Mat);
        y1Plane.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
        y1Plane.position.set(0, 1, 0);
        scene.add(y1Plane);

        createLabel('y = 1', new THREE.Vector3(4.5, 1.3, -4), '#a78bfa');

        // ─── Tick marks on axes ───
        function createTickMark(position, size, color = 0x666688) {
          const geom = new THREE.BoxGeometry(size, size, size);
          const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color });
          const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, mat);
          mesh.position.copy(position);
          scene.add(mesh);
          return mesh;
        }

        // t-axis ticks
        for (let t = -2; t <= 3; t++) {
          createTickMark(new THREE.Vector3(t, -0.5, 0), 0.08);
        }
        // y-axis ticks
        for (let y = 0; y <= 7; y++) {
          createTickMark(new THREE.Vector3(0, y, 0), 0.08);
        }
        // k-axis ticks
        for (let k = -3; k <= 3; k++) {
          createTickMark(new THREE.Vector3(0, -0.5, k), 0.08);
        }

        // ─── Particle system for ambient effect ───
        const particleCount = 200;
        const particleGeom = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
        const particlePositions = new Float32Array(particleCount * 3);
        for (let i = 0; i < particleCount; i++) {
          particlePositions[i * 3] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30;
          particlePositions[i * 3 + 1] = Math.random() * 15;
          particlePositions[i * 3 + 2] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30;
        }
        particleGeom.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(particlePositions, 3));
        const particleMat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({
          color: 0x6366f1,
          size: 0.05,
          transparent: true,
          opacity: 0.4
        });
        const particles = new THREE.Points(particleGeom, particleMat);
        scene.add(particles);

        // ─── Controls ───
        const kSlider = document.getElementById('k-slider');
        const tSlider = document.getElementById('t-slider');
        const curvesSlider = document.getElementById('curves-slider');

        function updateHighlightCurve() {
          const points = [];
          for (let i = 0; i <= 150; i++) {
            const t = -2 + ((currentTimeRange / 2) + 2) * (i / 150);
            const y = Math.min(Math.max(Math.exp(currentK * t), -5), 8);
            points.push(new THREE.Vector3(t, y, currentK));
          }
          highlightCurve.geometry.dispose();
          highlightCurve.geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(points);

          const color = currentK > 0.05 ? 0xf87171 :
                        currentK < -0.05 ? 0x60a5fa : 0x34d399;
          highlightCurve.material.color.setHex(color);

          // Update slice plane
          scene.remove(slicePlane.plane);
          scene.remove(slicePlane.edges);
          slicePlane = createSlicePlane(currentK);
          scene.add(slicePlane.plane);
          scene.add(slicePlane.edges);

          // Update k display
          const kDisplay = document.getElementById('k-display');
          kDisplay.textContent = currentK.toFixed(2);
          const kTypeDisplay = document.getElementById('k-type-display');
          if (currentK > 0.05) {
            kTypeDisplay.textContent = '📈 指数增长 Exponential Growth';
            kTypeDisplay.className = 'k-type k-positive';
          } else if (currentK < -0.05) {
            kTypeDisplay.textContent = '📉 指数衰减 Exponential Decay';
            kTypeDisplay.className = 'k-type k-negative';
          } else {
            kTypeDisplay.textContent = '⚖️ 临界状态 Critical State';
            kTypeDisplay.className = 'k-type k-zero';
          }
        }

        kSlider.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
          currentK = parseFloat(e.target.value);
          updateHighlightCurve();
          updateSlopes();
        });

        tSlider.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
          currentTimeRange = parseFloat(e.target.value);
          buildCurves(getKValues(numCurves));
          // Rebuild surface
          scene.remove(surface);
          scene.remove(surfaceWire);
          const newSurface = createSurface(currentTimeRange, -3, 3, 60, 40);
          scene.add(newSurface);
          objects.surface = newSurface;
          const newWire = createSurface(currentTimeRange, -3, 3, 30, 20);
          newWire.material = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
            color: 0xffffff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.06,
            side: THREE.DoubleSide, wireframe: true
          });
          scene.add(newWire);
          objects.surfaceWire = newWire;
          updateHighlightCurve();
        });

        curvesSlider.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
          numCurves = parseInt(e.target.value);
          buildCurves(getKValues(numCurves));
        });

        // Toggle surface
        document.getElementById('toggle-surface').addEventListener('click', () => {
          showSurface = !showSurface;
          surface.visible = showSurface;
          surfaceWire.visible = showSurface;
          document.getElementById('toggle-surface').textContent = showSurface ? '隐藏曲面' : '显示曲面';
        });

        // Toggle slopes
        document.getElementById('toggle-slopes').addEventListener('click', () => {
          showSlopes = !showSlopes;
          document.getElementById('toggle-slopes').textContent = showSlopes ? '隐藏斜率' : '显示斜率';
          updateSlopes();
        });

        // Zoom
        document.getElementById('zoom-in-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
          const dir = new THREE.Vector3();
          camera.getWorldDirection(dir);
          camera.position.addScaledVector(dir, 3);
        });

        document.getElementById('zoom-out-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
          const dir = new THREE.Vector3();
          camera.getWorldDirection(dir);
          camera.position.addScaledVector(dir, -3);
        });

        // Reset
        document.getElementById('reset-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
          camera.position.set(8, 8, 12);
          controls.target.set(0, 1.5, 0);
          currentK = 0;
          currentTimeRange = 5;
          numCurves = 9;
          kSlider.value = 0;
          tSlider.value = 5;
          curvesSlider.value = 9;
          buildCurves(getKValues(9));
          updateHighlightCurve();
          updateSlopes();
        });

        // ─── Animation Loop ───
        function animate() {
          requestAnimationFrame(animate);
          time += 0.016 * animationSpeed;

          // Gentle pulse on highlight curve
          if (highlightCurve) {
            const pulse = 0.08 + 0.02 * Math.sin(time * 3);
            highlightCurve.material.opacity = 0.8 + 0.2 * Math.sin(time * 2);
          }

          // Divider plane pulse
          if (dividerPlane) {
            dividerPlane.edges.material.opacity = 0.3 + 0.2 * Math.sin(time * 1.5);
          }

          // Animate particles
          const pPositions = particles.geometry.attributes.position;
          for (let i = 0; i < particleCount; i++) {
            let y = pPositions.getY(i);
            y += 0.005;
            if (y > 15) y = 0;
            pPositions.setY(i, y);
          }
          pPositions.needsUpdate = true;

          controls.update();
          renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }

        animate();

        // ─── Resize ───
        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
          const w = container.clientWidth || window.innerWidth;
          const h = container.clientHeight || window.innerHeight;
          camera.aspect = w / h;
          camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
          renderer.setSize(w, h);
        });

        // ─── postMessage Listener ───
        window.addEventListener('message', (event) => {
          const { action, payload } = event.data || {};

          switch (action) {
            case 'SET_WIDGET_STATE': {
              if (payload.cameraPosition) {
                camera.position.set(...payload.cameraPosition);
              }
              if (payload.cameraTarget) {
                controls.target.set(...payload.cameraTarget);
              }
              if (payload.k !== undefined) {
                currentK = payload.k;
                kSlider.value = currentK;
                updateHighlightCurve();
              }
              if (payload.timeScale !== undefined) {
                currentTimeRange = payload.timeScale;
                tSlider.value = currentTimeRange;
                buildCurves(getKValues(numCurves));
                scene.remove(surface);
                scene.remove(surfaceWire);
                const ns = createSurface(currentTimeRange, -3, 3, 60, 40);
                scene.add(ns);
                objects.surface = ns;
                updateHighlightCurve();
              }
              if (payload.showSurface !== undefined) {
                showSurface = payload.showSurface;
                surface.visible = showSurface;
                surfaceWire.visible = showSurface;
              }
              if (payload.animationSpeed !== undefined) {
                animationSpeed = payload.animationSpeed;
              }
              break;
            }

            case 'HIGHLIGHT_ELEMENT': {
              const { elementId, highlight } = payload;
              if (elementId === 'surface' && objects.surface) {
                objects.surface.material.opacity = highlight ? 0.8 : 0.55;
              }
              if (elementId === 'dividerPlane' && objects.dividerPlane) {
                objects.dividerPlane.plane.material.opacity = highlight ? 0.3 : 0.12;
                objects.dividerPlane.edges.material.opacity = highlight ? 0.9 : 0.5;
              }
              if (elementId === 'highlightCurve' && objects.highlightCurve) {
                objects.highlightCurve.material.opacity = highlight ? 1.0 : 0.7;
              }
              if (elementId === 'slopes') {
                showSlopes = highlight;
                updateSlopes();
              }
              break;
            }

            case 'ANNOTATE_ELEMENT': {
              const { elementId, text } = payload;
              // Remove existing annotations for this element
              if (objects.annotations && objects.annotations[elementId]) {
                objects.annotations[elementId].forEach(a => scene.remove(a));
              }
              if (!objects.annotations) objects.annotations = {};

              if (elementId === 'highlightCurve' && text) {
                const annotation = createLabel(text,
                  new THREE.Vector3(currentTimeRange / 2, Math.exp(currentK * currentTimeRange / 2), currentK + 0.5),
                  '#fbbf24');
                objects.annotations[elementId] = [annotation];
              }
              break;
            }

            case 'COMPARE_K': {
              const { k1, k2 } = payload;
              // Build curves for comparison
              const kVals = getKValues(numCurves);
              buildCurves(kVals);
              currentK = k1;
              kSlider.value = k1;
              updateHighlightCurve();
              break;
            }
          }
        });

        // Hide loading
        document.getElementById('loading').style.display = 'none';

      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Scene initialization failed:', error);
        document.getElementById('loading').innerHTML =
          `<div style="text-align:center;color:#ff6b6b;">
            <div style="font-size:24px;margin-bottom:16px;">⚠️</div>
            3D 场景加载失败<br>
            <small style="color:#888;">${error.message}</small><br>
            <button onclick="location.reload()" style="margin-top:16px;padding:8px 16px;background:#6366f1;color:white;border:none;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;">重试</button>
          </div>`;
      }
    }

    initScene();
  </script>

actions.text: 本场景聚焦“全课整理：证据链回看”。好了，各位同学，我们现在来到了一个非常重要的时刻——'全课整理：证据链回看'。从最开始的诊断，到刚才的空间视角，我们积累了很多交互的直觉。现在，让我们把这些散落的珍珠串成一条完整的证据链。
首先，请看向这里：'代数误解修复'。还记得在场景5和场景10吗？当大家（Differential Equation）试图用死板的代数思维去移动变量时，我们的拖动实验是如何修正那种'公式搬运'的冲动的。正是通过那两次关键的视觉反馈，我们把'微分'真正理解为了一个动态的整体，而不是可以随意拆解的符号。
接着，我们把目光投向'预测与增长'。这就连接到了大家最兴奋的部分。回想场景3里，我们通过拖动点来预测曲线的走向；到了场景14，也就是指数增长与衰减模型（Exponential Growth and Decay），我们发现比例增长本质上是线性驱动指数。这就是从离散的直觉推测，跨越到了连续的比例变化率模型。
最后，让我们夯实最核心的'直觉奠基'。大家刚才在空间视角里看到的那些曲面和斜率场，是不是觉得很有结构感？这就对了。我们这一节课，不管是修复误解还是玩转模型，都是在为一个更宏大的目标铺路：为后续的物理建模，比如运动力学里的牛顿冷却定律，提供一个坚实、可视的直觉起点。
所以大家要记住，这只是入门。微分方程的世界远比这广阔，更复杂的物理建模（Physical Modeling）完全依赖于我们此时此地建立起来的这些基础直觉。不要小看今天在拖动和观察中获得的微小感知，它们才是未来破解高深公式的真正钥匙。

questions.analysis: 衰变遵循 dy/dt = -ky 的规律。半衰期为10年意味着每10年衰减一半。从初始N0到N0/2需要10年，再从N0/2到N0/4又需要10年。总共需要20年。这等同于两个半衰期。
questions.question: 假设我们有一个新元素“幻数素”，其衰变速率与当前剩余量成正比。已知其半衰期为10年。如果初始有N0克，大约多少年后剩余量变为初始的1/4？

options.label: 该方程描述的是变化率（导数 Derivative）等于当前值的动态过程
它的一个特解是 y = e^t，代表了指数增长
如果初始条件是负数，随着时间的推移，y会趋近于0
这个方程可以描述银行账户中，利息不断复投产生的“复利”增长现象

questions.analysis: A正确：dy/dt是变化率，y是当前值，方程直接定义了变化率等于当前值。B正确：y=e^t的导数是它本身，是一个基础解。C错误：如果初始值为负，随着时间增加，y=e^t会趋近于负无穷，而非0。D正确：复利计算中，本息和增加的速度（利息）正比于当前本息和，这是一个经典的复利模型。
questions.question: 关于微分方程（Differential Equation） dy/dt = y，下列哪些描述是正确的？（多选）

questions.analysis: 参考回答要点：方程 dy/dt = ky 描述的是一个过程的瞬时增长速率（dy/dt）与它当前的积累量（y）成正比。k是比例常数，代表增长率。这就产生了一个正反馈环：当y增加一点点，它的变化率也增加，这就使得y在下一个瞬间增加得更多。如此循环，增长会呈爆炸式。就像滚雪球，雪球越大，表面积越大，能粘上的雪就越多，使得雪球更大。在复利中，本金越大，产生的利息越多，加入本金后，下一次计息的本金就更大，从而产生更多利息。这与‘马太效应’中拥有的越多，获得的也越多的逻辑完全一致。
questions.question: 请用你自己的话，结合“马太效应”（即富者愈富、贫者愈贫的现象），解释为什么微分方程 dy/dt = ky （其中k>0）能够代表一种“复利”或“滚雪球”式的增长。你需要描述出“变化率”和“当前量”之间的关系是如何导致这种结果的。
questions.commentPrompt: 评分标准（总分20分）：(1) 准确描述方程含义：解释了dy/dt是瞬时变化率，y是当前积累量，两者成正比关系（方程的直观含义）—— 40%。(2) 逻辑演绎：清晰说明“当前量越大，变化越快，这导致当前量更快地变得更大”，从而形成正反馈循环（滚雪球效应）—— 40%。(3) 类比恰当：成功地将数学逻辑与马太效应或复利现象联系起来，比喻生动准确—— 20%。

options.label: 增长会更快，因为开根号会让数值变大
增长会更慢，曲线会变得更平缓，甚至可能趋于一条直线
增长趋势完全一样，因为都是 y 的函数
在 y>1 时会增长更慢，在 0<y<1 时会增长更快，但最终都会爆炸式增长

questions.analysis: 核心是比较两者的变化率大小。当 y>1 时，sqrt(y) 比 y 小（例如 y=4，sqrt(4)=2 < 4）；当 0<y<1 时，sqrt(y) 比 y 大（例如 y=0.25，sqrt(0.25)=0.5 > 0.25）。但考虑到解曲线是从一个小的正数开始增长，一旦 y 稍微变大（比如超过1），其变化率就迅速小于 dy/dt=y 的情况。整体而言，它的增长驱动力更弱，曲线会比指数函数平缓得多，实际上它是一种二次方级的增长，看起来更像抛物线，而不是陡峭的指数曲线。所以B选项最准确。A错误，没有区分不同区间的数值大小关系。C错误，函数形式不同导致增长率截然不同。D指出了区间差异，但‘最终都会爆炸式增长’不准确，dy/dt=sqrt(y) 的确会在有限时间内爆炸（有限时间奇点），但其增长趋势与指数爆炸有本质不同，且描述‘增长更慢，更平缓’是其主要特征。
questions.question: 在第一组虚拟实验中，你观察到 dy/dt = y 的解曲线在 y>0 时向上弯曲地增长。在第二组虚拟实验中，对于方程 dy/dt = y^2，解曲线也有类似趋势。现在面对一个新方程 dy/dt = sqrt(y)，仅靠直觉判断，当 y>0 时，其解曲线的增长趋势相比于 dy/dt = y 会有何不同？

options.label: 污染物浓度会像指数衰减一样，迅速归零
污染物浓度会先快速下降，但永远无法完全归零，会残留极少量
污染物浓度会下降得越来越慢，需要无限长时间才能完全消失
污染物浓度的倒数与时间成线性关系，浓度最终会趋近于零，但比指数衰减慢

questions.analysis: 对于 dy/dt = -k y^2，可通过分离变量法求解：-dy/y^2 = k dt -> 1/y = kt + C。因此 y = 1/(kt+C)。当 t=0 时，C = 1/C0。可见，浓度的倒数随时间线性增长，浓度本身按双曲线规律衰减。它在开始时如果C0很大，下降很快，但随着浓度变小，其变化率的绝对值也变得更小，所以后期衰减会变得非常缓慢。但理论上，当t趋于无穷时，y趋于0。与指数衰减（dy/dt=-ky, y=C0*e^{-kt}）相比，指数衰减前期慢，后期快（对半衰期恒定），而这里的衰减是前期快后期慢。A错误，不是指数衰减。B错误，它在数学上是可以无限趋近于0的。C错误，它确实需要无限长时间，但这与指数衰减一样，关键区别在于衰减的模式是前期快后期慢，且倒数线性。D是最准确的数学描述。
questions.question: 考虑一个湖泊的污染模型，污染物一旦进入湖泊就不再排出，但会以某种速率自然降解。如果污染物的降解速率（dy/dt）与污染物当前浓度的平方成正比，即 dy/dt = -k y^2。假设初始浓度为C0，下列哪个关于“未来污染物浓度”的推论是正确的？

questions.analysis: 参考回答要点：最根本的区别在于变化率对当前量y的依赖程度不同。对于dy/dt = y，依赖是线性的；对于dy/dt = y^2，依赖是二次方的。这意味着当y变大时，dy/dt = y^2的增长加速度要猛烈得多。在实验结果中，dy/dt = y的解是一条指数曲线，它持续增长，但需要无限长的时间才能达到无穷。而dy/dt = y^2的解在超过某个临界点后，会以惊人的速度向上飙升，甚至在有限的时间内就穿透了坐标系的顶部，趋向无穷大，这被称为‘有限时间奇点’或爆炸现象。也就是说，反馈的强度决定了系统是在无限未来爆炸，还是在有限时间爆炸。
questions.question: 结合你在虚拟实验中对 dy/dt = y 和 dy/dt = y^2 这两个方程解曲线的观察，请解释它们的最根本区别是什么？提示：可以从“变化率对当前值的依赖程度”和“解在有限时间内的行为”这两个角度来分析。
questions.commentPrompt: 评分标准（总分15分）：(1) 明确指出两者的关键区别：对于 dy/dt=y，变化率与y线性相关；对于 dy/dt=y^2，变化率与y二次方相关。这导致在y较大时，后者的增长率远大于前者—— 50%。(2) 描述所观察到的现象，并能联系‘有限时间奇点’的概念：如指出 dy/dt=y^2 的解可能在有限时间内趋向于无穷大（爆炸），而 dy/dt=y 的解是指数增长，仅在时间无穷时趋于无穷，不会在有限时间内爆炸—— 50%。
